1000.description: The player is invited to Valhalla and told they will be reborn into a new life as greater heroes.
guide: Valkyrie (valkyrie 48,86) welcomes the player to Valhalla and explains the next life.
The Book of Ymir (yuno_in02 93,207) provides additional information about Valkyrie and the afterlife.
1000.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 98 for this quest.

1001.description: Before becoming an Acolyte the player must reach Novice Job Level 9, learn all Basic Skills and complete a penance trial. This quest is the trial Father Mareusis assigns, which sends the player to Father Rubalkabara.
guide: Father Mareusis (prt_church 184,41) - sends the player to do penance with Father Rubalkabara
Father Rubalkabara - practices asceticism in the Relics northeast of Prontera City
Father Mareusis (prt_church 184,41) - promotes the player to Acolyte once Novice Job Level 9, the Basic Skills and the penance are done
1001.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1002.description: A quest to change from Novice to Acolyte job, requiring the player to complete basic training and learn all Basic Skills before becoming an Acolyte.
guide: Father Mareusis (prt_church 184,41) - Discuss Acolyte requirements and readiness for the job change
Father Mareusis (prt_church 184,41) - sends the player at random to Mother Mathilda, who practices asceticism near Morocc Town, southwest of Prontera City
Father Mareusis (prt_church 184,41) - promotes the player to Acolyte after the trial is done and the player returns
1002.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1003.description: A quest to change job to Acolyte under the guidance of Father Mareusis. The NPC explains the requirements and assigns a random penance trial.
guide: Father Mareusis (prt_church 184,41) asks if the player wants to become an Acolyte and explains the requirements
Father Mareusis (prt_church 184,41) - randomly sends the player to Father Yosuke, who practices asceticism near a bridge somewhere northwest of Prontera
Father Mareusis (prt_church 184,41) reminds the player to reach Novice Job Level 9 and learn all Basic Skills if requirements are not met
1003.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1004.description: The Archer Guildsman explains the requirements and process for changing to the Archer job.
guide: Talk to Archer Guildsman (payon_in02 64,71) to learn about becoming an Archer
Learn all Basic Skills and reach Novice Job Level 10, as the Guildsman's check states
Gather the required Trunks: Fine-grained Trunk (item 1066), Solid Trunk (item 1067), Barren Trunk (item 1068), and Trunk (item 1019) with specific grades
Pass the total grade check of at least 25 out of 40
Be promoted to Archer and receive the Bow (item 1702) and Arrows (item 1750)
1004.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

1005.description: A quest to change your job to Mage. You must sign up for the Mage job application and pass the Mage Test by creating Mixed Solutions.
guide: Talk to Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124) to sign up for the Mage job application.
Make Mixed Solution No. 1 from the ingredients in the Guide Book, mix it in the machine in the center of the room, and bring it back to Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124).
1005.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1006.description: The Mage Guildsman helps the player become a Mage by explaining requirements and testing their skills with Mixed Solutions.
guide: Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124) explains the requirements for becoming a Mage and asks the player to sign up for the Mage application.
Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124) instructs the player to make Mixed Solution No. 2 from the Guide Book ingredients and bring it back.
Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124) confirms the player has passed the Mage test and completes the job change to Mage.
1006.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1007.description: A quest to change the player's job to Mage. The Mage Guildsman guides the player through requirements and tests to become a Mage.
guide: Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124): Instruct the player to reach Novice Job Level 10 and learn all Basic Skills before attempting the Mage Test.
Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124): Tell the player to make Mixed Solution No. 3 from the Guide Book ingredients and bring it back.
Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124): Confirm the player has passed the Mage Test and transform them into a Mage.
1007.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1008.description: A quest to change the player's job to Mage by passing a test and meeting job requirements.
guide: Mage Guildsman at the Mage Guild (geffen_in 164,124) tells the player they must reach Novice Job Level 9 and learn all Basic Skills before becoming a Mage.
Mage Guildsman (geffen_in 164,124) instructs the player to make Mixed Solution No. 4 from the Guide Book ingredients and bring it back.
After passing the Mage Test by creating the correct solution, the player is transformed into a Mage.
1008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1009.description: A job change to Merchant. The Merchant License Test has you deliver a package to one of four places, after a 1,000 zeny membership fee.
guide: Merchant (alberta_in 53,43) explains the Merchant License Test, gives a package serial number and sends you on one delivery route.
Get the delivery package from the storehouse and take it to the former Swordman's Association in Prontera.
Give the package to the Kafra Employee in Prontera (prontera 248,42), who is named Blossom.
Return to Merchant (alberta_in 53,43) to finish the test and become a Merchant.
1009.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1010.description: A job change to Merchant. The Merchant License Test has you deliver a package to one of four places, after a 1,000 zeny membership fee.
guide: Merchant (alberta_in 53,43) explains the Merchant License Test, gives a package serial number and sends you on one delivery route.
Get the delivery package from the storehouse and go to the Mage Guild in Geffen.
Give the package to the Mage Guildsman in charge at the Geffen Mage Guild.
Return to Merchant (alberta_in 53,43) to finish the test and become a Merchant.
1010.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1011.description: A job change to Merchant. The Merchant License Test has you deliver a package to one of four places, after a 1,000 zeny membership fee.
guide: Merchant (alberta_in 53,43) explains the Merchant License Test, gives a package serial number and sends you on one delivery route.
Get the delivery package from the storehouse and go to Morocc.
Give the package to Java Dullihan, the Dyemaker, or to one of his students (Student, morocc_in 140,102).
Return to Merchant (alberta_in 53,43) to finish the test and become a Merchant.
1011.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1012.description: A job change to Merchant. The Merchant License Test has you deliver a package to one of four places, after a 1,000 zeny membership fee.
guide: Merchant (alberta_in 53,43) explains the Merchant License Test, gives a package serial number and sends you on one delivery route.
Get the delivery package from the storehouse and give it to the Kafra Employee on Byalan Island, who is named Blossom.
Return to Merchant (alberta_in 53,43) to finish the test and become a Merchant.
1012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

1013.description: A quest to change the player's job to Thief, involving passing a mushroom collection test and completing the job change process.
guide: Thief Guide (moc_prydb1 39,129) - interviews the player and sets the mushroom test

Thief Guide (moc_prydb1 39,129) - tells the player to gather Orange Net Mushrooms (item 1069) and Orange Gooey Mushrooms (item 1070) from a farm; each Net Mushroom scores 3 points, each Gooey Mushroom 1 point, and 25 points pass
Comrade (moc_prydb1 42,133) - counts the mushrooms and, at 25 points or more, makes the player a Thief
1013.level_basis: Orange Net Mushroom (item 1069) is dropped by Thief Mushroom (level 1)

1014.description: A job change quest where the player can become a Swordman after meeting requirements.
guide: Swordman (izlude_in 74,172) - tells the player to learn all 9 Basic Skills and pass the Swordman Test before changing job
Swordman (izlude_in 74,172) - takes the job application and offers an interview straight away if the requirements are met
Swordman (izlude_in 74,172) - promotes the player to Swordman once the Basic Skills are learned and the test is passed
1014.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2000.description: Become a Blacksmith by completing the job application and passing tests with the guildsman.
guide: Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch - accepts a Merchant at Job Level 40 or higher and sends them to Geschupenschte
Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch - Geschupenschte gives a 10-question Merchant quiz; a score of 100 passes it
Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) - gives an order of items to deliver to a dealer in Geffen, Morocc, Lighthalzen, Payon or Hugel, then asks for the receipt
Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) - promotes the player to Blacksmith when the Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) is held at Job Level 40 or higher
2000.level_basis: Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) is dropped by Dokebi (level 33).

2001.description: Become a Blacksmith by completing the job with the Guildsman NPC.
guide: Talk to the Guildsman in Einbroch
Complete the job quest with the Guildsman
2001.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2002.description: The player must become a Blacksmith by completing a series of questions and delivering items to various NPCs in different locations.
guide: Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch - Geschupenschte hands out the order once the Merchant quiz is passed
Collect the items the order lists, bought from NPC shops (for example Steel, Rotten Bandage, Blue Gemstone and Arc Wand), and bring them back to the Guildsman
Deliver the package to the dealer named by the Guildsman: Baisulist in Geffen, Wickebine in Morocc, Krongast in Lighthalzen, Talpiz in Payon or Bismarc in Hugel
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), then return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch
2002.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2003.description: A Blacksmith job change quest in which the player brings the Guildsman's order items, takes the package to Baisulist in Geffen and returns with the receipt.
guide: Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch - gives the order for Steel, Rotten Bandage, Blue Gemstone and Arc Wand, bought from NPC shops
Bring the items back to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), who gives the package for Baisulist
Baisulist in Geffen (11 o'clock from the town center) - deliver the package and get the receipt
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), then return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch
2003.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2004.description: A Blacksmith job change quest in which the player brings Sparkling Dust, Skel Bone, Zargon and Gladius to the Guildsman and delivers the package to Wickebine in Morocc.
guide: Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch - gives the order for Sparkling Dust (2), Skel Bone, Zargon and Gladius, bought from NPC shops
Bring the items back to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), who gives the package for Wickebine
Wickebine in Morocc (the Swordmace dealer) - deliver the package and get the receipt
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), then return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch

Bring the items back to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), who gives the package for Krongast
Krongast in Lighthalzen (near the weapon shop, 6 o'clock from the town center) - deliver the package and get the receipt
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), then return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch
2005.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2006.description: A Blacksmith job change quest in which the player brings Iron Ore, Eye Bandage, Blue Gemstone and Arbalest to the Guildsman and delivers the package to Talpiz in Payon.

Bring the items back to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), who gives the package for Bismarc
Bismarc in Hugel (1 o'clock from the town center, near the airship) - deliver the package and get the receipt
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27), then return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch

2008.description: A Blacksmith job change quest in which the player delivers the Super Arc Wand package to Baisulist in Geffen and returns with the receipt.

Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch
Return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch, the next NPC in the job change

2009.description: A Blacksmith job change quest in which the player delivers the Super Gladius package to Wickebine in Morocc and returns with the receipt.
guide: Wickebine in Morocc (the Swordmace dealer) - deliver the Super Gladius package and get the receipt
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch
Return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch, the next NPC in the job change
2009.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2010.description: A Blacksmith job change quest in which the player delivers the Tsurugi package to Krongast in Lighthalzen and returns with the receipt.
guide: Krongast in Lighthalzen (near the weapon shop, 6 o'clock from the town center) - deliver the Tsurugi package and get the receipt
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch
Return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch, the next NPC in the job change

2011.description: A Blacksmith job change quest in which the player delivers the Arbalest package to Talpiz in Payon and returns with the receipt.
guide: Talpiz in Payon (5 o'clock from the town center) - deliver the Arbalest package and get the receipt
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch
Return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch, the next NPC in the job change
2011.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2012.description: A Blacksmith job change quest in which the player delivers the Ring Pommel Saber package to Bismarc in Hugel and returns with the receipt.
guide: Bismarc in Hugel (1 o'clock from the town center, near the airship) - deliver the Ring Pommel Saber package and get the receipt
Show the receipt to the Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch
Return to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch, the next NPC in the job change
2012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2013.description: A Blacksmith job change quest that begins after the player hands in the delivery receipt and goes back to Altiregen for the next test.
guide: Guildsman (ein_in01 201,27) in Einbroch - accepts the receipt and sends the player back to Altiregen
Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch - sends the player to the Blacksmith Guildsman (ein_in01 24,41) inside the building for the next test
2013.level_basis: The Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) is dropped by Dokebi (level 33) and Minorous (level 52).

2014.description: The player must change from the Merchant job class to the Blacksmith job class by passing a job test at the Blacksmith Guild.
guide: Mitehmaeeuh (Blacksmith Guildsman, ein_in01 24,41) in Einbroch - asks if the player is ready, then gives a five-question smithing test
Mitehmaeeuh (Blacksmith Guildsman, ein_in01 24,41) - a score above 70 passes and gives the Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) to take back to Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28)
2014.level_basis: The Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) is dropped by Dokebi (level 33) and Minorous (level 52).

2015.description: Change your job to Blacksmith by passing the job test and obtaining the Hammer of Blacksmith from the Blacksmith Guild.
guide: Mitehmaeeuh (Blacksmith Guildsman, ein_in01 24,41) - after the test, tells the player to take the Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) back to Altiregen
Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch - changes the player to Blacksmith while holding the Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005), at Job Level 40 or higher with no skill points left
2015.level_basis: Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) is dropped by Dokebi (level 33) and Minorous (level 52).

2016.description: The player must change to the Blacksmith job class by first becoming a Merchant and passing tests.
guide: Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) in Einbroch - changes the player to Blacksmith when the Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) is held at Job Level 40 or higher
Altiregen (ein_in01 18,28) - gives Steel as a gift once the job change is complete
2016.level_basis: The Hammer of Blacksmith (item 1005) is dropped by Dokebi (level 33) and Minorous (level 52).

2017.description: A quest to change from Thief to Rogue at the Rogue Guild.
guide: Markie (Rogue Guildsman, in_rogue 363,122) - gives the first test; a score above 80 passes and starts the quest
Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) - asks for the 10,000 zeny application fee and four items, chosen at random from three lists
Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) - takes the items and sends the player to the next NPC he names
2017.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2018.description: A quest to change job to Rogue, requiring the player to collect specific items and meet Mr. Smith at the Rogue guild.
guide: Visit Mr. Smith at the Rogue guild (in_rogue 376,23)
Bring 10,000 zeny, 10 Skel-bone, 6 Blue Herb, 10 Decayed Nail and 10 Horrendous Mouth to Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23)
2018.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2019.description: A quest to become a Rogue in the Rogue guild, requiring an application fee and collection of specific items.
guide: Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) asks for the 10,000 zeny application fee plus 10 Green Herb, 10 Crab Shell, 10 Snake Scale and 10 Garlet
Bring the fee and the four items to Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23), who takes them and says the next test is coming
On a later visit, Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) sends you at random to Aragham Junior (in_rogue 244,39), Antonio Junior (in_rogue 177,109) or Hollgrehenn Junior (in_rogue 160,34)
2019.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2020.description: A Rogue job change quest in which the player pays a 10,000 zeny application fee and brings 10 Yellow Herb, 10 Shell, 10 Grasshopper's Leg and 10 Bear's Footskin to Mr. Smith, who then sends the player to one of three Junior NPCs.
guide: Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) asks for the 10,000 zeny application fee plus 10 Yellow Herb, 10 Shell, 10 Grasshopper's Leg and 10 Bear's Footskin
Bring the fee and the four items to Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23), who takes them and says the next test is coming
On a later visit, Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) sends you at random to Aragham Junior (in_rogue 244,39), Antonio Junior (in_rogue 177,109) or Hollgrehenn Junior (in_rogue 160,34)
2020.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2021.description: A Rogue job change quest in which the player brings 10,000 zeny and five each of 17 listed items to Mr. Smith, then is sent to Hermanthorn Junior for a tunnel test.
guide: Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) asks for the 10,000 zeny application fee and five each of 17 items: Chrysalis, Empty Bottle, Iron Ore, Stone Heart, Red Herb, Animal Skin, Yellow Gemstone, Tooth of Bat, Scorpion Tail, Yoyo Tail, Monster's Feed, Fluff, Clover, Feather of Birds, Talon, Spawn and Raccoon Leaf
Bring the zeny and all 17 items to Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23), who takes them
Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) sends you to Hermanthorn Junior (in_rogue 272,135)
Hermanthorn Junior (in_rogue 272,135) sends you through the Underground Tunnel back to the Rogue Guild as the test
2021.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2022.description: A Rogue job change quest in which Mr. Smith sends the player to Aragham Junior, who leads the player through the Underground Tunnel back to the Rogue Guild for the test.
guide: Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) sends you to Aragham Junior, in the building South of the Sandarman Fortress (in_rogue 244,39)
Aragham Junior (in_rogue 244,39) explains the Rogue motto and asks if you are ready to go
If you say yes, Aragham Junior warps you to the Rogue Guild through the Underground Tunnel, where the test starts
2022.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2023.description: A Rogue job change quest in which Mr. Smith sends the player to Antonio Junior at Kokomo Beach, who leads the player through the Underground Tunnel back to the Rogue Guild for the test.
guide: Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) sends you to the building at Kokomo Beach on the way to Comodo, where Antonio Junior is (in_rogue 177,109)
Antonio Junior (in_rogue 177,109) explains the Rogue motto and tells you to walk back to the Rogue Guild through the Underground Tunnel
If you take the test, Antonio Junior warps you to the Rogue Guild, where the test starts
2023.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2024.description: A Rogue job change quest in which Mr. Smith sends the player to Hollgrehenn Junior, who sets a test through the Underground Tunnel back to the Rogue Guild.
guide: Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) sends you to Hollgrehenn Junior, in the field South of Sandarman Fortress on the way to Morocc
Hollgrehenn Junior (in_rogue 160,34) gives the test: walk back to the Rogue Guild through the Underground Tunnel
2024.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2025.description: A Rogue job change quest that starts after Mr. Smith takes the zeny and the 17 items, and sends the player to Hermanthorn Junior for the tunnel test.
guide: Mr. Smith (in_rogue 376,23) takes the 10,000 zeny and the 17 listed items, then sends you to Hermanthorn Junior
Hermanthorn Junior (in_rogue 272,135) gives a test requiring the player to go through the underground tunnel and return to the Rogue Guild
2025.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

2026.description: Change from Thief to Rogue (Quest 2026) - pass the job change test by completing the underground tunnel quest.
guide: Aragham Junior (in_rogue 244,39), Antonio Junior (in_rogue 177,109), Hollgrehenn Junior (in_rogue 160,34) or Hermanthorn Junior (in_rogue 272,135) sends you through the Underground Tunnel toward the Rogue Guild
Walk back to the Rogue Guild through the Underground Tunnel to finish the test
Return to Rogue Guildsman (in_rogue 363,122), Markie, who changes your job to Rogue once the test is passed
2026.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2027.description: The last step of the Thief to Rogue job change, where Markie, the Rogue Guildsman, changes the job and gives a Gladius after the tunnel test.
guide: Return to Rogue Guildsman (in_rogue 363,122), Markie, after the Underground Tunnel test
Markie changes your job from Thief to Rogue at Job Level 40 or higher and gives a Gladius (item 1219, or item 1220 at Job Level 50)
2027.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

Choose Start at Pierrot Pier (arug_que01 100,81) to begin the game; the 50 second time limit starts
Show the Glittering Paper (item 6031) to Pierrot Pier (arug_que01 100,81) before time runs out; the game ends in success
2143.level_basis: Set from the Hoe (item 6010) dropped by Kublin (level 85).

2144.description: The player helps Morestone find a mysterious area in the guild dungeon. Morestone collects rare gems and needs assistance to reach the mysterious area.

Show the Pickaxe (item 6010) to Morestone (arug_dun01 199,195), say your guild name, and choose Let's go; he takes you and your guild members to the mysterious area at arug_que01 103,133

Cherto gives you a note for the expert Mage Paje (brasilis 56,224), and the quest moves on

2196.description: A Toucan at bra_fild01 75,83 that is not affected by the magic talks to you and gives you its feather to bring to the guarana kid; the quest moves on when it blesses you and sends you away.

The Jaguar gives you fresh meat for the poor kid and sends you to the Monkey (bra_fild01 245,52); the quest moves on
2197.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2198.description: The Monkey at bra_fild01 245,52 hears that the guarana kid is lonely and gives you a branch of grapes to bring him; the quest moves on when you accept the errand.

The Monkey gives you a branch of grapes for the guarana kid, and the quest moves on

2199.description: The Strange Kid (brasilis 203,64) receives the feather, fresh meat and branch of grapes from you, and gives you a guarana berry (item 6237) in return; the quest moves on when he does.
guide: Talk to the Strange Kid (brasilis 203,64) and give him the feather, fresh meat and branch of grapes; he smiles and talks with you
Answer the kid when he says you can say anything; he gives you the Guarana Fruit (item 6237), and the quest moves on
2199.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2200.description: Candy Maker (brasilis 187,162) makes guarana candy from the Guarana Fruit (item 6237) you bring from the Strange Kid, and the quest completes when he gives you the Guarana Candy (item 12414).

Receive the Guarana Candy (item 12414) from Candy Maker (brasilis 187,162), and the quest is completed
2200.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

2203.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

Tell her you are looking for a brown fruit with a hard shell that holds juice and works as a cup; she says it is a coconut, found everywhere in Brasilis, and the quest moves on when you thank her

guide: Talk to the Wandering Bard (comodo 226,123), choose Could you sing for me, please and listen to Lalo's song

Answer the 10 questions; with 90 or 100 points, or 80 points on this retake, Gabriel sends you to meet Bliant Piyord at Prontera Castle, and the quest moves on
3012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3013.description: After Gabriel Valentine's knowledge test at prt_church 95,127, Bliant Piyord (Patron Knight_, no fixed position) explains the final battle test and asks for 1 Holy Water (item 523) to purify the candidate.
guide: Go to Prontera Castle and talk to Bliant Piyord (Patron Knight_, no fixed position); Gabriel Valentine (prt_church 95,127) has already sent you there after your test
Bliant Piyord says the battle test needs 1 Holy Water (item 523) to purify you before it, and the quest moves on as he explains it
3013.level_basis: No gate and no monster level apply. The item droppers listed below range from level 53 to 80, too wide to pick one level.

3014.description: Bliant Piyord starts the Crusader battle test when you have a Rosary (item 2608) equipped and 1 Holy Water (item 523), which he uses to purify you before you enter the waiting room.
guide: Talk to Bliant Piyord (Patron Knight_, no fixed position) with a Rosary (item 2608) equipped and choose I would like to begin; he uses 1 Holy Water (item 523) and warps you to the waiting room at job_cru 24,169
In the waiting room, defeat the Zombie, Soldier Skeleton, Archer Skeleton and Mummy summoned by Monster Summon (job_cru 2,1); the quest moves on after the 10th kill
3014.level_basis: Fixed by the Mummy (monster 1041, level 37) in the script.

3015.description: Michael Halig (Senior Crusader_, no fixed position) completes the Crusader job change once every test is finished and no skill points are left to spend.
guide: Talk to Michael Halig (Senior Crusader_, no fixed position) after the battle test; if you still have skill points he asks you to spend them first
With no skill points left, Michael Halig makes you a Crusader and gives you an item, and quest 3015 completes
3015.level_basis: Fixed by the Mummy monster (monster 1041, level 37) as stated in the quest facts

3016.description: Tohobu (Guarding Monk, prt_monk 59,247) sends an Acolyte who wants to become a monk to Sensei Moohae, and the quest moves on when Sensei Moohae gives the first training task.
guide: Talk to Tohobu (Guarding Monk, prt_monk 59,247), answer his name and job level, and choose I wish to become a monk; an Acolyte at Job Level 40 or higher is sent on to Sensei Moohae
Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) and answer Yes to become a monk; he gives you one of seven item tasks, and the quest moves on to that task
3016.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3017.description: Sensei Moohae gives the first monk task, 5 Sticky Mucus (item 938), 10 Earthworm Peeling (item 1055) and 20 Green Herb (item 511), and the quest moves on when you return them.
guide: Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) to receive the task of 5 Sticky Mucus (item 938), 10 Earthworm Peeling (item 1055) and 20 Green Herb (item 511)
Return the 5 Sticky Mucus, 10 Earthworm Peeling and 20 Green Herb to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58); he takes them and sends you to elder Touha in the north west, and the quest moves on
3017.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3018.description: Sensei Moohae gives the second monk task, 20 Yoyo Tail (item 942), 5 Iron Ore (item 1002) and 3 Blue Herb (item 510), and the quest moves on when you return them.
guide: Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) to receive the task of 20 Yoyo Tail (item 942), 5 Iron Ore (item 1002) and 3 Blue Herb (item 510)
Return the 20 Yoyo Tail, 5 Iron Ore and 3 Blue Herb to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58); he takes them and sends you to elder Touha in the north west, and the quest moves on
3018.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3019.description: Sensei Moohae gives the third monk task, 30 Stem (item 905), 5 Jellopy (item 909) and 10 Worm Peeling (item 955), and the quest moves on when you return them.
guide: Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) to receive the task of 30 Stem (item 905), 5 Jellopy (item 909) and 10 Worm Peeling (item 955)
Return the 30 Stem, 5 Jellopy and 10 Worm Peeling to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58); he takes them and says elder Touha in the north west will give the next step, and the quest moves on
3019.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3020.description: Sensei Moohae gives the fourth monk task, 5 Solid Shell (item 943), 20 Shell (item 935) and 5 Zargon (item 912), and the quest moves on when you return them.
guide: Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) to receive the task of 5 Solid Shell (item 943), 20 Shell (item 935) and 5 Zargon (item 912)
Return the 5 Solid Shell, 20 Shell and 5 Zargon to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58); he takes them and sends you to elder Touha in the north west, and the quest moves on
3020.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3021.description: Sensei Moohae gives the fifth monk task, 5 Cyfar (item 7053), 10 White Herb (item 509) and 10 Yellow Herb (item 508), and the quest moves on when you return them.
guide: Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) to receive the task of 5 Cyfar (item 7053), 10 White Herb (item 509) and 10 Yellow Herb (item 508)
Return the 5 Cyfar, 10 White Herb and 10 Yellow Herb to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58); he takes them and sends you to elder Touha in the north west, and the quest moves on
3021.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3022.description: Sensei Moohae gives the sixth monk task, 10 Tooth of Bat (item 913), 5 Bear's Footskin (item 948) and 20 Poison Spore (item 7033), and the quest moves on when you return them.
guide: Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) to receive the task of 10 Tooth of Bat (item 913), 5 Bear's Footskin (item 948) and 20 Poison Spore (item 7033)
Return the 10 Tooth of Bat, 5 Bear's Footskin and 20 Poison Spore to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58); he takes them and sends you to elder Touha in the north west, and the quest moves on
3022.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3023.description: Sensei Moohae gives the seventh monk task, 5 Porcupine Quill (item 1027), 20 Cobweb (item 1025) and 10 Bug Leg (item 1042), and the quest moves on when you return them.
guide: Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) to receive the task of 5 Porcupine Quill (item 1027), 20 Cobweb (item 1025) and 10 Bug Leg (item 1042)
Return the 5 Porcupine Quill, 20 Cobweb and 10 Bug Leg to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58); he takes them and sends you to elder Touha in the north west, and the quest moves on
3023.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3024.description: Touha (prt_monk 251,255) gives the first monk lesson after the item task, and the quest moves on when the player accepts the lesson by choosing Yes.
guide: Talk to Touha (prt_monk 251,255) after the item task is finished; he says he will tell you what a monk must know and help strengthen your body
Choose Yes when Touha says to relax your body and asks whether you are ready; he tells you to repeat after him, and the quest moves on
3024.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3025.description: Touha (prt_monk 251,255) teaches the monk chant, and each time the player picks the next line from a list; the excerpt does not show where quest 3025 ends.
guide: Talk to Touha (prt_monk 251,255) after the first lesson; he speaks a line of the chant and lets you pick the next line from a list
Keep choosing the lines Touha asks for until the chant ends; the excerpt does not show the step that completes quest 3025
3025.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3026.description: Touha (prt_monk 251,255) gives the second monk chant lesson, and Boohae (prt_monk 57,179) then sets the test choice that moves the quest on; the excerpt does not show how Touha's lesson ends.
guide: Talk to Touha (prt_monk 251,255) and take his chant lesson; the excerpt does not show how the lesson sets the next step
Talk to Boohae (prt_monk 57,179) and choose Gathering mushrooms or Marathon; the quest moves on to the test you choose
3026.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3027.description: A quest to become a Monk by completing the mushroom training tests overseen by Hyunmoo.
guide: Talk to Boohae (prt_monk 57,179) and choose Gathering mushrooms; he tells you to prepare and come back later
Talk to Hyunmoo (job_monk 225,180) and gather Orange Net Mushrooms (item 1069) and Orange Gooey Mushrooms (item 1070) in the building near the abbey; more than 29 of either one passes the test
Hyunmoo says you passed and sends you to meet Tomoon in the deepest room of the building near the abbey, and the quest moves on
3027.level_basis: Orange Net Mushroom (item 1069) and Orange Gooey Mushroom (item 1070) are dropped by Thief Mushroom (level 1).

3028.description: Boohae (prt_monk 57,179) sends the candidate to the marathon, where the Supervisor (monk_test 387,350) counts the laps, and the quest moves on when the last lap sends you to Tomoon.
guide: Talk to Boohae (prt_monk 57,179) and choose Marathon; he tells you to prepare and come back, and the quest starts
Go to the Apprentice Monk (monk_test 386,388) and choose Keep running; he tells you to run until you are told to stop
Run laps around the building and touch the Supervisor (monk_test 387,350) each lap; after the last lap he sends you to Tomoon and the quest moves on
3028.level_basis: Thief Mushroom (level 1) drops Orange Net Mushroom and Orange Gooey Mushroom items.

3029.description: A final test to become a monk where you must kill evil creatures and meet Tomoon in the deepest room of a building near the abbey.
guide: Talk to Tomoon (monk_test 319,139) in the deepest room of the building near the abbey; he tells you to terminate every living thing in your way
Tomoon warps you into the maze at monk_test 88,74 for the final spiritual test, and the quest moves on at that warp
3029.level_basis: Orange Net Mushroom (item 1069) and Orange Gooey Mushroom (item 1070) are dropped by Thief Mushroom (level 1).

3031.description: Tomoon (monk_test 319,139) gives the Green Potion (item 506) that the player must drink before becoming a monk, and the quest moves on when he hands it over.
guide: Talk to Tomoon (monk_test 319,139) and listen to his speech; he warps you into the maze at monk_test 88,74 to kill the evil creatures
Return to Tomoon (monk_test 319,139) after the maze; he gives you the Green Potion (item 506) and tells you to go back to Sensei Moohae, and the quest moves on
3031.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3032.description: Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) asks the Acolyte to keep the monk vows once the Green Potion (item 506) is used, and the job changes to Monk when the player makes the oath.
guide: Talk to Sensei Moohae (monk_in 99,58) with no Green Potion (item 506) left, and answer his vow questions
Choose I vow to keep these oaths; Sensei Moohae completes quest 3032, changes your job to Monk, and gives you a gift
3032.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3040.description: Reseal the evil Baphomet in the Sealed Shrine. The monk Friar Patrick guides you through the process, which requires a minimum level of 75 and a party leader to enter first.
guide: Talk to Friar Patrick (monk_test 309,146) and choose I want to enter; a party leader at BaseLevel 75 or higher is allowed in first
When the sign appears, touch the Grave of Baphomet (monk_test 306,151) with your party to move inside; quest 3040 starts and has a 43200 second time limit
3040.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel >= 75.

3041.description: The Curse of Baphomet is the Sealed Catacomb step where the party reactivates a Magical Seal by putting magical power into its altar, and the quest ends when Baphomet is defeated. Friar Patrick lets only a party leader at Base Level 75 or higher open the shrine.
guide: Talk to Friar Patrick (monk_test 309,146) and choose I want to enter; as a party leader at Base Level 75 or higher you open the shrine, and when the sign appears touch the Grave of Baphomet (monk_test 306,151) to move inside
Use a Magical Seal (2@cata 79,81 or 123,109, among others) to put magical power into the altar; the seal returns, but you cannot use magic for 3 minutes
Defeat the Baphomet that control_baphomet (2@cata 3,3) summons at 2@cata 79,64; its death erases quest 3041
Talk to Ancient Hero's Soul (2@cata 80,63) and choose Let me leave the shrine; he warps your group to monk_test 310,150
3041.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel >= 75.

3042.description: Friar Patrick sends the player holding the Cursed Baphomet Doll (item 6004) to Rust Blackhand, who offers to make the doll into a Gigantic Magestic Goat.
guide: Talk to Friar Patrick (monk_test 309,146) with the Cursed Baphomet Doll (item 6004) in your inventory and choose About the Cursed Baphomet Doll; he sends you to Rust Blackhand and quest 3042 starts
Talk to Rust Blackhand (prt_monk 261,91), near the main building of the monastery, and he offers to make the doll into a Gigantic Magestic Goat

Choose I want to make one! and Rust Blackhand lists the ingredients: Cursed Baphomet Doll (item 6004), Majestic Goat (item 2256), 30 Crystal of Darkness (item 7799), 50 Fragment of Darkness (item 7798) and 990000 Zeny; quest 3042 then moves on to 3043
3042.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel >= 75.

3043.description: Rust Blackhand at the monastery (prt_monk 261,91) turns the Cursed Baphomet Doll (item 6004), Majestic Goat (item 2256), 30 Crystal of Darkness (item 7799), 50 Fragment of Darkness (item 7798) and 990000 Zeny into a Gigantic Magestic Goat.
guide: Talk to Rust Blackhand (prt_monk 261,91) at the monastery with the ingredients ready; he asks whether you brought all of them

Hand over the Cursed Baphomet Doll (item 6004), Majestic Goat (item 2256), 30 Crystal of Darkness (item 7799), 50 Fragment of Darkness (item 7798) and 990000 Zeny; the excerpt says the Majestic Goat comes from the weak Baphomet in the Labyrinth Forest and the Crystal and Fragment of Darkness from the Incarnation of Morocc
Rust Blackhand takes the ingredients and gives you the Gigantic Magestic Goat (item 5374), and quest 3043 completes
3043.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3045.description: Quest 3045 is meant as the two-hour play limit for the Sealed Shrine, but its start check is commented out, so the excerpts only erase it when Baphomet's curse is lifted.
guide: Friar Patrick (monk_test 309,146) or Grave of Baphomet (monk_test 306,151) erases quest 3045 once the 12 hour cooldown of quest 3040 has passed and the curse weakens
The excerpts show no NPC step that starts quest 3045
3045.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel >= 75.

3050.description: Satan Morocc's resurrection has left the Continental Guard short of firewood, so the Continental Official sends volunteers at Base Level 80 or higher to Chief Balrog, who sets the first task of bringing back 30 Live Coals (item 7098).
guide: Talk to the Continental Official (no fixed position; morocc 176,103) and choose I'm here to volunteer; at Base Level 80 or higher he sends you to Chief Balrog in the center

Talk to Chief Balrog (morocc 159,113) and choose I want to join the Continental Guard; after Ask Again and You've just got to let me join! choose Give me a chance to prove myself! and No problem to accept the task of 30 Live Coals (item 7098)
3050.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79.

3051.description: Chief Balrog checks the 30 Live Coal (item 7098) brought in by the player and then gives the next task, 50 Glacial Hearts (item 7561), for the Schwarzwald mercenaries who struggle with the desert heat.
guide: Gather 30 Live Coal (item 7098), which Blazer or Fire Imp drop, then talk to Chief Balrog (morocc 159,113) and hand them over
Choose No problem. How many do you want? and Chief Balrog takes the 30 Live Coal; he then sends you to the Ice Cave to the north for 50 Glacial Hearts (item 7561)
3051.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79, setting recommended_level to 80

3052.description: Chief Balrog accepts 50 Glacial Hearts (item 7561) from the player, gives the Continental Guard Paper (item 7826), and welcomes the player into the Continental Guard.
guide: Talk to Chief Balrog (morocc 159,113) with 50 Glacial Hearts (item 7561); they drop from Siroma, Gazeti, Snowier or Ice Titan
Hand the 50 Glacial Hearts to Chief Balrog; he takes them, gives you the Continental Guard Paper (item 7826) and welcomes you to the Continental Guard, and the quest moves on
3052.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79, setting recommended_level to 80.

3053.description: Chief Balrog offers the new Continental Guard member a situational briefing on Satan Morocc, the time-space gaps in Sograt Desert and the doppelgangers.
guide: Talk to Chief Balrog (morocc 159,113) after joining; he asks whether you want a full situational briefing, and you choose Yes

Chief Balrog explains that the entrances to Morocc are under Continental Guard control and that Sograt Desert has gaps in time and space; for more information speak to the Continental Official (no fixed position; morocc 176,103)
3053.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 79.

3055.description: Chief Balrog accepts the Morocc Skin (item 7820) as proof that Satan Morocc was defeated, gives the player experience, and moves the quest on to the choice of reward.
guide: Talk to Chief Balrog (morocc 159,113) and say you defeated Satan Morocc; without the Morocc Skin (item 7820) he asks for proof and sends you back
Hand the Morocc Skin (item 7820) to Chief Balrog; he takes it, gives you experience and offers the Seal of Continental Guard, Morocc Charm Stone or Morocc Ring, and the quest moves on
3055.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79.

3056.description: Chief Balrog offers the player one of three rewards for defeating Satan Morocc: the Seal of Continental Guard (item 2730), the Morocc Charm Stone (item 2731) or the Morocc Ring (item 2732), and the quest is completed when one is taken.
guide: Talk to Chief Balrog (morocc 159,113) and choose one of the three rewards; the options are Seal of Continental Guard (MHP+50, +3% Attack Speed), Morocc Charm Stone (MSP+50, -1% Casting Speed) or Morocc Ring (CRI+5)
Choose Yes to confirm the reward; Chief Balrog gives it to you and quest 3056 completes
3056.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 79.

3060.description: Kid Karyn asks the player to find her little sister Curdie, whom she left with strange men at Thor Volcano, and the quest moves on once the player finds Curdie and promises to come back for her.
guide: Talk to Kid Karyn (veins 327,185) and choose Accept Request; she asks you to find her sister Curdie at Thor Volcano, and quest 3060 starts
Find Little Curdie (que_thor 36,66) lying unconscious at Thor Volcano, wake her and promise to find someone who can unlock her shackles; the quest moves on to 3061
3060.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3061.description: Little Curdie at Thor Volcano is locked in shackles that only someone with locksmith skills can open, so the player must ask Kid Karyn where to find a forge or locksmith in town.
guide: Talk to Little Curdie (que_thor 36,66) at Thor Volcano; she says someone in town must have the skill to unlock her shackles
Talk to Kid Karyn (veins 327,185) and ask where a forge or locksmith is; she says there is a locksmith in the market street, and the quest moves on to 3062
3061.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3062.description: The player must find the locksmith Mr. Lockenlock in the market street, and Toby (Young Town Native, veins 221,120) says he is always there and needs a Yellow Potion (item 503) to sober up.
guide: Talk to Toby (Young Town Native, veins 221,120) and ask where you can find a locksmith; he says Mr. Lockenlock sits in the market street
Toby says a Yellow Potion (item 503) will shock Mr. Lockenlock back to sobriety; the quest moves on to bringing him the potion
3062.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3063.description: Mr. Lockenlock, a drunkard in the market street, needs a Yellow Potion (item 503) before he will talk about making a key to free Curdie.
guide: Talk to Lockenlock (veins 181,166) in the market street; he is a drunkard, so follow Toby's advice and bring him a Yellow Potion (item 503) first
Hand over 1 Yellow Potion (item 503); Mr. Lockenlock sobers up enough to say he needs a bottle of Chamelepu Soap from the organic soap seller, and the quest moves on to 3064
3063.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3064.description: Mr. Lockenlock sends the player to Organic Soap Maker Ivory for a bottle of Chamelepu Soap to make a mold of the lock, and Ivory needs Milk (item 519), Green Herb (item 511), Jellopy (item 909) and Empty Bottle (item 713) first.
guide: Talk to Lockenlock (veins 181,166) again; he says you must find the lady selling organic soap in the market and get a bottle of Chamelepu Soap for a mold of the lock
Talk to Ivory (veins 227,127); she asks for 10 Milk (item 519), 100 Green Herb (item 511), 50 Jellopy (item 909) and 5 Empty Bottle (item 713), and the quest moves on to 3065
3064.level_basis: The item droppers range from level 3 to 50, too wide to pick one level.

3065.description: Organic Soap Maker Ivory needs Milk (item 519), Green Herb (item 511), Jellopy (item 909) and Empty Bottle (item 713) for her soap, and sends the player to Mr. Saraman once they are delivered.
guide: Bring Ivory (veins 227,127) at least 10 Milk (item 519), 100 Green Herb (item 511), 50 Jellopy (item 909) and 5 Empty Bottle (item 713); she checks the counts before the quest moves on
Ivory says to visit Mr. Saraman, the Silk Sand Camel farm owner, and show him the ingredients; the quest moves on to 3066
3065.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3066.description: The player goes to Mr. Saraman at the camel farm to get camel dung for the soap, and Saraman says his Silk Sand Camel will only eat an appetite stimulant made from the ingredients he lists.
guide: Talk to Saraman (veins 115,59) at the camel farm; he says the camel will not eat late in the day, so you need an appetite stimulant
Saraman lists the ingredients for the appetite stimulant: 1 Unripe Apple (item 619), 5 Monster's Feed (item 528), 1 Empty Bottle (item 713) and 1 Yellow Potion (item 503), and the quest moves on
3066.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3067.description: Mr. Saraman mixes Monster's Feed (item 528), Unripe Apple (item 619), Empty Bottle (item 713) and Yellow Potion (item 503) into an appetite stimulant for his camel, so she will pass camel dung for the soap.
guide: Bring 5 Monster's Feed (item 528), 1 Unripe Apple (item 619), 1 Empty Bottle (item 713) and 1 Yellow Potion (item 503) to Mr. Saraman (veins 115,59); he mixes them into an appetite stimulant
Saraman gives you the stimulant and says only his Silk Sand Camel will eat it, and that 5 lumps of camel dung should follow; the quest moves on to 3068
3067.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3068.description: Saraman sends the player with the appetite stimulant to the camel at veins 78,226, hoping it will eat and drop 5 lumps of camel dung, but the camel sniffs it and turns its nose away.
guide: Talk to Saraman (veins 115,59); he says the stimulant will make the camel eat, and the dung will flow after you get 5 lumps
Take the appetite stimulant to the camel at veins 78,226; it sniffs the stimulant and turns its nose away, and the quest moves on to 3069
3068.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3069.description: The camel at veins 78,226 refuses the stimulant, and Saraman says his Silk Sand Camel, Soony, has run away, so the player must go and find her.
guide: Talk to the Camel (veins 78,226) after the refusal; it turns its nose away again and is not the camel you are looking for
Talk to Saraman (veins 115,59); he says his worker forgot to tie up Soony and asks you to find her near the camel farm, and the quest moves on to the search
3069.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3070.description: Saraman's Silk Sand Camel, Soony, has run away, and the player must find her before any camel dung can be collected.
guide: Talk to Saraman (veins 115,59); he says Soony has run away and asks you to find her, since she moves slowly and should not be far from here
Find the Silk Sand Camel (ve_fild07 235,42) and talk to it; its leg is wounded, it nibbles the appetite stimulant, and the quest moves on to 3071
3070.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3071.description: The Silk Sand Camel is found, and the player must feed it Milk, Green Herb, Jellopy and Empty Bottle to get its first lump of camel dung.
guide: Talk to Silk Sand Camel (ve_fild07 235,42) after it has eaten the appetite stimulant; to feed it you need 2 Milk (item 519), 20 Green Herb (item 511), 10 Jellopy (item 909) and 1 Empty Bottle (item 713)
Feed the camel; when it produces a lump of steaming camel dung (not every feeding does), the quest moves on to 3072
3071.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3072.description: The player already has one lump of camel dung and must feed the Silk Sand Camel again to get the second lump.
guide: Talk to Silk Sand Camel (ve_fild07 235,42) and feed it 2 Milk (item 519), 20 Green Herb (item 511), 10 Jellopy (item 909) and 1 Empty Bottle (item 713)
When the camel produces another lump of steaming camel dung, the quest moves on to 3073
3072.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3073.description: The player has two lumps of camel dung and must feed the Silk Sand Camel again to get the third lump.
guide: Talk to Silk Sand Camel (ve_fild07 235,42) and feed it 2 Milk (item 519), 20 Green Herb (item 511), 10 Jellopy (item 909) and 1 Empty Bottle (item 713)
When the camel produces the third lump of steaming camel dung, the quest moves on to 3074
3073.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3074.description: The player has three lumps of camel dung and must feed the Silk Sand Camel again to get the fourth lump.
guide: Talk to Silk Sand Camel (ve_fild07 235,42) and feed it 2 Milk (item 519), 20 Green Herb (item 511), 10 Jellopy (item 909) and 1 Empty Bottle (item 713)
When the camel produces the fourth lump of steaming camel dung, the quest moves on to 3075
3074.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3075.description: The player has four lumps of camel dung and must feed the Silk Sand Camel once more to get the fifth lump.
guide: Talk to Silk Sand Camel (ve_fild07 235,42) and feed it 2 Milk (item 519), 20 Green Herb (item 511), 10 Jellopy (item 909) and 1 Empty Bottle (item 713)
When the camel produces the fifth lump of steaming camel dung, the quest moves on to 3076 with the instruction to return to Mr. Saraman
3075.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3076.description: The player brings the 5 lumps of camel dung and the news that Soony was found back to Saraman, who gives an Old Violet Box (item 617) as thanks.
guide: Talk to Saraman (veins 115,59) and tell him you found Soony at the outskirts of town; he thanks you and says he will send workers to bring her back
Saraman gives you an Old Violet Box (item 617), and the quest moves on to 3077 with the soap task
3076.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3077.description: Ms. Ivory takes the camel dung from the player and makes the Silk Sand Camel Soap, which Mr. Lockenlock needs for the key mold.
guide: Talk to Ms. Ivory (Organic Soap Maker Ivory, veins 227,127) and give her the camel dung; she says she does not want to handle it for much longer
Ivory mixes the ingredients into the Silk Sand Camel Soap without charging for her service, and the quest moves on to 3078 with the instruction to bring it to Mr. Lockenlock
3077.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3078.description: The player brings the Silk Sand Camel Soap to Mr. Lockenlock, who explains how to pour it into the lock, and the quest moves on to 3079 when the player agrees to bring the bottle back.
guide: Talk to Lockenlock (veins 181,166) with the Silk Sand Camel Soap; he asks whether Ms. Ivory told you how to use it
Lockenlock explains that you pour the soap into the keyhole and back into the bottle within 30 seconds, and the quest moves on to 3079 when you agree to bring the bottle back to him
3078.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3079.description: Use the Chamelpu Soap on the shackle lock of Little Curdie at Thor Volcano to make a key mold, then take it back to Lockenlock.
guide: Lockenlock (veins 181,166) explains that you must pour the Chamelpu Soap into the keyhole and back into the bottle within thirty seconds.
At Little Curdie (que_thor 36,66) in Thor Volcano, pour the soap into the shackle's lock to make the mold and wrap it carefully.
Bring the key mold back to Lockenlock (veins 181,166) in town.
3079.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3080.description: Take the key mold made from Little Curdie's shackles back to town so Lockenlock can make a key from it.
guide: Take the wrapped key mold from Little Curdie (que_thor 36,66) back to town.
Show the key mold to Lockenlock (veins 181,166), who says he needs 1 Steel (item 999) to make the key.
3080.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3081.description: Bring 1 Steel to Lockenlock so he can make the key that frees Little Curdie.
guide: Lockenlock (veins 181,166) says he needs 1 Steel (item 999) to make the key.
Bring 1 Steel (item 999) to Lockenlock (veins 181,166); he asks what the key is for.
Explain that you are freeing Little Curdie, and Lockenlock gives you the master key for her shackles.
3081.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3082.description: Take the master key from Lockenlock to Thor Volcano, unlock Little Curdie's shackles and send her back to town.
guide: Lockenlock (veins 181,166) gives you the master key and asks you to bring it to Thor Volcano to rescue Curdie.
Unlock the shackles of Little Curdie (que_thor 36,66) with the master key.
Send Little Curdie back to town with a Butterfly Wing, because she cannot move her legs.
3082.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3083.description: Tell Kid Karyn at veins 327,185 that his sister Curdie got home safely, which completes the quest.
guide: Little Curdie (que_thor 36,66) is freed and sent back to town with a Butterfly Wing.
Tell Kid Karyn (veins 327,185) that you sent Curdie home; he thanks you and promises to tell his dad about your help.
3083.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3085.description: Commander Hibba Agip sends you to Staff Officer Abidal for a private talk, which begins the expedition report mission.
guide: Talk to Hibba Agip at mid_campin 90,121; Instructor Igrid tells you to go speak to Staff Officer Abidal.
Staff Officer Abidal (mid_campin 94,118) asks to talk with you privately.
3085.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3086.description: Deliver the Expedition Report to three national leaders of Midgard
guide: Hibba Agip - deliver the Expedition Report (item 11012) to Minister Laur of the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom, Priest Nuria of Arunafeltz, and Gerhart of the Schwatzvalt Republic
Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121) says a messenger waits at the time-space gap to Midgard to tell the officials of your arrival.
3086.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3087.description: Carry the Expedition Report to Minister Laur, Priest Nuria, and Gerhart, the officials of three Midgard countries.
guide: Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121) gives you the Expedition Report (item 11012).
Hibba Agip - deliver the expedition report to Minister Laur, Priest Nuria, and Gerhart
3087.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3088.description: The expedition report has been lost, and Hibba Agip orders you to search for its pages.
guide: Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121) says the report was lost and orders you to search everywhere for its pages.
Hibba Agip warns that monsters may have consumed some pages, or that they may have drifted to the sea.
Bring as many pages as you can to Staff Officer Abidal (mid_campin 94,118), who will fill in the missing parts.
3088.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3089.description: Search for the pages of the lost expedition report so that Staff Officer Abidal can bind them back into the full report.
guide: Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121) orders you to search everywhere for the pages of the lost expedition report.
Hibba Agip warns that monsters may have consumed some pages, or that they may have drifted to the sea.
Bring the pages you find to Staff Officer Abidal (mid_campin 94,118), who binds them into the full report.
3089.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3090.description: Bring Parts of a Report to Staff Officer Abidal in groups of ten so he can restore the four volumes of the expedition report.
guide: Staff Officer Abidal (mid_campin 94,118) asks you to find the lost pages of the expedition report.
Bring Part of a Report (item 6040) to Staff Officer Abidal (mid_campin 94,118) in increments of 10 to restore volumes 11013-11016.
When all four volumes are restored, Abidal binds them into the Expedition Report (item 11012).
Bring the Expedition Report (item 11012) to Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121).
3090.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3091.description: Deliver the expedition report to the three countries of Midgard. The player must find lost report pages and restore the report volumes before completing the mission.
guide: Staff Officer Abidal (mid_campin 94,118) offers the mission to deliver the expedition report to the three countries of Midgard.
Find Part of a Report (item 6040) and bring it to Abidal (mid_campin 94,118) in increments of 10.
Abidal restores the report volumes 11013-11016 from the pages you bring.
When all four volumes are restored, Abidal binds them into the Expedition Report (item 11012).
3091.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3092.description: Hand the restored Expedition Report to Commander Hibba Agip, who checks it and gives you three copies to deliver.
guide: Bring the restored Expedition Report (item 11012) to Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121).
Hibba Agip takes the restored report and gives you three copies to deliver.
Hibba Agip reminds you that Minister Laur, Priest Nuria, and Gerhart are the officials to receive them.
3092.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3093.description: Deliver the expedition report to the national leaders of three Midgard countries.
guide: Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121) hands you three Expedition Reports (item 11012) to deliver to the Midgard officials.
Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121) reminds the player of the three officials: Minister Laur of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, Priest Nuria of Arunafeltz, and Gerhart of the Schwarzwald Republic.
3093.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3094.description: Report back to Commander Hibba Agip after delivering the expedition reports, which completes the expedition mission.
guide: Hibba Agip (mid_campin 90,121) asks whether you delivered the report to all three national leaders and thanks you.
Hibba Agip warns that the strange events are not over and asks you to come back to help once the mastermind is found.
Hibba Agip gives you experience and three First Aid Kits (item 12110) as a reward.
3094.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3100.description: Muff, who borrowed money from the loan shark Belder, asks you to look for the wallet that holds the bond of debt.
guide: Muff (comodo 224,187) says he borrowed money from the loan shark Belder and then lost his bond of debt.
Muff says he lost his wallet with the bond of debt after a drink, probably on the way home through the Papuchicha Forest.
Muff asks you to find the wallet so he can get his collateral back from Belder.
3100.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 60.

3101.description: The player must investigate a strange heap of earth and decide whether to dig up the spot or give up.
guide: Heap of Earth (cmd_fild01 55,160) shows a hole that someone dug and covered again; choose Dig Up the Spot.
Dig again after the first attempt to recover the soggy wallet, which holds the bond of debt.
Bring the soggy wallet back to Muff (comodo 224,187).
3101.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3102.description: The recovered bond of debt is too ruined to read, so Muff asks you to take it to Inventor Dorian in Izlude to restore it.
guide: Muff (comodo 224,187) confirms the wet, tattered paper is the bond of debt and says it is too ruined to read.
Muff says Inventor Dorian (izlude_in 110,64) in Izlude may restore the paper with his Magic Dryer.
Accept Muff's request and ask Inventor Dorian in Izlude to restore the bond of debt.
3102.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 60.

3103.description: Inventor Dorian in Izlude agrees to restore Muff's bond of debt if you can explain how his Mystic Dryer de Elegance works, then asks you to fix it.
guide: Dorian (izlude_in 110,64) explains the Mystic Dryer de Elegance, then asks you to name the main theory it works by.
Dorian says the ruby engine is broken and asks you to help fix it so the dryer can restore the bond of debt.
Dorian (izlude_in 110,64) asks you to gather 20 Rusty Screws, 10 Iron Ores, 5 Steel, 2 Rubies, and 10 Red Gemstones.
3103.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 60.

3104.description: Gather the repair materials Dorian asks for to fix his Mystic Dryer de Elegance: Rusty Screws, Iron Ores, Steel, Rubies, and Red Gemstones.
guide: Talk to Dorian at izlude_in 110,64 to begin the repair task.
Gather Rusty Screw (item 7317), Iron Ore (item 1002), Steel (item 999), Ruby (item 723), and Red Gemstone (item 716) as required.
Bring all the materials back to Dorian (izlude_in 110,64), who then explains how to repair the Mystic Dryer de Elegance.
3104.level_basis: Zombie Master (level 62) drops Ruby (item 723), which is required for the repair.

3105.description: Repair the Mystic Dryer de Elegance by replacing its ruby engine, tightening the screw and pressing the four switches.
guide: At the Mystic Dryer de Elegance (no fixed position), replace the ruby in the engine with a new rough ruby.
Tighten the screw on the joint until you hear a click; tightening further breaks it and sends you back to Dorian (izlude_in 110,64).
Press the Red, Blue, Yellow and Green switches, one for each gear; a wrong switch makes the repair fail and sends you back to Dorian (izlude_in 110,64).
3105.level_basis: Ruby (item 723) is dropped by Zombie Master (level 62), which sets the level at 62.

3106.description: The repair of the Mystic Dryer de Elegance failed, so Dorian asks you to return and try again.
guide: Return to Dorian (izlude_in 110,64) after the repair failed, which happens when the screw breaks the joint or a wrong switch is pressed.
Dorian (izlude_in 110,64) says the machine is not made for ordinary users and asks you to try the repair again.
3106.level_basis: Ruby (item 723) is dropped by Zombie Master (level 62)

3107.description: The Mystic Dryer de Elegance is repaired, so you report to Dorian and get ready to restore the damaged document.
guide: Tell Dorian (izlude_in 110,64) that the Mystic Dryer de Elegance is running, so he can verify it and let you use it.
Dorian (izlude_in 110,64) congratulates you and asks you to insert the damaged document into the machine and press the switch.
3107.level_basis: The level 79 is from the Baroness of Retribution (level 79) who drops Ruby (item 723).

3108.description: Insert Muff's wet bond of debt into the Mystic Dryer de Elegance and press the switch to restore it.
guide: Dorian (izlude_in 110,64) asks you to insert the damaged document into the Mystic Dryer de Elegance and press the switch.
At the Mystic Dryer de Elegance (no fixed position), insert the wet bond of debt; when the heater stops, the restored Debt Note (item 7722) is yours.
3108.level_basis: Ruby (item 723) is dropped by Zombie Master (level 62)

3109.description: Take the restored bond of debt, the Debt Note (item 7722), back to Muff (comodo 224,187) so he can reclaim his collateral from Belder.
guide: Muff (comodo 224,187) asks how the Magic Dryer went and takes the Debt Note (item 7722) from you.
Muff (comodo 224,187) gives you an Old Blue Box (item 603) and four Seeds of Yggdrasil (item 608) as a reward for your help.
If you no longer have the Debt Note, Muff sends you back to Dorian (izlude_in 110,64).
3109.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 60.

3110.description: Ibrahim hires the player to track down the stolen Diamond of Destruction. The quest involves investigating the Four Cursed Jewels and finding where the diamond went.
guide: Ibrahim (moc_ruins 152,147) hires you to find where his Diamond of Destruction went after it was stolen.
Visit the jewelers Jhonnita in Alberta, Kimeunbang in Payon, and Leblo (geffen 128,153), and ask about the diamond without saying that Ibrahim hired you.
3110.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 65.

3111.description: Help Leblo obtain medicine from Doctor Wola in Payon to cure his pain.
guide: Leblo (geffen 128,153) asks you to get his back medicine from Doctor Wola in Payon, who refuses to examine him after he insulted her.
Find Doctor Wola (payon_in03 167,149) in Payon and try to make her happy, since she is the one who can give you Leblo's medicine.
Doctor Wola (payon_in03 167,149) says you made her drop her herbal medicine pot and asks you to bring 20 Fine Sands, 5 Empty Bottles, 10 Brigans and 10 Soft Blades of Grass to fix it.
3111.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3112.description: Help Doctor Wola fix her broken herbal medicine pot by bringing her the required items and waiting while she repairs it.
guide: Bring 20 Fine Sands (item 7043), 5 Empty Bottles (item 713), 10 Brigans (item 7054) and 10 Soft Blades of Grass (item 7194) to Doctor Wola (payon_in03 167,149).
Wola (payon_in03 167,149) grinds and mixes the items, then asks you to sit in the corner and wait until she says she is done.
Wola (payon_in03 167,149) says the pot is fixed and asks what you came for.
3112.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3113.description: Doctor Wola has fixed her pot and says she will send Leblo's medicine once she double-checks it.
guide: Ask Wola (payon_in03 167,149) about Leblo's back medicine, since she forgot what you came for.
Wola (payon_in03 167,149) says she already prepared the medicine, will double-check it, and will have it delivered to Leblo (geffen 128,153) shortly.
Wola (payon_in03 167,149) asks you to tell Leblo (geffen 128,153) that she is taking care of him.
3113.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3114.description: Deliver Doctor Wola's medicine to Leblo, who then tells you the Z Gang has the Diamond of Destruction.
guide: Leblo (geffen 128,153) thanks you for the medicine and says he misjudged Wola.
Leblo (geffen 128,153) says a young couple tried to sell him the Diamond of Destruction, and they looked like members of the Z Gang.
Leblo (geffen 128,153) tells you to talk with an investigator of the Rogue Guild to learn more about the Z Gang.
3114.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3115.description: Leblo reveals that the Z Gang has the Diamond of Destruction and sends you to a Rogue Guild investigator for more information.
guide: Leblo (geffen 128,153) says a young couple tried to sell him the Diamond of Destruction, and they looked like members of the Z Gang.
Leblo (geffen 128,153) tells you to talk with a Rogue Guild investigator, such as the Rogue Investigator (in_rogue 366,46), to learn more about the Z Gang.
3115.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3116.description: The Rogue Investigator (in_rogue 366,46) reveals that the Z Gang's hideout is a large warehouse in Comodo, where the search continues.
guide: Ask the Rogue Investigator (in_rogue 366,46) where the Z Gang hideout is; a non-Rogue must pay him a 10,000 zeny bribe to learn it.
Go to the Z Gang's old hideout, a large warehouse in Comodo, and look at the Small Safe (cmd_in02 69,188), which reveals a hidden switch.
Press the tiny switch at Odd Switch (cmd_in02 80,189) under the boxes to advance the quest.
3116.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3117.description: With the tiny switch pressed, the Small Safe at cmd_in02 69,188 opens and holds the Diamond of Destruction (item 7723).
guide: Open the Small Safe (cmd_in02 69,188), which now opens because the switches were pressed.
Take the Diamond of Destruction (item 7723) from the safe while the Investigator (cmd_in02 94,208) sleeps nearby.
Sneak out of the hideout and plan to return the diamond to Ibrahim (moc_ruins 152,147).
3117.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3118.description: Return the recovered Diamond of Destruction (item 7723) to Ibrahim (moc_ruins 152,147), which completes the search for the stolen jewel.
guide: Give the Diamond of Destruction (item 7723) to Ibrahim (moc_ruins 152,147), who is relieved to have it back.
Ibrahim (moc_ruins 152,147) gives you 2 Crystal Jewels (item 732) and an Old Blue Box (item 603) as payment.
Ibrahim (moc_ruins 152,147) says he will research the diamond and contact you if he needs your help again.
3118.level_basis: The level 66 comes from the script gate (treasure_nd > 10) && (BaseLevel > 65) in Ibrahim's script.

3119.description: A National Wanted Notice lists the Z Gang as criminals to capture, and the Chief Officer then names the three members.
guide: Read the National Wanted Notice at prontera 150,326, which lists the Z Gang criminals and offers the Book of Forbidden Mystery as the reward.
Chief Officer (prontera 148,326) names Louis Von Silokens, Martha Hertizan and Catfoii as the three members, and says Catfoii must be captured.
Chief Officer (prontera 148,326) tells players below Base Level 70 that they are not ready and should train first.
3119.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 70.

3120.description: The Chief Officer tells you about the Z Gang members and their crimes, and points you to the knight Valdes for more information.
guide: Ask Chief Officer (prontera 148,326) about Louis, Martha, Catfoii, and the Book of Forbidden Mystery.
Chief Officer (prontera 148,326) says the Z Gang stole the Book of Forbidden Mystery from the Royal Library, the greatest danger of all their crimes.
Talk to Valdes (prt_in 168,18), who asks you to bring 5 bottles of Morocc Fruit Wine (item 12049) before he will tell you more about the Z Gang.
3120.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 70 to start the quest.

3121.description: Valdes will share what he knows about the Z Gang only after you bring him 5 bottles of Morocc Fruit Wine (item 12049).
guide: Give Valdes (prt_in 168,18) the 5 bottles of Morocc Fruit Wine (item 12049) he asked for.
Valdes (prt_in 168,18) says the Z Gang has repeatedly eluded the Rogue Guild, and that he was dismissed after his own failed investigation.
Valdes (prt_in 168,18) sends you to the Rogue agent Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) and gives you the password, 'The dawn is yet to come.'
3121.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3122.description: Give Marybell the password from Valdes, and she sends you to Moonho Ahn in Payon to prove you can be trusted.
guide: Talk to Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) and give her the password 'The dawn is yet to come.'
Ask Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) about the Z Gang, and she sends you to Payon to find Moonho Ahn, the White Meteor.
Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) says she will only trust you if you beat Moonho Ahn at gambling.
3122.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3123.description: Challenge Moonho Ahn, the retired White Meteor, in Payon; he explains the rules of Coin Shake and asks you to return once he is ready.
guide: Talk to Moonho Ahn (payon 244,62) and choose 'I'm here to challenge you.'
Moonho Ahn (payon 244,62) explains Coin Shake: a best 2 out of 3 guessing game of Odd or Even, with a 500 zeny participation fee.
Moonho Ahn (payon 244,62) asks you to come back when he has prepared the game.
3123.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3124.description: Play Coin Shake against Moonho Ahn in Payon for 500 zeny, and win the match to become the new White Meteor.
guide: Pay the 500 zeny fee and choose 'Yes, let's play!' with Moonho Ahn (payon 244,62).
Take turns with Moonho Ahn (payon 244,62) as coin shaker and guesser, calling Odd or Even, until one side wins the match.
If you win, Moonho Ahn (payon 244,62) marks your wrist with the sign of the White Meteor and passes the title to you.
3124.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3125.description: Tell Marybell you beat Moonho Ahn, then ask her about the Z Gang's goals, recent movements and stronghold.
guide: Report to Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) that you beat Moonho Ahn, and she checks the signature on your arm as the White Meteor's.
Ask Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) about the Z Gang's goal, recent movements and stronghold.
After you ask about all three, Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) says the Z Gang is recruiting in Morocc and sends you there.
3125.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3126.description: In Morocc, a Suspicious Man attacks you and drops a note ordering the Z Gang to kill you.
guide: Talk to the Suspicious Man (moc_ruins 90,67), who calls you a pursuer and attacks before he runs away.
The Suspicious Man (moc_ruins 90,67) drops a note that orders the Z Gang to kill you.
3126.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3127.description: Catch the Z Gang informer who dropped the note in Morocc and make him talk about the Z Gang's hideout.
guide: Talk to the Suspicious Man (moc_ruins 90,67) to confront him as a Z Gang informer.
Press the Z Gang Informer (moc_ruins 90,67) to confess, and he says the Z Gang's hideout is in South Morocc and needs a secret password.
Head back to Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) to tell her what the informer said.
3127.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3128.description: Marybell shows you an envelope found on a Z Gang informer and sends you to the decoder Gooho Ahn in Payon.
guide: Talk to Marybell (in_rogue 359,116), who says a Rogue dispatched to Comodo found an envelope on a Z Gang informer.
Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) says the paper is written in invisible ink and sends you to Gooho Ahn (payon 192,176), a decoder in Payon.
Ask Gooho Ahn (payon 192,176) whether he has finished decoding the letter.
3128.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3129.description: Decode a strange letter from the Z Gang and deliver it to Marybell.
guide: Talk to Gooho Ahn (payon 192,176), who is struggling to decrypt the Z Gang's letter.
Gooho Ahn (payon 192,176) asks you to gather 20 Live Coals (item 7098), 1 Matchstick (item 7035), 2 Alcohol (item 970), and 10 Burning Hearts (item 7097) to measure the light and heat he needs.
3129.level_basis: The item droppers listed range from level 1 to 91, too wide to pick one level.

3130.description: Bring the Live Coals, Matchstick, Alcohol and Burning Hearts to Gooho Ahn, who decrypts the Z Gang's letter and gives you its message.
guide: Bring 20 Live Coals (item 7098), 1 Matchstick (item 7035), 2 Alcohol (item 970), and 10 Burning Hearts (item 7097) to Gooho Ahn (payon 192,176).
Gooho Ahn (payon 192,176) identifies the letter as ancient Aegye and dictates the message to you.
Deliver the message exactly as Gooho Ahn (payon 192,176) dictated it to Marybell (in_rogue 359,116).
3130.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

3131.description: Marybell reads the decoded message, which reveals the Z Gang's hideout near the secret path to the South Morocc underground.
guide: Deliver the decoded message to Marybell (in_rogue 359,116), who says it reveals the location of the Z Gang's hideout.
