Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) says the hideout is near the secret path to the South Morocc underground, and the Rogue Guild cannot take you along.
Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) says you will each hunt the Z Gang separately, and whoever finds them first gets to beat them up.
3131.level_basis: The item droppers listed range from level 1 to 91, too wide to pick one level.

3132.description: Speak the decoded phrases to the Odd Slab at moc_fild17 209,235, which opens the way into the Z Gang's hideout.
guide: Ask Marybell (in_rogue 359,116) where the hideout is, and she says it is near the secret path to the South Morocc underground.
Talk to the Odd Slab (moc_fild17 209,235) and speak the Aegye phrases from the letter in order.
Once you speak the last phrase, the Odd Slab (moc_fild17 209,235) pulls you into the Z Gang's hideout.
3132.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3133.description: Inside the Z Gang's hideout, Louis, Martha and Catfoii surrender after you confront them and hand over the Forbidden Secret Art (item 7724).
guide: Talk to Louis (z_agit 97,101) in the hideout, where the Z Gang blames each other for the failed invisibility.
Confront the Z Gang in the hideout; after they surrender, Louis (z_agit 97,101) gives up the book.
Once they surrender, you receive the Forbidden Secret Art (item 7724) and are sent back to the Odd Slab (moc_fild17 209,235).
3133.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3134.description: Return the Forbidden Secret Art (item 7724) to the Chief Officer in Prontera, who gives you the kingdom's reward and completes the Z Gang Wanted quest.
guide: Return to Chief Officer (prontera 148,326) with the Forbidden Secret Art (item 7724), which the Chief Officer takes from you.
Chief Officer (prontera 148,326) thanks you on behalf of the king and gives you a reward and experience.
3134.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 70, so recommended_level is 71.

3135.description: Enter Nidhoggur's Nest with your party through the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper, which starts a three-day timer before the nest can be entered again.
guide: Talk to the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 100,201) with at least one other servant in your party; only the party leader can request admission.
Enter the nest through the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 100,201), which sets the three-day timer on Nidhoggur's Nest.
Defeat Nidhoggur's Shadow; the World Tree Yggdrasil (2@nyd 202,324) thanks you, asks you to report to those in charge of Splendide and Manuk, and escorts you out.
Afterwards the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 100,201) says at least three days are needed for the World Tree to stabilize before you can enter again.
3135.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

3136.description: Nidhoggur's Nest Time Limit is a four-hour timer that starts when your party enters the nest; when it runs out, the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper refuses re-entry until the World Tree stabilizes.
guide: Enter Nidhoggur's Nest through the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 100,201) with at least one other servant in your party, which starts the four-hour timer.
If the four-hour limit has expired, the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 100,201) says you must wait for the World Tree to stabilize before trying again.
Once the World Tree has stabilized, the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper (nyd_dun02 100,201) clears both records and lets you register to enter again.
3136.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4000.description: Answer Hunter Sherin's interview questions about hunting and etiquette; a score of 90 or 100 passes you on to the job change test.
guide: Talk to Hunter Guildsman (hu_in01 386,373) as an Archer at Job Level 40 or higher and choose 'Yes. That's what I'm here for.'
Hunter Guildsman (hu_in01 386,373), speaking as Hunter Sherin, starts the interview with scenario questions about hunting, travel, Zeny and selling items.
Choose an answer to each scenario; a score of 90 or 100 passes the interview.
Hunter Guildsman (hu_in01 386,373) moves you on to the job change test if you pass; otherwise you must come back and retake the interview.
4000.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

4001.description: Register with the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who is called the Demon Hunter, and receive the list of materials for your Hunter test.
guide: Talk to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) after passing Hunter Sherin's interview, and confirm your name when asked.
If you deny your name twice, the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) warps you to Hugel (hugel 208,223).
The Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) gives you one random list of three materials for the test, which becomes your next stage.
Bring the listed materials back to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) when you have everything ready.
4001.level_basis: No gate and no monster level apply. The item droppers listed below range from level 31 to 79, too wide to pick one level.

4002.description: Bring 5 Claw of Desert Wolf (item 7030), 5 Wooden Block (item 1019) and 3 White Herb (item 509) to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) for the Hunter test.
guide: Gather 5 Claw of Desert Wolf (item 7030), 5 Wooden Block (item 1019) and 3 White Herb (item 509), the list the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) gave you.
Bring the three items to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who checks them against the list.
The Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), speaking as the Demon Hunter, then sends you to the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace for directions to the testing area.
4002.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4003.description: Bring 3 Bill of Birds (item 925), 5 Skel Bone (item 932) and 3 Green Herb (item 511) to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) for the Hunter test.
guide: Gather 3 Bill of Birds (item 925), 5 Skel Bone (item 932) and 3 Green Herb (item 511), the list the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) gave you.
Bring the three items to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who checks them against the list.
The Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), speaking as the Demon Hunter, then sends you to the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace for directions to the testing area.
4003.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4004.description: Bring 3 Poisonous Canine (item 937), 3 Animal's Skin (item 919) and 5 Red Herb (item 507) to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) for the Hunter test.
guide: Gather 3 Poisonous Canine (item 937), 3 Animal's Skin (item 919) and 5 Red Herb (item 507), the list the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) gave you.
Bring the items to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who checks them against the list.
The Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) then sends you to the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace for directions to the testing area.
4004.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4005.description: Bring 3 Dokkaebi Horn (item 1021), 3 Poison Spore (item 7032) and 10 Fluff (item 914) to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) for the Hunter test.
guide: Gather 3 Dokkaebi Horn (item 1021), 3 Poison Spore (item 7032) and 10 Fluff (item 914), the list the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) gave you.
Bring the items to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who checks them against the list.
The Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) then sends you to the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace for directions to the testing area.
4005.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4006.description: Bring 9 Shell (item 935), 9 Worm Peelings (item 955) and 9 Yellow Herb (item 508) to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) for the Hunter test.
guide: Gather 9 Shell (item 935), 9 Worm Peelings (item 955) and 9 Yellow Herb (item 508), the list the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) gave you.
Bring the items to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who checks them against the list.
The Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) then sends you to the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace for directions to the testing area.
4006.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4007.description: Bring 3 Tooth of Bat (item 913), 1 Sticky Mucus (item 938) and 1 Bear's Foot (item 948) to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) for the Hunter test.
guide: Gather 3 Tooth of Bat (item 913), 1 Sticky Mucus (item 938) and 1 Bear's Foot (item 948), the list the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) gave you.
Bring the items to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who checks them against the list.
The Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) then sends you to the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace for directions to the testing area.
4007.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4008.description: Bring 2 Porcupine Spike (item 1027), 1 Yoyo Tail (item 942) and 1 Acorn (item 1026) to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) for the Hunter test.
guide: Gather 2 Porcupine Spike (item 1027), 1 Yoyo Tail (item 942) and 1 Acorn (item 1026), the list the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) gave you.
Bring the items to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who checks them against the list.
The Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382) then sends you to the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace for directions to the testing area.
4008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4009.description: Hear the Hunter Guildmaster's explanation of the job test at payon_in03 131,7, then begin the test and receive 200 Silver Arrows (item 1751).
guide: Talk to the Hunter Guildmaster (payon_in03 131,7) and ask what the test is, what passing requires, or what the warnings are.
The test is to hunt monsters with a particular name while avoiding traps; you start at the 6 o'clock direction and pass by escaping at the 12 o'clock direction after hitting the central switch.
Falling into a trap means starting over, and only one person can take the test at a time, so you wait in the chatroom if someone else is inside.
Choose 'Begin test.' and the Hunter Guildmaster (payon_in03 131,7) gives you 200 Silver Arrows (item 1751) and sends you to the test area.
4009.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4010.description: After your materials are accepted, the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace directs you to the Hunter job test and sends you to the test area.
guide: Hand in your materials to the Guild Receptionist (hu_in01 382,382), who sends you to the Guildmaster in Payon Central Palace for directions to the testing area.
The Hunter at payon_in02 21,31 explains the test, gives you 200 Silver Arrows (item 1751) when you begin, and sends you to the test area (job_hunte 176,22).
4010.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4011.description: Take the Hunter job test by hunting the target monsters while avoiding traps, then hit the central escape switch and leave on the 12 o'clock side of the map.
guide: The Hunter Guildmaster (payon_in03 131,7) gives you 200 Silver Arrows (item 1751) when you begin, and warps you to the test area (job_hunte 176,22).
Hunt the target monsters while avoiding traps; falling into a trap sends you back to the start of the test.
Hit the escape switch in the center of the map, then escape on the 12 o'clock side of the map to pass.
If someone else is taking the test, wait in the Waiting Room (job_hunte 178,38) until the person in front succeeds, resigns or fails.
4011.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4012.description: After leaving the Hunter test area alive, return to the Hunter Guildmaster to receive the Penetration (item 1007) that proves you passed.
guide: Walk into the exit at job_hunte 89,139 after the test; it sends you back to Payon at payon_in02 21,27 or payon_in03 128,7.
Return to the Hunter Guildmaster (payon_in03 131,7 or payon_in02 21,31), who says you came back in one piece and gives you Penetration (item 1007).
The Hunter Guildmaster then tells you to go back to the Hunter Guild (hu_in01 386,373).
4012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4013.description: Give the Penetration (item 1007) to Hunter Sherin at the Hunter Guild (hu_in01 386,373) to change your job to Hunter and receive a reward.
guide: Talk to the Hunter Guildsman (hu_in01 386,373), speaking as Hunter Sherin, with the Penetration (item 1007) in your inventory; without it, Sherin says to bring it back.
Hunter Sherin (hu_in01 386,373) takes the Penetration (item 1007) and changes your job to Hunter.
Hunter Sherin (hu_in01 386,373) gives you a Hunter Bow (item 1718) if your Job Level is above 49, otherwise a CrossBow (item 1710).
4013.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

4133.description: Accept Anori's request for a purification potion to stop Iara, who is seducing young tribesmen, by bringing 20 Heart of Mermaid, 10 Leopard Claw and 3 Ancient Lips.
guide: Talk to Anori (brasilis 315,334), the Shaman, who tells you that Iara is seducing young tribesmen at a cave behind the waterfall.
Agree to help, and Anori (brasilis 315,334) says the only materials needed are 20 Heart of Mermaid (item 950), 10 Leopard Claw (item 7172) and 3 Ancient Lips (item 1054).
Gather those materials and bring them back to Anori (brasilis 315,334), who makes the purification potion.
4133.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

4134.description: Hand 20 Heart of Mermaid, 10 Leopard Claw and 3 Ancient Lips to Anori, who makes 2 Puri Potion (item 11517) that makes Iara stop training at the cave for a while.
guide: Bring 20 Heart of Mermaid (item 950), 10 Leopard Claw (item 7172) and 3 Ancient Lips (item 1054) to Anori (brasilis 315,334).
Anori (brasilis 315,334) grinds and mixes the materials and gives you 2 Puri Potion (item 11517).
Anori (brasilis 315,334) asks you to block the Iara that threatens the tribe, since the potion makes her stop training at the cave for a while.
4134.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

4135.description: Anori is still preparing after the purification potion is made and will not ask for help until this 24-hour timer runs out.
guide: Talk to Anori (brasilis 315,334) while the timer runs; he says he is still preparing and does not need your help at this time.
When the 24-hour timer ends, Anori (brasilis 315,334) can be spoken to again and speaks to you about Iara once more.
4135.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

6000.description: Accept Phoenix's offer to train as a Taekwon Do student; if your Base Level is 19 or lower, Phoenix asks you to gain one more Base Level before the training begins.
guide: Talk to Phoenix (payon 157,141) and choose 'Okay, I will join you.' as a Novice; Phoenix sends you back if your Job Level is below 9.
Phoenix (payon 157,141) says your body must be conditioned and asks you to gain one more Base Level, then return.
When you return with the extra Base Level, Phoenix says you are more in tune with your inner strength and moves you to the next part of training.
6000.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 19.

6001.description: Once your Base Level is above 19, Phoenix begins your spiritual training with questions about how you face difficulty and conflicting viewpoints.
guide: Speak to Phoenix (payon 157,141) once your Base Level is above 19, and he begins your spiritual training.
Answer Phoenix's questions about facing difficulty and about conflicting viewpoints; each answer is followed by his teaching.
When the questions are finished, Phoenix (payon 157,141) asks you to reflect and come back once your mind is calm.
6001.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 19.

6002.description: Answer Phoenix's final question about dedicating yourself to Taekwon Do, which makes you a disciple and gives you a training uniform and guard set.
guide: Speak to Phoenix (payon 157,141) once you are calm, and he asks whether you are ready to dedicate yourself to the art and uphold its philosophy.
Choose 'Yes.' and Phoenix (payon 157,141) makes you a disciple of Taekwon Do and gives you a training uniform and guard set.
Phoenix (payon 157,141) gives you the title Taekwon Boy or Taekwon Girl and wishes you luck on your journey.
6002.level_basis: Fixed by the level gate in the script (if(BaseLevel > 19) {).

6005.description: The Kid in Morocc (morocc_in 174,30) asks a Taekwon disciple at Job Level 40 or higher to become a Soul Linker and bring him 3carat Diamond (item 732), Immortal Heart (item 929) and Witherless Rose (item 748).
guide: Talk to the Kid (morocc_in 174,30), who calls you over and offers to make you a Soul Linker once you hear him out.
Accept his offer, and the Kid (morocc_in 174,30) says to bring him 1 3carat Diamond (item 732), 1 Immortal Heart (item 929) and 1 Witherless Rose (item 748).
Bring the three items back to the Kid (morocc_in 174,30), who takes them and introduces Maia, asking you to come back once she has finished her preparations.
6005.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

6006.description: After the Kid takes your items, Maia finishes preparing the ceremony and then takes you into the depths of your mind.
guide: Return to the Kid (morocc_in 174,30) after a short wait; he says the preparations are finished, but first you must spend all your skill points.
Once your skill points are spent, the Kid (morocc_in 174,30) warps you into your mind at job_soul 30,30.
In your mind, step onto Maia (job_soul 30,31), who says the spirits of fallen warriors wait for you and that you can stay for only 3 minutes.
6006.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

6007.description: Inside your mind, speak with the Monk Spirit, Sage Spirit and Alchemist Spirit, who each ask for your help to move on.
guide: Maia (job_soul 30,31) tells you to listen to the spirits, because there is a reason why they cannot move on to the next world.
Talk to the Monk Spirit (job_soul 30,35), the Sage Spirit (job_soul 30,25) or the Alchemist Spirit (job_soul 25,30), and each one explains why they cannot move on and asks for your help.
Once a spirit asks for your help, the quest moves on and Maia (job_soul 30,31) is ready to begin the ceremony.
6007.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

6008.description: Once the spirits have asked for your help, Maia completes your Soul Linker ceremony in your mind when you choose to become a Soul Linker, which changes your job.
guide: Talk to Maia (job_soul 30,31) after the spirits have asked for your help, and choose 'Become a Soul Linker' instead of conversing with the spirits more.
Maia (job_soul 30,31) explains that the Witherless Rose and Immortal Heart take the harm meant for you and the Diamond turns to dust in place of your body, so the fallen warriors can fight for you.
Use all your skill points first; then Maia (job_soul 30,31) changes you into a Soul Linker, completes the quest and sends you back to Morocc (morocc 157,47).
6008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

6010.description: Bring Tzerero 30 Sticky Mucus (item 938) and 30 Resin (item 907) to pass the Super Novice qualification test and become a Super Novice.
guide: Talk to Tzerero (aldeba_in 223,167) and accept his offer to join the Super Novice Society.
Tzerero (aldeba_in 223,167) says the qualification test is to bring him 30 Sticky Mucus (item 938) and 30 Resin (item 907).
When you hand in both items, Tzerero (aldeba_in 223,167) changes your job to Super Novice and gives you G-Strings (item 2339).
6010.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

6015.description: Deliver Kuuga Gai's letter to Wildcat Joe in Einbroch, where the Suspicious Man asks you for 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010).
guide: Choose 'Sure.' with Kuuga Gai (que_ng 30,65), who gives you his letter to deliver to Wildcat Joe in Einbroch, where Joe hides in a high place.
Talk to the Suspicious Man (einbroch 184,194), who says he is looking for minerals and asks you to bring 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010) before he helps you find Red Leopard Joe.
6015.level_basis: Phracon (item 1010) is dropped by Savage Babe (level 7).

6016.description: Bring 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010) to the Suspicious Man in Einbroch, who admits he is Red Leopard Joe and writes his reply to Kuuga Gai.
guide: Bring 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010) to the Suspicious Man (einbroch 184,194).
The Suspicious Man (einbroch 184,194) reads Kuuga Gai's letter and admits he is Red Leopard Joe, who prefers that name to Wildcat Joe.
Red Leopard Joe writes a reply for Kuuga Gai and warps you to Amatsu (amatsu 113,127) to deliver it.

6017.description: Deliver Red Leopard Joe's reply to Kuuga Gai at que_ng 30,65, who then asks you to bring 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010) so he can craft a Kunai.
guide: Give Red Leopard Joe's reply to Kuuga Gai (que_ng 30,65), who reads that Joe rejected the truce and is alarmed.
Kuuga Gai (que_ng 30,65) asks you to gather 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010) so he can craft his own Kunai, and to hurry.

6018.description: Kuuga Gai learns that Wildcat Joe wants the same materials, then asks you to bring 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010) so he can craft a Kunai; with them he makes you a Ninja.
guide: Show Kuuga Gai (que_ng 30,65) Wildcat Joe's reply, which rejects the truce, and he asks you to gather 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010).
Bring 5 Cyfar (item 7053) and 1 Phracon (item 1010) to Kuuga Gai (que_ng 30,65), who checks that you have them.
Spend all leftover Skill Points, then Kuuga Gai (que_ng 30,65) takes the items, makes you a Ninja and gives you an Asura (item 13010).
6018.level_basis: Phracon (item 1010) is dropped by Savage Babe (level 7).

6020.description: Master Miller sends you with a letter of introduction to Wise Bull Horn in Payon, a shaman who judges whether you qualify to be a Gunslinger.
guide: Talk to Master Miller (que_ng 152,167), choose 'I want to become a Gunslinger.', then choose 'Sure!' to apply.
Miller (que_ng 152,167) says he will get you started and gives you a letter for Mr. Wise Bull Horn in Payon.
Deliver the letter to Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65), who will judge whether you qualify to be a Gunslinger.
6020.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

6021.description: Wise Bull Horn lists the materials for a Gunslinger voucher, and you bring him 1 Trunk, 3 Fluff, 3 Zargon, 10 Shell, 3 Green Herb and 3 Rainbow Shell.
guide: Talk to Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65), who says he will make a voucher and lists the items he needs.
Bring 1 Trunk (item 1019), 3 Fluff (item 914), 3 Zargon (item 912), 10 Shell (item 935), 3 Green Herb (item 511) and 3 Rainbow Shell (item 1013) to Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65).
When you hand in the items, Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65) says he needs time to make the voucher and asks you to come back shortly.
6021.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

6022.description: Wise Bull Horn makes your Gunslinger voucher, talks about his years as a young adventurer, and then asks you to bring him a cold glass of Milk (item 519).
guide: Return to Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65) after handing in the items; he says you arrived just in time, as he is making the voucher.
Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65) talks about his years choosing Gunslinger voucher recipients and about Selena and Black Fox.
Before you leave, Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65) asks you to bring him a cold glass of Milk (item 519).
6022.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

6023.description: Wise Bull Horn asks you to bring him a cold glass of Milk (item 519), and then sends you with his voucher to Miller, the Black Fox.
guide: Talk to Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65), who is thirsty and asks you to bring him a cold glass of Milk (item 519).
Bring 1 Milk (item 519) to Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65), who drinks it and thanks you.
Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65) gives you his approval and tells you to take the voucher to Miller, the Black Fox.
6023.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

6024.description: A quest to change job to Gunslinger by completing a voucher and returning to Master Miller for promotion.
guide: Talk to Master Miller (que_ng 152,167) with the voucher from Wise Bull Horn (payon 184,65); spend any leftover Skill Points first.
Miller (que_ng 152,167) explains that you must keep your gun with you and can only get guns and bullets from Gunslinger Guild members.

Miller (que_ng 152,167) promotes you to a Gunslinger and completes the quest; the reward is a Novice Rifle (item 13180), 2 Bullet Case (item 12149) and a Silver Bullet Case (item 12151), or else a Six Shooter (item 13100) or Branch (item 13150) at random.
6024.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

6025.description: After participating in a KVM battle, the player must wait 5 minutes before signing up for KVM Guillaume quest 6025.
guide: Talk to the KVM Mercenary Officer (bat_room 164,178), who speaks as Guillaume Mercenary Officer, and choose 'I will fight with you.'
If you took part in a KVM battle recently, the officer says you must wait 5 minutes before signing up again.
The officer warps you to the battle room: bat_room 169,223 if your Base Level is above 79, bat_room 197,223 if below 60, otherwise bat_room 225,223.
Touch a camp in the battle map, such as bat_c01 54,128, which sets quest 6025 when the battle queue flag is off.
6025.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 79.

6026.description: Sign up with the Croix Mercenary Officer (bat_room 164,121) for the KVM battle; after a battle you must wait 5 minutes before signing up again.
guide: Talk to the KVM Mercenary Officer (bat_room 164,121), who speaks as Croix Mercenary Officer, and choose 'I will fight with you.'
If you took part in a KVM battle recently, the officer says you must wait 5 minutes before signing up again.
The officer warps you to the battle room: bat_room 169,207 if your Base Level is above 79, bat_room 197,207 if below 60, otherwise bat_room 225,207.
6026.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 79.

7000.description: A female Archer at Job Level 40 or higher fills out the Comodo Dance School application with Aile, who takes it to the director and asks you to come back shortly.
guide: Talk to Aile (job_duncer 43,93), who explains the Comodo Dance School and asks whether you want to sign up.
Choose 'Fill out the application.' with Aile (job_duncer 43,93); she says you need Job Level 40 or higher to enroll, and sends you away if you do not have it.
Fill out the application, and Aile (job_duncer 43,93) says she will show it to the director, so come back in a little while.
7000.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7001.description: Aile lists the supplies for your lessons on this path: 10,000 Zeny, 20 Sticky Mucus, 3 Jellopy, 5 Red Potions and Shoes, which you bring back to her.
guide: Talk to Aile (job_duncer 43,93) after your application, and she says the supplies are part of your tuition.
Aile (job_duncer 43,93) asks for 10,000 Zeny for tuition, 20 Sticky Mucus (item 938) for shoe polish, 3 Jellopy (item 909), 5 Red Potions (item 501) and Shoes (item 2403).
Bring those items and 10,000 Zeny to Aile (job_duncer 43,93), who takes the tuition and sends you to Bijou for the interview.
7001.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7002.description: Aile's supply list for this path asks for 10,000 Zeny tuition, 5 Earthworm Peelings and a pair of Boots, which you bring back to her.
guide: Talk to Aile (job_duncer 43,93) after your application; she says the supplies are part of the tuition.
Aile (job_duncer 43,93) asks for 10,000 Zeny, 5 Earthworm Peelings (item 1055) for polishing the floor, and a pair of Boots (item 2405).
Bring 10,000 Zeny, 5 Earthworm Peelings (item 1055) and 1 Boots (item 2405) to Aile (job_duncer 43,93), who takes the tuition and sends you to Bijou for the interview.
7002.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7003.description: Aile's supply list for this path asks for 10,000 Zeny tuition, 2 Clam Shells, 5 Yellow Potions, 20 Jellopy, 10 Black Hairs and Sandals, which you bring back to her.
guide: Talk to Aile (job_duncer 43,93) after your application; she says the supplies are part of the tuition.
Aile (job_duncer 43,93) asks for 10,000 Zeny, 2 Clam Shells (item 965), 5 Yellow Potions (item 503), 20 Jellopy (item 909), 10 Black Hairs (item 1020) and Sandals (item 2401).
Bring those items and 10,000 Zeny to Aile (job_duncer 43,93), who takes the tuition and sends you to Bijou for the interview.
7003.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7004.description: Bijou interviews you with a ten-question quiz about dance and Comodo, and a score above 70 (or a perfect 100) passes you on to the Dance Test.
guide: Talk to Bijou (job_duncer 95,93) after Aile's supply hand-in; she says she will ask a couple of simple questions for the interview.
Answer Bijou's ten quiz questions about dance, Comodo and the job change; each correct answer adds 10 points.
A score above 70, or a perfect 100, passes; otherwise Bijou (job_duncer 95,93) says you failed and asks you to study more and come back.
After passing, Bijou (job_duncer 95,93) explains the Dance Test; choose 'Go to the testing area.' to start it.
7004.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7005.description: Bijou explains the Dance Test, where you dance alone for 1 minute following the music's directions; reaching the exit point at job_duncer 69,110 passes the test and sends you back to Bijou.
guide: Talk to Bijou (job_duncer 95,93) and choose 'Listen to instructions.' to hear the rules: 1 minute, one dancer at a time, and the camera set to face forward.
Choose 'Go to the testing area.' with Bijou (job_duncer 95,93), who says good luck and warps you to job_duncer 105,109.
Follow the direction moves in the test; if you fail, you are sent back to job_duncer 105,109 to try again.
Reach the exit point at job_duncer 69,110 (the dance return point) to finish the dance; you are told to go back to Bijou and warped to comodo 188,162.
7005.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7006.description: After passing the Dance Test, return to Bijou to have your job changed to Dancer; she gives you a Rope (item 1950), or a Line (item 1953) at Job Level 50.
guide: Return to Bijou (job_duncer 95,93) after the Dance Test with no skill points left, since she will not change jobs while you have some.
Bijou (job_duncer 95,93) says she saw your dance and that you are qualified to become a Dancer, then changes your job.
Bijou (job_duncer 95,93) completes the quest and gives you a small gift: a Line (item 1953) at Job Level 50, otherwise a Rope (item 1950).
7006.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7007.description: Moohyun offers a Taekwon student at Job Level 40 or higher the path to Taekwon Master, sending you to Moogang in Comodo with a letter of recommendation.
guide: Talk to Moohyun (payon 215,102) as a Taekwon student, choose 'Sure.' and then 'Yes, I am!' to hear about the Taekwon Master path.
At Job Level 40 or higher, choose 'Yes, I do.' with Moohyun (payon 215,102), who says Moogang in Comodo will train you.
Moohyun (payon 215,102) writes a letter of recommendation to send to Moogang, and tells you to visit him in Comodo, the place closest to the sky.
7007.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7008.description: Moogang asks you to gather four shards of nature for the Taekwon Master test: Rough Wind, Great Nature, Mystic Frozen and Flame Heart, which you bring back to him.
guide: Talk to Wandering Master (Moogang, comodo 172,230), spend any leftover Skill Points, then choose 'Yes, let me take the test!'.
Moogang (comodo 172,230) asks you to gather Rough Wind (item 996), Great Nature (item 997), Mystic Frozen (item 995) and Flame Heart (item 994).
Bring 1 each of Rough Wind (item 996), Great Nature (item 997), Mystic Frozen (item 995) and Flame Heart (item 994) to Moogang (comodo 172,230), who takes them and teaches you about nature.
7008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7009.description: Moogang sends you to the altar at job_star 34,12 for the next test, where Daru guides you through it; return to Moogang once the test is complete.
guide: Talk to Wandering Master (Moogang, comodo 172,230), who asks if you are ready; choose 'Yes, I am ready.' to go to the altar.
Moogang (comodo 172,230) warps you to the altar (job_star 34,12), where you speak to Daru, who serves as your guide for the test.
After you complete the test with Daru, come back and talk to Moogang (comodo 172,230).
7009.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7010.description: Cheehee in the Star Room asks you to bring a Star Crumb (item 1000) and a Star Dust (item 1001), then tests your knowledge of the starlight song.
guide: Talk to Cheehee (job_star 161,33) in the Star Room, who asks you to bring a piece of a star and the sand of a star.
Bring 1 Star Crumb (item 1000) and 1 Star Dust (item 1001) to Cheehee (job_star 161,33); if you do not have them, she sends you to Payon (payon 164,58) to find them.
Answer Cheehee's question about the starlight song; the right answer is '25th day, Deep Cave, Knights', then go back to Moogang (comodo 172,230).
7010.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7011.description: Return to Moogang after Cheehee's lesson on the Sun, the Moon and the Stars; he completes your job change to Star Gladiator.
guide: Talk to Wandering Master (Moogang, comodo 172,230) after Cheehee's lesson, and tell him what you learned about the Sun, the Moon and the Stars.
Moogang (comodo 172,230) says you are already a warrior of the Sun, the Moon and the Stars, and completes the quest.
Moogang (comodo 172,230) changes you into a Star Gladiator and teaches you the song of the Sun, the Moon and the Stars.
7011.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7012.description: Echinacea, leader of the pursuit party in the Ash Vacuum, assigns you as Mr. Kidd's assistant to help track Satan Morocc and find Rayan.
guide: Talk to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185), who asks your name and assigns you as Mr. Kidd's assistant.
Talk to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311), who asks whether you have any business there and offers you a chore.
Choose 'No, I don't mind at all.' with Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311), who sends you to Rin (que_job01 84,17) in an underground tavern at Southwest Morocc.
7012.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7013.description: Mr. Kidd sends you back to Echinacea because you do not want to help, and she scolds you before sending you back to him.
guide: Choose 'Yes.' with Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) when he asks if you mind being entrusted with a chore; he says he did not need help and sends you back to Echinacea.
Talk to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185), who scolds you for abandoning your duty and tells you to go back and help Mr. Kidd.
7013.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7014.description: After Echinacea's scolding, Mr. Kidd sends you to find Rin at an underground tavern in Southwest Morocc to gather information for him.
guide: Talk to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) after Echinacea's scolding; he says both camps are tracing Satan Morocc and that the Morocc colleagues have not been heard from for a while.
Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) asks you to gather information and sends you to Rin (que_job01 84,17) at an underground tavern in Southwest Morocc, where a boy named Jack stands out front.
7014.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7015.description: Pursue Rayan Moore and investigate Satan Morocc's whereabouts. Help Rin gather clues about Rayan's activities and the space gap.
guide: Talk to Rin (que_job01 84,17) and choose 'Mr. Kidd sent me.' to explain why you came.
Rin (que_job01 84,17) explains that Rayan broke Satan Morocc's seal, that his gang ambushed her, and that the Dandelions are Rayan's puppets.
When Rin (que_job01 84,17) asks if you will investigate the area where she was ambushed, say you are interested and she continues talking.
7015.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7016.description: Rin gives you the location southwest of Hugel, past Abyss Lake, where she was ambushed, and you search there for clues.
guide: Talk to Rin (que_job01 84,17), who gives you the location: southwest of Hugel, past Abyss Lake and west to the stiff mountains.
Search the mountain area south of the second hill from the top, where the Heap of Earth (hu_fild04 235,103) shows traces of a battle.
Choose 'Take a careful look.' at the Heap of Earth (hu_fild04 235,103) to find a Bloody Crystal of Darkness (item 6027).
7016.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7017.description: Show Rin the Bloody Crystal of Darkness you found, and she gives you her journal, the Morocc Tracing Log (item 6029), to take to Mr. Kidd.
guide: Show the Bloody Crystal of Darkness (item 6027) to Rin (que_job01 84,17), who says it is the same kind of crystal that Satan Morocc's minions carry.
Rin (que_job01 84,17) gives you her journal, the Morocc Tracing Log (item 6029), and asks you to take it and the crystal to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311).
7017.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7018.description: Pursue Rayan Moore and investigate Satan Morocc's activities by delivering the Morocc Tracing Log and Bloody Crystal of Darkness to Mr. Kidd.
guide: Talk to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) with the Morocc Tracing Log (item 6029) and the Bloody Crystal of Darkness (item 6027), and he takes them from you.
Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) says Rin is wounded, asks you to come back later to substitute for her until she recovers, and asks to be left alone to write his report.
7018.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7019.description: After Mr. Kidd's report, touch the Bloody Crystal of Darkness at the space gap and get pulled into a fight where Rin battles Rayan and his Dandelion Members.
guide: Try to touch the Bloody Crystal of Darkness at the space gap near Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311); the first try warps you to que_dan01 (32,27).
At que_dan01 (31,27), touch the crystal again and you are pulled into the space gap, where Rin (que_dan01 34,34) fights Rayan (que_dan01 36,34) and the Dandelion Members.
You cannot move during the fight; Rin is overpowered and Rayan leaves, which ends this stage.
7019.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7020.description: After Rayan leaves and Rin is overpowered, defeat the Dandelion Members and search the corpse at que_dan01 (49,36) for a Sealed Magic Scroll.
guide: Defeat the Dandelion Members in que_dan01; the corpse cannot be searched while any of them are still alive.
Search the Corpse (que_dan01 49,36), which shows a laceration from Rin's attack, and check its pockets or shake it.
A Sealed Magic Scroll (item 6028) falls out of the corpse's jacket pocket; take it to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311).
7020.level_basis: Recommended level 37 comes from the Dandelion Member (monster 1985, level 37) named by a spawn line in the script.

7021.description: Mr. Kidd hears what happened at the space gap after you show him the Sealed Magic Scroll from the corpse, and asks you to find a scholar to examine it.
guide: Talk to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311), who asks what happened after you return from the space gap.
Show Mr. Kidd the Sealed Magic Scroll (item 6028) and tell him what you saw; he says the scroll holds a spell anyone can use, but it is sealed and needs a pass code.
Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) asks you to ask a scholar about the scroll, and recommends Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185).
7021.level_basis: The recommended level is 37, fixed by the monster Dandelion Member (level 37) named in the script

7022.description: Echinacea points you to Mr. Defaria, an Arunafeltz scholar of magic, to ask about the spell scroll that Mr. Kidd found.
guide: Talk to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) about the scholar that Mr. Kidd asked you to find for the spell scroll.
Choose 'Who?' with Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185), who points out Mr. Defaria, an old man from Arunafeltz trying to make a fire with wet firewood.
Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) tells you to go show the spell scroll to Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272).
7022.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7023.description: Mr. Defaria recognizes the spell scroll as a sealed Arunafeltz scroll and agrees to help unseal it if you gather the materials he names.
guide: Talk to Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) once his fire has gone out, and show him the spell scroll when he asks to see it.
Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) says the scroll is sealed by an Arunafeltz temple method, and asks you to keep his help unofficial; choose 'Got it.' to accept.
Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) asks you to gather 30 Holy Water (item 523), 30 Rune of Darkness (item 7511) and 30 Bloody Rune (item 7563) to unseal the scroll.
7023.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7024.description: Bring the 30 Holy Water, 30 Rune of Darkness and 30 Bloody Rune that Mr. Defaria asked for, along with the Sealed Scroll, so he can unseal the spell scroll.
guide: Bring 30 Holy Water (item 523), 30 Rune of Darkness (item 7511), 30 Bloody Rune (item 7563) and the Sealed Scroll (item 6028) to Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272).
Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) takes the items and the scroll, then asks you to come back in a little while.
7024.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7025.description: Mr. Defaria unseals the scroll, which turns out to hold a teleportation spell that moves you to a specific location, and he gives you the Unsealed Magic Spell.
guide: Talk to Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) again; he may say you must wait longer, since the unsealing takes a random amount of time.
When the unsealing is done, Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) explains the scroll is a teleportation spell to a specific location, and gives you the Unsealed Magic Spell (item 14595).
Mr. Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) says organizations use such scrolls to gather their members, and asks you to leave him alone to rest.
7025.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7026.description: Use the Unsealed Magic Spell to teleport to the Dandelion area, where you listen at a side door and overhear Rayan's followers quarrelling.
guide: Talk to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311), who tells you to use the spell scroll to teleport to a place linked to the Dandelions, gather clues and not fight them.
Use the Unsealed Magic Spell (item 14595) to teleport there, then touch the side door at que_dan02 (21,37) to hear the Dandelion members arguing about Rayan.
When Rayan says it is time to take back 'it', use a Butterfly Wing to escape to the save point, which sets the next stage.
7026.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7027.description: Report what you overheard in the basement to Mr. Kidd, who asks you to go back and spy on the Dandelions a little longer.
guide: Talk to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) and tell him what you heard from the basement in the empty house near the national border.
Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) says he will follow you once he has reported to the higher-ups, and asks you to go back and spy on them a bit more.
7027.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7028.description: Go through the basement side door at que_dan02 (21,37), where you find a blood-covered man who turns out to be Rayan, and Mr. Kidd takes him away.
guide: At the basement side door (que_dan02 21,37), choose 'Enter.' to go inside the basement.
In que_dan02 (115,53), the blood-covered Man talks about his master and the Dandelions, and Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) arrives to ask who he is.
The man is revealed as Rayan, and Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) says he will take him to Rin for interrogation; you then return to town.
7028.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7029.description: Mr. Kidd gives you the Crystal Of Feardom and the Morocc Tracing Log to deliver to Rin, who is interrogating the captured Rayan.
guide: Talk to Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) after Rayan's capture; he says Rin is interrogating him in the basement.
Mr. Kidd (mid_camp 199,311) gives you the Crystal Of Feardom (item 6027) and the Morocc Tracing Log (item 6029), and asks you to bring them to Rin.
7029.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7030.description: Deliver the Morocc Tracing Log and Crystal Of Feardom to Rin, who receives them while Rayan's second personality takes over, and she gives you a pattern number.
guide: Talk to Rin (que_job01 144,54) with the Morocc Tracing Log (item 6029) and the Crystal Of Feardom (item 6027); she takes both from you.
Choose one of Rin's options to stop Rayan (que_job01 144,54) from going berserk; Rayan's second personality then speaks and disappears.
Rin (que_job01 144,54) gives you the tracing pattern number and asks you to report it to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185).
7030.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7031.description: Report the tracing pattern number from Rin to Echinacea, who starts the location-tracing spell to find Rayan's magic wavelength.
guide: Talk to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) and give her the tracing pattern number that Rin gave you.
Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) checks the number, starts the location-tracing spell, and uses up the Morocc Tracing Log (item 6029).
Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) says the results will take some time, so you must check back later.
7031.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7034.description: Echinacea waits for the location-tracing spell to find Rayan's magic wavelength, and sends you to the building manager once the results are ready.
guide: Talk to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) after the pattern number is entered; she says the wavelength tracing takes time and asks you to be patient.
When Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) sends you on, go to the building south of the camp that has a mana detector attached to it.
Ask the building manager about the trace results, as Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) asked.
7034.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7035.description: The building manager reports that the traced pattern number is not found in this area, but the intact magic stone shows Rayan is still alive somewhere.
guide: Talk to the Manager (mid_camp 191,206), who asks whether Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) sent you and says the wavelength was not detected in this area.
Choose 'But?' to hear that the pattern is used to trace a human, and that an intact stone means the target is still alive somewhere.
The Manager (mid_camp 191,206) says he will keep watching for the same wavelength, and the quest moves on to reporting to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185).
7035.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7036.description: Echinacea concludes that Rayan is with Satan Morocc, ends the pursuit and gives you a reward.
guide: Talk to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) and report what the building manager told you about the trace results.
Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) says Rayan is not on the Midgard Continent or in the Ash Vacuum, so he must be with Satan Morocc, and the pursuit is at an end.
Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) thanks you for your help and gives you experience and an Old Violet Box (item 617) as a reward.
7036.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7037.description: Echinacea closes the Rayan case and tells you to leave it alone, and Defaria offers to talk about the Dandelions if you do him a favor.
guide: Talk to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185), choose 'Something is bothering me...', and she says the matter is out of your hands and to focus on helping the camp.
Talk to Defaria (mid_camp 256,272), enter 'Dandelion' when asked, and choose 'Just tell me what you know.'; he says you should ask Echinacea instead.
Choose 'I'll do anything for you.' and then 'Yes!'; Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) asks you to bring 20 Sweet Potatoes (item 516) and 30 Logs (item 7201).
7037.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7038.description: Defaria asks you to bring 20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs for his fire, then gives you Nice Sweet Potatoes to deliver to Mr. Kidd.
guide: Talk to Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) with 20 Sweet Potatoes (item 516) and 30 Logs (item 7201); he asks you to pile them on the firewood.
Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) lights the fire with the sweet potatoes and logs, which are used up, and says his magic has not gotten rusty.
Talk to Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) again; when you ask about Dandelion, he declines to talk about politics and gives you 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes (item 549) to deliver to Mr. Kidd.
7038.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7039.description: Defaria explains the Dandelion group to you and sends two steaming hot Nice Sweet Potatoes to Echinacea.
guide: Talk to Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) after delivering the Nice Sweet Potatoes to Mr. Kidd; he asks whether Mr. Kidd liked them.
Choose 'Then what..?' and Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) explains that the Dandelions were right-wing patriots who allied with warmongers in the government and began by spying.
Choose 'So Arunafeltz planned all this!'; Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) says it is not that simple and gives you 2 steaming hot Nice Sweet Potatoes (item 549) to bring to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185).
7039.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7040.description: Echinacea receives the 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes from Defaria and explains why the truce with Arunafeltz must hold.
guide: Talk to Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) with 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes (item 549); she asks whether the old man sent them.
Choose 'That's right.'; Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) explains that Arunafeltz has new moderate leaders and that the truce must not be broken.
Echinacea (mid_campin 68,185) takes the 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes and asks you to tell Defaria that she is grateful for them.
7040.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7041.description: Defaria is pleased with Echinacea's words about peace, and gives you five Baked Yams (item 633) to finish the quest.
guide: Talk to Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) after Echinacea has taken the sweet potatoes; he asks whether she really said that.
Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) says the three countries decided to cooperate and hopes for lasting, friendly relationships, though he is not holding his breath for world peace.
Defaria (mid_camp 256,272) gives you 5 Baked Yams (item 633) for trying so hard, which completes the quest.
7041.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7042.description: Breeder Taab offers a part-time job feeding the Tatachoes, asking for 50 Fresh Fish in return for an EXP reward.
guide: Talk to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306), choose 'I'm here for a job.', and accept the first part-time job, feeding the Tatachoes.
Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306) asks you to bring 50 Fresh Fish (item 579), which you can find from Tatachoes in the fields.
Bring 50 Fresh Fish (item 579) to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306), who gives you 80,000 EXP and 30,000 JEXP (less on a repeat).
7042.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7043.description: Part-time job for Breeder Taab to gather feed for Cornuses (Cornus).
guide: Talk to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306), choose 'I'm here for a job.', and take the job of feeding the Cornuses.
Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306) says the Cornuses are out of feed and asks you to bring 30 Great Leaves (item 7198) and 30 Brown Roots (item 7188), which you can find from Pinguiculas in the fields.
Bring 30 Great Leaves (item 7198) and 30 Brown Roots (item 7188) to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306), who gives you 90,000 EXP and 40,000 JEXP (less on a repeat).
7043.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7044.description: Breeder Taab asks you to bring 20 Monster's Feeds and 30 Pet Foods to feed the Hillsrions, which he is trying a new feed on, for an EXP reward.
guide: Talk to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306), choose 'I'm here for a job.', and take the job of feeding the Hillsrions when he offers it.
Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306) says he wants to try Monster's Feed this time and asks you to bring 20 Monster's Feeds (item 528) and 30 Pet Foods (item 537).
Bring 20 Monster's Feeds (item 528) and 30 Pet Foods (item 537) to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306), who gives you 80,000 EXP and 30,000 JEXP (less on a repeat).
7044.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7045.description: Breeder Taab asks you to bring 50 Meat and 30 Pet Foods to feed the Hillsrions, which he wants to try Meat on, for an EXP reward.
guide: Talk to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306), choose 'I'm here for a job.', and take the job of feeding the Hillsrions with Meat when he offers it.
Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306) says he wants to try Meat this time and asks you to bring 50 Meat (item 517) and 30 Pet Foods (item 537).
Bring 50 Meat (item 517) and 30 Pet Foods (item 537) to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306), who gives you 80,000 EXP and 30,000 JEXP (less on a repeat).
7045.level_basis: The item droppers range from level 11 to 113, too wide to pick one level.

7046.description: Part-time job at Breeder Taab to bring fur for warm rugs. The player must collect 30 scraps of fur and deliver them to the NPC for a spiritual reward.
guide: Visit Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306) to accept the part-time job for warm rugs.
Bring 30 scraps of fur (item 6020) to Breeder Taab.
Receive a spiritual reward (8,000 EXP or 80,000 EXP) after completing the job.
7046.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7047.description: After a part-time job, Breeder Taab thanks you and makes you wait before you can take another job.
guide: Talk to Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306) after finishing a part-time job; he thanks you for helping him last time.
If the wait is not over, Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306) says he has enough feed and supplies and asks you to go rest.
When the wait is over, Breeder Taab (mid_camp 143,306) says the part-time work is constant and clears the quest, so you can take a job again.
7047.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7048.description: After Burled asks you to explore Thanatos Tower and report what you learn, you break the Rune Device at tha_t03 67,70 to get the Red Key.
guide: Talk to the Entrance Guide (tha_t02 231,161), who speaks as Burled, and choose 'Start a conversation.' to hear about the tower.
Choose 'Just tell me about it.', then 'What accident are you referring to?', and accept Burled's favor with 'Ok! I will.'
Burled (tha_t02 231,161) asks you to explore the tower and tell him in detail anything you learn about what drives the accidents.
Investigate the Rune Device (tha_t03 67,70) and choose 'Investigate it.'; a Taekwon or a level 4 weapon breaks it and gives you the Red Key (item 7421).
Choose 'Concentrate on it.' with the Rune Device (tha_t03 67,70) to read the letters, which completes this stage.
7048.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7049.description: Enter the three-digit code at the Rune Device at tha_t04 195,195 to get the Yellow Key (item 7422) and read the next message.
guide: Rune Device (tha_t04 195,195), the screen with a numeric keypad, asks for a 3-digit number with no 0 and no repeated digit; enter one.
After each try, Screen (tha_t04 195,195) reports how many digits are in the correct place and how many are correct in total.
When the access is authorized, the Yellow Key (item 7422) appears; choose 'Concentrate on it.' to read the message, which completes this stage.
7049.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7050.description: The Brilliant Statue at tha_t05 62,179 takes the Red Key and Yellow Key in its wings and releases the Blue Key (item 7423).
guide: Talk to the Brilliant Statue (tha_t05 62,179) and choose 'Stick the key into the crack...' while carrying the Red Key (item 7421) and Yellow Key (item 7422).
When asked which key goes in the left wing, type 'Red Key'; then type 'Yellow Key' for the right wing.
The Blue Key (item 7423) appears from the statue; choose 'Concentrate on it.' and read the message, which completes this stage.
7050.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7051.description: With the Red, Yellow and Blue keys, align the five wheels of the Brilliant Statue at tha_t06 226,230 to release the Green Key (item 7424).
guide: Talk to the Brilliant Statue (tha_t06 226,230) and choose 'Investigate.' while carrying the Red Key (item 7421), Yellow Key (item 7422) and Blue Key (item 7423).
Choose 'Investigate the Wheels' and adjust the five wheels until all of them are in the same position, which activates the machine.
When the machine activates, the Green Key (item 7424) appears; choose 'Concentrate on it.' and read the message, which completes this stage.
7051.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7052.description: With all four keys in hand, the Splendid Sword at tha_t06 204,181 gives you the Black Key (item 7425) and Varmunt's Journal.
guide: Talk to the Splendid Sword (tha_t06 204,181) with the Red Key (item 7421), Yellow Key (item 7422), Blue Key (item 7423) and Green Key (item 7424), and choose 'Observe it.'
Choose 'Towards the hilt of the sword', then 'Insert the sword into the hole' when the hole appears in the table.
The Black Key (item 7425) appears and a drawer opens to show Varmunt's Journal, which completes this stage; then show it to Burled (tha_t02 231,161).
7052.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7053.description: Show Varmunt's Journal to Burled at the Entrance Guide (tha_t02 231,161), who keeps it secret from Rekenber and rewards you with an Old Violet Box (item 617).
guide: Choose 'Start a conversation.' with the Entrance Guide (tha_t02 231,161), who speaks as Burled, then choose 'I found Varmunt's Journal...'.
Burled (tha_t02 231,161) reads the journal, says the Rekenber Corporation is looking for Varmunt's research materials, and says the secret should be kept from them.
Burled (tha_t02 231,161) gives you the note and an Old Violet Box (item 617) with a little EXP, which completes the quest.
7053.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7054.description: Defeat 1000 Kobold Archers to teach them a lesson and receive the Seal of our 'Brave Kitty Cats' from Myu.
guide: Talk to Myu in the village of Deserted people and choose 'What should I do' and then 'That's easy' to agree to defeat 1000 Kobold Archers.
Hunt the Kobold Archers 1000 times without harming any Wild Rose, as Myu warned.
Go back to Myu (gef_fild05 80,149), who gives you the Seal of our 'Brave Kitty Cats' (item 5446) once the Kobold Archers have learned their lesson.
7054.level_basis: Recommended level is 33, fixed by the quest objective monster Kobold Archer.

7055.description: Defeat 1 Wild Rose (monster 1261), which Myu forbids; she finds out and ends the arrangement, erasing both Myu quests.
guide: Talk to Myu (gef_fild05 80,149) and accept her job; this also starts this quest.
Defeat 1 Wild Rose (monster 1261), the objective of this quest, even though Myu warned never to harm Wild Roses.
Talk to Myu (gef_fild05 80,149) again; she says 'Our business is over!!!' and erases both Myu quests.
7055.level_basis: Fixed by the quest objective monster Wild Rose (monster 1261, level 38)

7056.description: Arc asks you to find his friend Terra, a Laphine who left without permission, by following the knotted plant marks she leaves behind.
guide: Talk to Splendide Guard (spl_in01 32,306), who speaks as Arc, and choose 'What favor' and then 'Sure, I will do it.' to accept the search.
Arc explains that Terra marks her way with knotted plants, so a trail of them should lead to her; keep this a secret from the other Laphines.
Examine the knotted stem at spl_fild02 45,214, which Terra left as a mark and which points South.
7056.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7057.description: Terra's knotted trail leads south to a cave, where the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223), a scarred giant statue wearing a muffler, suggests Terra fought it.
guide: Follow the knotted leaves that point South from the stem at spl_fild02 45,214, which Terra left as her trail.
Once in the cave, examine the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223), a statue of a Giant with many scars and a muffler on its neck.
Conclude that Terra's marks are gone and that she may have fought this Giant, then head back to Arc (spl_in01 32,306).
7057.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7058.description: Terra returns to Arc wounded after taking Bradium, and Arc asks you to tell him about the Giant from the cave and then bring her back.
guide: Talk to Splendide Guard (spl_in01 32,306), who speaks as Arc, to hear that Terra came back covered with wounds and took the Bradium.
Tell Arc about the Giant from the cave; he says Bradium is precious to the Sapha and that the Sapha body was already stiff.
Answer Arc's questions about the cave and agree to go, then Arc asks you to go and bring Terra back to his post.
7058.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7059.description: Arc asks you to return to the cave of the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223) to look for Terra, who is no longer there, and to examine the ore left around the Sapha's body.
guide: Go back to the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223) in the cave to look for Terra, as Arc asked.
Examine the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223) and find no trace of Terra, but small particles of an ore sprinkled around the Sapha's body, which you identify as Powdered Bradium.
7059.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7060.description: In the Sapha village, overhear the villagers Lawine and Rivier talking about a badly hurt fairy held in prison, who may be Terra.
guide: Go to the Sapha village and talk to Villager (manuk 278,177) or Villager (manuk 281,177) while the Sapha villagers are talking.
Choose 'Break into their conversation.' or 'Keep quiet and listen.' to hear Villager Lawine and Villager Rivier speak of a badly hurt fairy in prison.
The Sapha villagers will not say more, and the captured fairy may be Terra; this completes the stage.
7060.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7061.description: Snorren, a Sapha at the prison (man_in01 175,59), wants to talk to the captured Laphine about his missing friend Ogen, so you interpret for him and learn her wounds need treatment.
guide: Talk to Snorren (man_in01 175,59), choose 'About the Captured Fairy.' and show the ring to prove you can understand him.
Choose 'Do you need an interpreter' and Snorren agrees to ask Luik about it; he says his friend Ogen is missing.

Talk to Snorren (man_in01 175,59) again; Luik says the Laphine's wounds need treatment, so choose 'Nothing gets past you...' and go back to the Splendide Guard (spl_in01 32,306), who speaks as Arc, for a cure.
7061.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7062.description: Arc hears that a wounded Laphine may be held in the Sapha village and gives you three Yggdrasilberries (item 607) to cure her, asking you to find more.
guide: Talk to Splendide Guard (spl_in01 32,306), who speaks as Arc, and tell him about the wounded Laphine held in the Sapha village.
Arc asks whether it is Terra, mentions the Yggdrasil and gives you three Yggdrasilberries (item 607), saying they will not be enough.
Arc says a huge tree with an exposed Yggdrasil root stands outside, where more Yggdrasilberries can be found.
7062.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7063.description: Gather Yggdrasilberries (item 607) from the huge Yggdrasil fruit near the swamp to cure the wounded Laphine, aiming for at least six.
guide: Look for the huge tree near a swamp at the edge of the area, where the Yggdrasil root is exposed and Yggdrasilberries can be found.
Examine the huge fruit at spl_fild01 329,29 to pull out a Yggdrasil and take a Yggdrasilberry (item 607); you already have three from Arc.
Once you have six or more Yggdrasilberries (item 607), go back to Snorren (man_in01 175,59), who needs at least six.
7063.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7064.description: Snorren at man_in01 17,128 brings the Yggdrasilberry cure to Luik and asks you to talk to the Laphine and hear her story.
guide: Talk to Snorren (man_in01 17,128) after he has the Yggdrasilberries; he says the berries are a cure for the Laphine and that Luik has them.
Give your name when Snorren asks for it; he says you should try talking to the Laphine and let's hear her story.
Snorren (man_in01 17,128) hands the stage to the talk with Luik (man_in01 19,126), where the Laphine's story will be heard.
7064.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7065.description: Interpret for Luik and Snorren in the prison: the Laphine wants bradium to save a Sapha friend who is petrifying, and Luik doubts your story until you promise proof.
guide: Talk to Snorren (man_in01 17,128), who asks you to help translate for the Laphine while Luik watches.
Talk to Luik (man_in01 19,126) and choose 'To give it to a Sapha in a cave...' to explain that the Laphine came for bradium after her friend was hurt and began to petrify.
Choose 'That's not true!' and promise Luik that you will bring back something that proves the petrified Sapha in the cave, which ends this stage.
7065.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7066.description: Collect evidence from the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223) in the cave: a Shaggy Muffler (item 6085) and Bradium Fragments (item 6084), which you will bring back to Luik and Snorren.
guide: Examine the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223) in the cave, a giant statue that wears a muffler and holds something in its arms.
Choose 'Muffler' and then 'Fragment of Bradium', or the same two choices in the other order, to take the Shaggy Muffler (item 6085) and Bradium Fragments (item 6084).
Once you have both items, the stage is complete and the next step is to return to Luik (man_in01 19,126) and Snorren (man_in01 17,128).
7066.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7067.description: Show the Shaggy Muffler (item 6085) and Bradium Fragments (item 6084) to Luik and Snorren, who recognize the muffler as Ogen's and take the evidence to save him.
guide: Talk to Luik (man_in01 19,126) or Snorren (man_in01 17,128) with the Shaggy Muffler (item 6085) and Bradium Fragments (item 6084) in your inventory.
Snorren says the muffler is Ogen's and the bradium is unrefined; choose 'Calm down' when he rushes off, and Luik says the finest bradium from the Refinery can save Ogen.
Luik takes the muffler and bradium, promises to talk to his superiors, and the stage ends with Snorren asking which way to go; without both items, Luik asks for proof.
7067.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7068.description: At the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223), Snorren finds that Ogen cannot come back alive, mourns his friend who protected Terra, and then goes ahead to tell the townspeople.
guide: Go to the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223) in the cave while wearing the ring, since Snorren only joins you when the ring is equipped.
Examine the Petrified Sapha (nyd_dun01 58,223); Snorren says that Ogen cannot come back alive, and you choose 'You don't mean..?'.
Snorren says Ogen protected Terra, and then he goes on ahead to tell Luik and the townspeople, which completes this stage.
7068.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7069.description: Return to Snorren at the prison (man_in01 175,59), who says Terra is free and that Ogen has gone back to Mother Nature, and receive Manuk Coins (item 6080) for your help.
guide: Talk to Snorren (man_in01 175,59) after the cave; he says Luik wanted him to tell you that Terra, the Laphine, is free now.
Snorren (man_in01 175,59) says the Sapha are tired of fighting, asks you to check whether Terra got home safely, and says Ogen has gone back to Mother Nature.
Snorren (man_in01 175,59) thanks you and gives you Manuk Coins (item 6080), which completes this stage.
7069.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7070.description: Arc tells you that Terra is back in one piece but has not spoken since her return, and asks you to visit her home, Terra's Yai, to hear what happened.
guide: Talk to Splendide Guard (spl_in01 32,306), who speaks as Arc, after Terra's return; he says she is back in one piece but has not spoken a word since.
Arc (spl_in02 236,92) asks you to come by Terra's Yai, her Private Residence to the Southeast of the Splendide area, where he wants a detailed account.
Arc asks you to go to Terra's Yai later to hear what happened, which completes this stage.
7070.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7071.description: Visit Terra and Arc at Terra's Yai (spl_in02 236,92) to hear the full story of the cave and the Sapha, and receive Splendide Coins (item 6081) from Arc for completing the quest.
guide: Talk to Arc (spl_in02 236,92) at Terra's Yai, where Terra (spl_in02 239,93) is also present and has not spoken since her return.
Arc tells you that Terra went to the Sapha cave, that the two of them fought and were trapped, and that Ogen sacrificed himself to protect Terra; choose 'So that's what happened.' to continue.
Arc (spl_in02 236,92) thanks you, gives you Splendide Coins (item 6081) and experience, and completes the quest.
7071.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7074.description: Defeat a Rata (monster 2017) to complete this hunting quest.
guide: Talk to Manuk Galtun (manuk 252,116), who speaks as Strom, and choose 'Keep the peace.' to hear that the Rata and Duneyrr are the monsters Strom asks you to defeat.
Defeat 1 Rata (monster 2017) in the cave, as Strom asks, to prove that you are a strong and decent person.
Return to Manuk Galtun (manuk 252,116) once the Duneyrr hunt is also done; Strom gives you Manuk Coins (item 6080) and experience for both hunts.
7074.level_basis: fixed by the quest objective monster Rata (monster 2017)

7075.description: Defeat 1 x Duneyrr (monster 2018) in the cave.
guide: Talk to Manuk Galtun (manuk 252,116), who speaks as Strom, and choose 'Keep the peace.' to receive the Rata and Duneyrr task.
Defeat 1 Duneyrr (monster 2018) in the cave, as Strom asks, alongside the Rata hunt.
Return to Manuk Galtun (manuk 252,116) once the Rata and the Duneyrr are both defeated; Strom gives you Manuk Coins (item 6080) and experience.
7075.level_basis: fixed by the quest objective monster Duneyrr (monster 2018)

7076.description: Find and defeat the Runaway Dandelion Member (monster 2026, level 90) to complete the Wanted: Dandelion quest.
guide: Talk to Wanted Sign (mid_camp 192,239) and choose 'I accept that request.' to take Rin's request to find the Runaway Dandelion.
Defeat the Runaway Dandelion Member (monster 2026) that Rin's notice says is hiding in a cave, and be careful since the gang has a bad reputation.
Return to Pet Breeder (mid_camp 146,306), who speaks as Pinedel and asks for the hunt to be done, to receive Rin's treasure box (item 7444) and complete the quest.
7076.level_basis: The recommended level is 90, fixed by the quest objective monster Runaway Dandelion Member (monster 2026).

7077.description: Collect 10 Draco Eggs (item 6093) for the Pet Breeder (mid_camp 146,306), who wants to study them as cute pets.
guide: Talk to Pet Breeder (mid_camp 146,306), who speaks as Pinedel, choose 'Cute pet investigation.' and then 'Yes.' to take the request.
Pinedel says there is a Dragon nest in the cave you found, and asks you to collect 10 Draco Eggs (item 6093), which are hard to hatch in captivity.
Bring the 10 Draco Eggs (item 6093) to Pet Breeder (mid_camp 146,306) to finish this stage.
7077.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7078.description: Pinedel is raising the 10 Draco Eggs you delivered at the Pet Breeder (mid_camp 146,306) and asks you to come back after a day to check on them.
guide: Talk to Pet Breeder (mid_camp 146,306), who speaks as Pinedel, after handing in 10 Draco Eggs (item 6093); he says he will try to make them into cute pets.
Come back to Pet Breeder (mid_camp 146,306) after a day; if Pinedel says he still needs more time, return the next day.
When Pinedel says the eggs are about to hatch and that he will investigate them at home, this stage ends.
7078.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

7079.description: The player must hunt Bradium Golem and collect 20 blended Bradium to complete the quest.
guide: Talk to Manuk Engineer (man_in01 378,276) and choose 'About collecting stones.' to hear that the mine is clogged and that Bradium is needed for survival.
Manuk Engineer (man_in01 378,276) asks you to terminate the Bradium Golem and bring back Bradium; choose 'Sure, I don't mind.' to take the mission.
Hunt Bradium Golem and bring 20 Refined Bradium (item 6090) to Manuk Engineer (man_in01 378,276).

7080.description: Manuk Engineer thanks you for the Bradium you brought, says the supply is enough for now, and clears this quest when you return after the wait.
guide: Talk to Manuk Engineer (man_in01 378,276) after handing in 20 Refined Bradium (item 6090) for quest 7079; he gives you 40000 EXP and 3 Manuk Coins (item 6080), which starts this quest.
Talk to Manuk Engineer (man_in01 378,276) during the wait; he says the Enriched Bradium is more than enough for now.
Return to Manuk Engineer (man_in01 378,276) after the wait; he hopes you can help again and clears this quest.

7081.description: Laphine Craftsman requests 15 Crystallized Teardrop and 15 Fluorescent Liquid to make decorations for the Yai.
guide: Talk to Laphine Craftsman (spl_in01 97,313) to receive the request for materials
Collect 15 Crystallized Teardrop (item 6075) and 15 Fluorescent Liquid (item 7326) as requested
7081.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

7082.description: After you hand in the Crystallized Teardrop and Fluorescent Liquid, the Laphine Craftsman thanks you, says the materials are enough for now, and clears this quest after a wait.
guide: Talk to Laphine Craftsman (spl_in01 97,313) after handing in 15 Crystallized Teardrop (item 6075) and 15 Fluorescent Liquid (item 7326) for the earlier request; she says that is sufficient for the time being.
Talk to Laphine Craftsman (spl_in01 97,313) again after the wait; she thanks you and hopes you can help again, which clears this quest.
7082.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8000.description: Quitting the Assassin job change test puts you in this state, and the Ferocious-looking guy at the guild lets you apply again once you are a Thief at job level 40.
guide: Choose 'Quit the job change test for now.' with Barcardi (Test Guide, in_moc_16 21,165), which sets this state and warps you to in_moc_16 19,13.
Or choose 'I... I quit!' with Thomas (in_moc_16 89,98) during the hiding test, which also sets this state and warps you to in_moc_16 18,14.
Talk to the Guildsman (Ferocious-looking guy, in_moc_16 19,33) as a Thief and choose 'Yes. I've picked my last pocket.' to apply again; this changes this quest to the application state.
8000.level_basis: The level gate in the script is fixed by the Mummy (monster 1041, level 37)

8001.description: A Thief at job level 40 or higher applies for the Assassin job; the Guildsman sends you to the office, and Assassin 'Khai' takes your application form and sends you to the Test Hall.
guide: Talk to the Guildsman (Ferocious-looking guy, in_moc_16 19,33) as a Thief at job level 40 or higher and choose 'Yes. I've picked my last pocket.' to be sent to the office.
Talk to Assassin 'Khai' (in_moc_16 25,90) and choose 'Yes, I am.' to fill out the application form with your name and job level.
Khai (in_moc_16 25,90) accepts the form and transports you to the Test Hall at in_moc_16 19,144 for the next trial.
8001.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8002.description: The Anonymous One (in_moc_16 19,154) gives the Assassin written test of 10 questions on skills, stats and monsters, and you need 9 correct answers to pass.
guide: Talk to The Anonymous One (nameless_one, in_moc_16 19,154) and choose 'Skills' or 'Stats' to hear about them, or 'Hmpf, I know it all.' to go straight to the test.
Answer the 10 multiple-choice questions about Assassin skills, stats, weapons and monsters; 9 correct answers are needed to pass.
If you pass, The Anonymous One says another test awaits you; if you fail, you are sent back to the office at in_moc_16 19,76, where Khai (in_moc_16 25,90) can advise you.
8002.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8003.description: The Test Guide (in_moc_16 21,165), who speaks as Barcardi, sends you to the Test Hall to kill 6 Job change target monsters within 3 minutes while avoiding the decoy monsters.
guide: Talk to Test Guide (in_moc_16 21,165), who speaks as Barcardi, and go to the room above him to be transported to the Test Hall.
In the Test Hall (in_moc_16), kill at least 6 monsters named Job change target within the 3 minutes that Beholder (in_moc_16 1,1) announces.
Monsters named Job change creature, Job change dummy and similar are decoys; killing one warps you back to in_moc_16 19,161 to restart the test.
When all 6 Job change target monsters are dead, Beholder (in_moc_16 1,1) announces it and the quest moves on to the next stage.
8003.level_basis: The recommended level is 14, fixed by the monster Poporing (monster 1031, level 14) mentioned in the script

8004.description: A job change test to become an Assassin. The player must reach Barcardi at the opposite side of the room without killing any monsters.
guide: Talk to Thomas (in_moc_16 89,98), who explains that you must not kill any monster and must reach Barcardi on the opposite side of the room.
Cross the room among the Mummy and Hydra monsters without killing any of them; Thomas says running away or passing out fails the test.
Reach Barcardi (in_moc_16 87,48) on the other side, who congratulates you and sends you to the Guildmaster's room at in_moc_16 181,183.
