To quit, choose 'I... I quit!' with Thomas; he sends you to in_moc_16 18,14 and this quest moves to the quit state.
8004.level_basis: The recommended level is 37, fixed by the monster Mummy (monster 1041, level 37) in the script.

8005.description: The player receives a job change to become an Assassin and must proceed to the Guildmaster's room.
guide: Talk to Barcardi (in_moc_16 87,48), who congratulates you on passing the hiding test and says you may proceed to the Guildmaster's room.
Touch the Maze Assistant (in_moc_16 182,169); while this stage is active he warps you to in_moc_16 181,183 and the quest moves on to 8006.
8005.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8006.description: Go through the maze to the Guildmaster, answer his interview questions, and receive the Necklace of Oblivion (item 1008) and a token for the Assassin expert Huey.
guide: Touch the Maze Assistant (in_moc_16 182,169) to continue through the maze until he takes you into the Guildmaster's room at in_moc_16 167,113.
Talk to Guildmaster (in_moc_16 149,80) as a Thief and answer his questions about the priority of an Assassin, your reasons and your plans.
The Anonymous One, Huey and Beholder give their opinions of you, and the Guildmaster gives you a weapon as a present.
The Guildmaster gives you a token and the Necklace of Oblivion (item 1008), then sends you to the Assassin expert Huey at the entrance, which completes this stage.
8006.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8007.description: Bring the Necklace of Oblivion (item 1008) from the Guildmaster to the Assassin expert Huey at the Guildsman (in_moc_16 19,33) for approval.
guide: Talk to Guildsman (in_moc_16 19,33) as a Thief while carrying the Necklace of Oblivion (item 1008); Assassin Expert 'Huey' examines it.
If you have no necklace, Assassin Expert 'Huey' tells you to get the Necklace of Oblivion again and bring it to him before the guildmaster finds out.
When Huey approves the necklace, it is taken from your inventory and the quest moves on to 8008 for the job change.
8007.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8008.description: Assassin Expert 'Huey' approves your Necklace of Oblivion (item 1008) at the Guildsman (in_moc_16 19,33), and your Thief job changes to Assassin.
guide: Talk to Guildsman (in_moc_16 19,33) as a Thief while carrying the Necklace of Oblivion (item 1008); Assassin Expert 'Huey' says you have been approved.
Huey takes the Necklace of Oblivion, changes your job to Assassin and completes this quest, then tells you to do your best as an Assassin.
8008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8009.description: Bishop Paul (High Bishop, prt_church 16,41) accepts your application for the Priest job change and explains the Three Trials of Priesthood.
guide: Talk to High Bishop (prt_church 16,41), who speaks as Bishop Paul, and choose 'I want to be a Priest.' then 'Yes, I do.' to apply; you must have no unused skill points.
Bishop Paul explains the Three Trials: a pilgrimage to three ascetic Priests, spiritual training against Demons and the Undead, and a final promise of devotion.
Acolytes at job level 50 skip the pilgrimage and are sent to Father Peter (Peter S. Alberto, job_prist 24,187) for the spiritual training; others start the pilgrimage.
8009.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8010.description: On the pilgrimage, visit three ascetic Priests in order: Father Rubalkabara, Sister Mathilda and Father Yosuke, then report back to Bishop Paul (High Bishop, prt_church 16,41).
guide: Talk to High Bishop (prt_church 16,41), who speaks as Bishop Paul, to hear the order: Father Rubalkabara first, Sister Mathilda second and Father Yosuke third.
Meet Father Rubalkabara, northeast of the Prontera Ruins, then report to Bishop Paul (prt_church 16,41), who sends you to Sister Mathilda.
Meet Sister Mathilda, near Morocc southwest of Prontera, then report to Bishop Paul (prt_church 16,41), who sends you to Father Yosuke in a field northwest of Prontera.
Meet Father Yosuke, then return to Bishop Paul (prt_church 16,41), who says the pilgrimage is complete and sends you to spiritual training with Peter S. Alberto (job_prist 24,187).
8010.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8011.description: Father Peter (Peter S. Alberto, job_prist 24,187) explains the spiritual training against Undead and Demon creatures and sends you into the training area.
guide: Talk to High Bishop (prt_church 16,41), who speaks as Bishop Paul; when the pilgrimage is done or you are job level 50, he sends you to Father Peter for the spiritual training.
Talk to Peter S. Alberto (job_prist 24,187), who speaks as Father Peter, and listen to his explanation of the training against Undead and Demon creatures.
Choose 'I'm ready.' with Father Peter; he sends you to the training area at job_prist 24,44, where the Zombie_Generator starts the training.
8011.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8012.description: In the spiritual training area (job_prist 24,44), defeat the creatures that the Zombie_Generator spawns, then leave through the exit at job_prist 98,105 to finish the training.
guide: In the training area (job_prist 24,44), kill the creatures of darkness the Zombie_Generator spawns, as Father Peter told you to show no mercy.
Leave the training area through the exit at job_prist 98,105 (prst3_1); an Acolyte is sent back to the Sanctuary at prt_church 16,37.
After you leave by that exit, the quest moves on to the next stage, which is the oath of devotion with Sister Cecilia.
8012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8013.description: After the spiritual training, return to Sister Cecilia (prt_church 27,24), who says one last trial remains and begins your formal oath for the Priesthood.
guide: Leave the training area through prst3_1 (job_prist 98,105); an Acolyte is sent back to the Sanctuary at prt_church 16,37.
Talk to Sister Cecilia (prt_church 27,24), who says one last trial is left and begins the formal oath for the Priesthood, which starts the next stage.
8013.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8014.description: Sister Cecilia (prt_church 27,24) administers your oath of devotion to God; answering her questions honestly completes it and sends you to Bishop Paul.
guide: Talk to Sister Cecilia (prt_church 27,24) and answer her oath questions from the heart, starting with whether you will give your life to God.
Answer the remaining questions about helping others, sacrifice, public messages, luring monsters and following God; a wrong answer sends you away to reflect and return later.
Choose 'I do.' when she asks whether you will swear to adhere to God's teachings; this completes the oath and sends you to Bishop Paul (prt_church 16,41).
8014.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8015.description: Bishop Paul (High Bishop, prt_church 16,41) promotes you to Priest once all three trials are complete and you have no skill points left to spend.
guide: Talk to High Bishop (prt_church 16,41), who speaks as Bishop Paul, after your oath with Sister Cecilia; he says you have completed all three trials.
If you still have skill points, Bishop Paul asks you to use them first and then return to him.
Bishop Paul starts the promotion, which moves this quest on to 8016 for the job change itself.
8015.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8016.description: Bishop Paul completes your promotion to Priest and gives you a Book (item 1550) or a Bible (item 1551), depending on your job level.
guide: Talk to High Bishop (prt_church 16,41), who speaks as Bishop Paul, after the oath and with no skill points left, to start the promotion.
Bishop Paul says God grants his power, and your job changes to Priest; this completes the quest.
He gives you a Book (item 1550) if your job level is below 50, or a Bible (item 1551) at job level 50 or higher.
8016.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8017.description: Zelmeto, the field overseer of the factory, asks the player to inspect broken machines and their components to repair the factory's operations.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242), choose 'You're understaffed?' and then 'I can help you.' to accept the inspection work.
Find the 2nd Control Panel (ein_in01 49,232) and inspect it; its screws are missing and its iron cover is bent open, which moves the quest on.
Report back to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242), who then tells you which machine to check next.
8017.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8018.description: After you find the broken 2nd Control Panel (ein_in01 49,232), Zelmeto asks you to check the automatic pressure governors.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) after inspecting the 2nd Control Panel (ein_in01 49,232), and report what you found.
Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) says three automatic pressure governors flatten the bent iron plates and asks you to inspect them, which moves the quest on to 8019.
8018.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8019.description: Zelmeto asked you to inspect the automatic pressure governors; the one at 3rd Pressure Governor (ein_in01 108,217) makes grinding noises and has loose screws.
guide: Go to the automatic pressure governors in the factory and check them carefully, since Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) asked you to report any problem even if it seems small.
Inspect the 3rd Pressure Governor (ein_in01 108,217); at first it looks fine, but it makes grinding noises and a few surface screws are loose, which moves the quest on to 8020.
8019.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8020.description: Report the loose screws and grinding noises of the 3rd Pressure Governor (ein_in01 108,217) to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242), who then sends you to the bigger control panel.
guide: Go back to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) and report the grinding noises and loose surface screws of the 3rd Pressure Governor (ein_in01 108,217).

Zelmeto says the problem is worse than he expected and asks you to inspect the control panel in the middle of the factory, which is the same kind as the 2nd Control Panel but bigger; this moves the quest on to 8021.
8020.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8021.description: Inspect the Main Control Panel (ein_in01 62,258) in the middle of the factory, which sounds hollow and seems to be missing some parts.
guide: Find the Main Control Panel (ein_in01 62,258) in the middle of the factory, the bigger control panel that Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) asked you to check.
Inspect the Main Control Panel (ein_in01 62,258); its surface looks fine, but tapping it gives a hollow sound, which moves the quest on to 8022.
8021.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8022.description: Report the missing parts of the Main Control Panel (ein_in01 62,258) to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242), who thinks a short circuit burnt out its internal devices, and then check the mechanical hand.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) after inspecting the Main Control Panel (ein_in01 62,258), and tell him about the hollow sound and missing parts.
Zelmeto says a short circuit most likely burnt out the internal devices and asks you to check the mechanical hand that transports small objects next, which moves the quest on to 8023.
8022.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8023.description: Zelmeto asks you to inspect the small conveyor in the factory, and the Conveyor (ein_in01 46,197) shows jittery movements, a weak mechanical arm and rusted screws.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242), who asks you to inspect the small sized conveyor and not the large one.
Examine the Conveyor (ein_in01 46,197); its movements look jittery and clumsy, its mechanical arm looks weak, and its screws look loose and rusted, which moves the quest on to 8024.
8023.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8024.description: After you inspect the small conveyor, Zelmeto says there are too many things to fix and sends you to inspect a pipe near the large cauldrons of molten metal.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) after inspecting the Conveyor (ein_in01 46,197); he is surprised by the report and says there are too many things that need fixing.
Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) tells you to inspect the pipe inside the factory near the large cauldrons of molten metal, which moves the quest on to 8025.
8024.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8025.description: Zelmeto sends you to inspect a pipe, and the Pipe (ein_in01 100,266) is bloated and worn out from long overload.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242), who asks you to inspect an outdoor pipe that is located far outside the factory and should be easy to find.
Inspect the Pipe (ein_in01 100,266); it is bloated and worn out from long overload, which moves the quest on to 8026.
8025.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8026.description: After the pipe inspection, Zelmeto says the last machine is a large conveyor that is moved around the factory, and he does not know where it is now.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) after inspecting the Pipe (ein_in01 100,266); he says the repairs must start as soon as possible.
Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) says the last machine is a large conveyor, bigger and more powerful than the small one, and that he does not know where it is now.
Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) says the large conveyor is still somewhere inside the building, which moves the quest on to 8027.
8026.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8027.description: Zelmeto asks you to inspect the large conveyor, and the Conveyor (ein_in01 95,239) shows awkward, erratic and weak movements with almost all of its screws rusted.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242), who reminds you to inspect the large conveyor and not the small one.
Examine the Conveyor (ein_in01 95,239); its movements are awkward, erratic and weak, and almost all of its screws are rusted, which moves the quest on to 8028.
8027.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8028.description: Zelmeto says both conveyors have similar problems and that the repairs need enough materials, so he will ask his superintendent for a Factory Repair budget.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) after inspecting the large Conveyor (ein_in01 95,239); he says both conveyors have similar problems and that the repairs will be a hassle.
Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) says he will request an increase for the Factory Repair budget from the superintendent, which moves the quest on to 8029.
8028.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8029.description: Zelmeto asked for a Factory Repair budget, and the plant superintendent Liotzburg (einbroch 132,84) refuses it and says everything is fine.
guide: Talk to Liotzburg (einbroch 132,84), the plant superintendent, about the Factory Repair budget that Zelmeto asked for.
Liotzburg says the budget would be a waste of money and that Zelmeto is lying, which moves the quest on to 8030.
8029.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8030.description: Zelmeto reports that the superintendent rejected his repair proposal, and lists the materials needed: 20 Flexible Tube, 10 Rusty Screw and 10 Used Iron Plate.
guide: Talk to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) after Liotzburg (einbroch 132,84) refused the budget; he says his proposal was rejected and that maintenance is crucial.
Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) says the repairs need 20 Flexible Tube, 10 Rusty Screw and 10 Used Iron Plate, and that without funds there is no way to buy them, which moves the quest on to 8031.
8030.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8031.description: Zelmeto needs 20 Flexible Tube, 10 Rusty Screw and 10 Used Iron Plate to repair the factory, and he gives you experience when you hand them over.
guide: Bring 20 Flexible Tube, 10 Rusty Screw and 10 Used Iron Plate to Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242), who says the repairs need them.
Choose 'Give him materials.' with Zelmeto (ein_in01 67,242) to hand over the items; he thanks you, starts the repairs and gives you experience, which completes the quest.
8031.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8032.description: Captain Tarlock asks you to deliver his letter to his younger brother, Captain Ferlock, and come back with the reply.
guide: Talk to Captain Tarlock (airplane_01 238,154) and ask how the Airship flies; he keeps it secret the first time, so ask again at base level 60 or higher.
Choose 'Yes, I really want to know!' and then 'Sure.' with Captain Tarlock (airplane_01 238,154) to accept his favor and receive the letter for his brother.
Deliver the letter to Captain Ferlock (airplane 236,163), the younger brother, and bring back his reply for Tarlock.
8032.level_basis: Will of the Darkness (item 7340) is dropped by Hodremlin (level 61).

8033.description: Captain Ferlock asks you to get back 2 Will of the Darkness (item 7340) and 2 Prickly Fruit (item 576) that gremlins stole from him, so he can send his reply to Tarlock.
guide: Talk to Captain Ferlock (airplane 236,163) and choose 'Give him Tarlock's Letter.' to hand over the letter from his brother.
Ferlock asks you to get his 2 Will of the Darkness (item 7340) and 2 Prickly Fruit (item 576) back from the monsters that attack Tarlock's Airship.
Talk to Captain Ferlock (airplane 236,163) again with 2 Will of the Darkness and 2 Prickly Fruit in your inventory to hand them over and receive his reply, which moves the quest on to 8034.
8033.level_basis: Hodremlin (level 61) drops Will of the Darkness (item 7340).

8034.description: Report to Captain Tarlock (airplane_01 238,154) that you handed his letter to Captain Ferlock, who sent a reply that Tarlock says he will read.
guide: Talk to Captain Tarlock (airplane_01 238,154) and choose 'I handed the letter to Captain Ferlock.' to report Ferlock's answer.
Tarlock (airplane_01 238,154) says he will read Ferlock's letter and asks you to wait, which moves the quest on to 8035.
8034.level_basis: Will of the Darkness (item 7340) is dropped by Hodremlin (level 61).

8035.description: The Airship Captain Tarlock explains how the airship works, including the boiler, steam system, and Rune Mechanism amplifier that keeps it aloft.
guide: Talk to Captain Tarlock (airplane_01 238,154) after he hears Ferlock's answer; he says he will read the letter, which starts this stage.

Talk to Captain Tarlock (airplane_01 238,154) again with the option about the finished reading; he explains that the boiler's steam turns the propeller and that a Rune Mechanism amplifies the power, which completes the quest.
8035.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8036.description: Hallen, a crewman sweeping the deck, asks you to deliver Mr. Mawong's letter to Kaci, who runs the Dice game on the Airship.
guide: Talk to Hallen (airplane 236,63) and choose 'What is it' to hear his favor and receive the letter for Kaci.
Give the letter to Kaci (airplane 33,69) by choosing 'Give her the letter from Hallen.', which moves the quest on to 8037.
8036.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8037.description: Kaci thanks you for delivering the letter and answers your questions about Hallen, Mawong and the Airship before she goes back to work.
guide: Talk to Kaci (airplane 33,69) after she receives Mawong's letter; she thanks you because Hallen was too busy to deliver it himself.
Choose 'Ask about Hallen', 'Ask about Mawong' and 'Ask about the Airship' with Kaci (airplane 33,69) so she answers all three.
After all three answers, Kaci tells you to refuse Hallen's next favor and goes back to work, which moves the quest on to 8038.
8037.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8038.description: Hallen asks whether people should help each other in a crisis, and your answer decides whether he gives you a Red Potion or the quest moves on.
guide: Talk to Hallen (airplane 236,63) after Kaci sends you back; he says he is swamped with work and asks whether people should help each other in times of crisis.
Choose 'Not at all. Every man for himself!' to move the quest on to 8039, or 'Yes, I do.' to receive a Red Potion (item 501) from Hallen.
On a later talk, Hallen talks about Sage Varmunt and asks you to learn how the Airship flies, which moves the quest on to 8039.
8038.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8039.description: Hallen wants to know how the Airship flies, and once you learn the secret from Captain Tarlock you tell Hallen about the Rune Stone.
guide: Talk to Hallen (airplane 236,63), who asks what makes such a big Airship fly; if you have not learned it yet, he suggests asking Captain Ferlock or the other captains.
After Captain Tarlock (airplane_01 238,154) has explained the Airship's secret, choose 'Umm, yeah, kind of.' with Hallen (airplane 236,63) and tell him what you learned.
Choose 'Actually, there's another power source.' with Hallen (airplane 236,63) to reveal the Rune Stone, which moves the quest on to 8040.
8039.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8040.description: Hallen remembers that a drunkard at Kaci's Dice game often mentions Ymir's Heart Piece, and he gives you a Red Potion for the secret.
guide: Talk to Hallen (airplane 236,63) after telling him about the Rune Stone; he recalls that Kaci told him about a drunkard who mentions Ymir's Heart while playing Dice for Apples.
Hallen (airplane 236,63) gives you a Red Potion (item 501) for the information, which moves the quest on to the next stage.
8040.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8041.description: Kaci tells you that the drunkard who mentions Ymir's Heart is an Einbroch Lab Director, which makes you want to investigate the laboratory.
guide: Talk to Kaci (airplane 33,69) and choose 'Who's that drunk over there' to ask about the drunkard who plays her Dice game.
Kaci (airplane 33,69) says he is an Einbroch Lab Director who keeps losing Apples at Dice; you decide to investigate the Einbroch Laboratory, which moves the quest on to 8042.
8041.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8042.description: Enter the restricted archive of the Einbroch Laboratory by solving the Security System's 3 digit password, which reveals the Varmunt Project files.
guide: Go to lab03 (ein_in01 261,35) in the Einbroch Laboratory; the Security System denies access as an unauthorized person at first.
At lab03 (ein_in01 261,35), enter a 3 digit password with no 0 and no repeated digit, and use the correct-number and misplaced-number hints from the Password Checker to narrow it down within 5 tries.
When the password is correct, the archive opens and Ferlock (ein_in01 263,35) catches you reading the Varmunt Project file and tells you to visit him at the Airship, which moves the quest on to 8043.
8042.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8043.description: Captain Ferlock explains that the Rune Stones powering the Airships are made in the Einbroch Laboratory and that Gremlins controlled by Wills of the Darkness are trying to steal them.
guide: Talk to Airship Captain (airplane 236,163) after the Einbroch Laboratory archive; he asks why you were investigating Ymir's Heart Piece, and you choose 'Well, there's someone I need to help...' to hear more.
Choose 'I promise...' and then 'Wait, what's the Varmunt Project' so Ferlock explains that all Rune Stones are produced in the Einbroch Laboratory.
Talk to Airship Captain (airplane 236,163) again; he explains that Gremlins are being controlled with Wills of the Darkness to steal the Rune Stones and that Beholders watch the attacks.
Finish the conversation with Airship Captain (airplane 236,163) and keep his information to yourself to complete the quest.
8043.level_basis: Hodremlin (level 61) drops Will of the Darkness (item 7340)

8044.description: Euslan, who is sick, asks you to look for her fiancee Thierry, who left on an Airship to find medicine for her illness.
guide: Speak to Euslan (yuno 111,156) and, when she asks for help, choose 'Offer to find Thierry' to promise to search for him.
Talk to Kaci (airplane 33,69) and choose 'Do you know a guy named Thierry' to ask about him.
Kaci says the airship captain keeps the passenger list and may help, and she asks you to pass her regards to Euslan, which moves the quest on to 8045.
8044.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8045.description: Kaci suggests asking Airship Captain Ferlock about the passenger list, and he reveals that Thierry repaired an airship after a dragon attack on the Hugel route.
guide: Talk to Kaci (airplane 33,69) again; she says the airship captain may be able to help you find Thierry.
Talk to Airship Captain (airplane 236,163) and choose 'I am looking for a man named Thierry.' then 'Will you let me check the history of passenger lists.'

Keep talking to Airship Captain (airplane 236,163) until he says Thierry was one of the first passengers to Hugel and saved the airship, and asks you to tell Euslan where he is, which moves the quest on to 8046.
8045.level_basis: Will of the Darkness (item 7340) is dropped by Hodremlin (level 61).

8046.description: Euslan hears from you that Kaci works on the Airship and that Thierry went to Hugel, and she asks you to find him there and tell him she is alright.
guide: Talk to Euslan (yuno 111,156) and choose 'Well, I met Kaci on the Airship.' to tell her what you learned.
Euslan says Thierry went to Hugel and asks you to travel there and tell him she is alright, since she cannot go herself.
Euslan suggests asking her brother Eukran (que_bingo 53,190), a Bingo game coordinator in Hugel, where Thierry is, which moves the quest on to 8047.
8046.level_basis: Will of the Darkness (item 7340) is dropped by Hodremlin (level 61).

8047.description: Euslan's brother Eukran, a Bingo game coordinator in Hugel, hears about his sister's illness and tells you that Thierry went to the Odin Shrine.
guide: Talk to Eukran (que_bingo 53,190) and choose 'Talk about Euslan' to tell him about his sister's illness and her search for Thierry.
Eukran (que_bingo 53,190) says Thierry passed by about a month ago and went to the Odin Shrine, which may have something to help Euslan recover.
Eukran warps you to que_bingo 37,24, which moves the quest on to 8048.
8047.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8048.description: At Odin Shrine, the Young Man, who speaks as Thierry, tells you he is researching a cure for Euslan's disease and asks you to let her know he is coming home soon.
guide: Talk to Young Man (odin_tem01 130,134) at Odin Shrine and choose 'Mr. Thierry' to speak with him.
Choose 'Tell him about Euslan' with Thierry (odin_tem01 130,134) to tell him that Euslan sent you, and he asks you to let her know he is coming home soon.
Choose 'What are you doing here' with Thierry (odin_tem01 130,134) to hear that he is working on a cure for Euslan's disease, which moves the quest on to 8049.
8048.level_basis: Runes of the Darkness (item 7511) is dropped by Skeggiold (level 81).

8049.description: At Odin Shrine, Thierry asks you to trust him and tell Euslan he will be home soon, and you overhear Suspicious Men planning to get rid of him.
guide: Talk to Young Man (odin_tem01 130,134) at Odin Shrine, who speaks as Thierry; he says he cannot tell you more and asks you to tell Euslan he will be home very soon.
Walk onto the hidden spot at HiddenHugel (odin_tem01 111,144) to overhear a Suspicious Man and a Very Suspicious Man planning to get rid of Thierry, which moves the quest on to 8050.
8049.level_basis: Rune of Darkness (item 7511) is dropped by Skeggiold (level 81)

8050.description: Thierry explains that the men he works for are Rekenber agents, and he needs 5 Runes of the Darkness to finish the medicine for Euslan.
guide: Talk to Young Man (odin_tem01 130,134) at Odin Shrine and choose 'Warn Thierry about Suspicious Men' to tell him what you overheard.
Thierry (odin_tem01 130,134) says the Rekenber agents were using him, and that the cure for Euslan's disease needs 5 Runes of the Darkness to finish.
Thierry says he will hide from the men and asks you to help him get the runes, which moves the quest on to 8051.
8050.level_basis: Rune of Darkness (item 7511) is dropped by Skeggiold (level 81).

8051.description: Thierry needs 5 Runes of the Darkness to finish Euslan's medicine, and once you bring them he gives you the finished medicine to take to her.
guide: Talk to Young Man (odin_tem01 130,134), who speaks as Thierry; without 5 Runes of the Darkness in your inventory he asks you to bring them as soon as you can.

With 5 Runes of the Darkness (item 7511) in your inventory, talk to Young Man (odin_tem01 130,134) again; he takes the 5 runes, makes the medicine and gives it to you to bring to Euslan, which moves the quest on to 8052.
8051.level_basis: The recommended level 69 comes from the Rune of Darkness (item 7511) which is dropped by Frus at level 69.

8052.description: Thierry has made the medicine for Euslan's disease, and you deliver it to Euslan, who is relieved to know he will come home soon.
guide: Talk to Euslan (yuno 111,156) after Thierry has made the medicine; you tell her you found Thierry and that he procured medicine for her.
You give Euslan (yuno 111,156) the medicine as Thierry requested; she thanks you and the quest is complete.
8052.level_basis: Rune of Darkness (item 7511) is dropped by Frus (level 69)

8053.description: Allen Schuwell, a sick man, asks you to find his son Postell outside town and tell him to bring Kolbun A, his medicine.
guide: Talk to Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387,245) and choose 'Sure.' to accept his request to find his son Postell.
Head east outside the town and find Postell Schuwell (hu_fild06 34,123), and tell him that his father needs his Kolbun A now.
Choose 'But your father needs you!' with Postell Schuwell (hu_fild06 34,123) to agree to get the medicine to his father, which moves the quest on to 8054.
8053.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 49.

8054.description: Allen Schuwell is in agony and asks you for a White Potion, and you stay with him while his son Postell is on the way with the medicine.
guide: Talk to Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387,245) and choose 'Give White Potion' with a White Potion (item 504) in your inventory; without one, he asks you to bring one as soon as you can.
Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387,245) thanks you, says he is afraid of another attack before Postell arrives, and asks you to stay by his side, which moves the quest on to 8055.
8054.level_basis: The level gate in Allen's script requires BaseLevel > 49, setting recommended_level to 50.

8055.description: Allen Schuwell suffers a neutron attack and needs Withstander medicine from his drawer, and you stay with him until his son Postell arrives with the wrong medicine.
guide: Talk to Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387,245), who asks for his Withstander medicine from the drawer at hu_in01 370,255.
Give Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387,245) a dose of Withstander when he collapses again, and wait with him until his son arrives.
When Postell Schuwell (hu_in01 385,247) brings the wrong medicine, Allen thanks you and asks you to look inside the medicine drawer, which moves the quest on to 8056.
8055.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 49.

8056.description: Allen thanks you after his son brings the wrong medicine, and lets you take an Old Blue Box from his medicine drawer.
guide: Talk to Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387,245) after Postell brings the wrong medicine; Allen says he has not forgotten you and asks you to look inside the medicine drawer.
Search the Upper Drawer (hu_in01 370,255), where you find an Old Blue Box (item 603) deep inside, which completes the quest.
8056.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 49.

8057.description: Manainne is upset that El Schatt plans to cut down the town tree for his shop, which he says means a lot to everyone in the town.
guide: Talk to the tree at hugel 198,169, which starts the quest.
Talk to Manainne (hugel 191,172), who says the tree means much to everyone in the town and that El Schatt plans to chop it down for his shop.
Manainne (hugel 191,172) points out El Schatt (hugel 196,164) surveying the land for construction, which moves the quest on to 8058.
8057.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 49.

8058.description: El Schatt tells you he has let go of the past and plans to build shops and a plaza where the old tree stands.
guide: Talk to El Schatt (hugel 196,164) after Manainne points him out; he says memories are nice but he does not dwell on the past.
El Schatt (hugel 196,164) says his father has wanted to build a shop here and that the business will help the entire community.
El Schatt (hugel 196,164) says the town is quaint but he needs to look to the future, which moves the quest on to 8059.
8058.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8059.description: A dialogue quest where the player converses with Perfitz about his business plans and concerns regarding a tree in the area.
guide: Talk to Perfitz (hugel 100,103) after El Schatt has started his plans; he says he is pleased that his son has taken up the family business.
Perfitz (hugel 100,103) says he has a gut feeling that something is wrong with his son's eagerness to cut down the tree, which moves the quest on to 8060.
8059.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8060.description: El Schatt refuses to change his mind after Perfitz speaks to him, and admits he used to protect the old tree with his life.
guide: Talk to El Schatt (hugel 196,164) after Perfitz (hugel 100,103) has spoken with you; he asks whether you came to change his mind.
El Schatt (hugel 196,164) says the shops are final and admits he would have protected the old tree with his life, which moves the quest on to 8061.
8060.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8061.description: Manainne tells you that El Schatt once dated his older sister Kanainne, who died, and that El Schatt has since changed into a cold, money-driven man.
guide: Talk to Manainne (hugel 191,172) after El Schatt has shown his plans; he recalls that El Schatt and his older sister Kanainne spent time together under the tree.
Manainne (hugel 191,172) says Kanainne got sick and died, El Schatt disappeared, and he has now become heartless, which moves the quest on to 8062.
8061.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8062.description: In Niflheim, a spirit says it is Kanainne, Manainne's sister and El Schatt's lover, and asks you to return to Hugel so she can reach El Schatt.
guide: Talk to A Spirit (niflheim 90,106) in Niflheim, who remembers the names Manainne and El Schatt.
The spirit says her name is Kanainne, that she has been watching El Schatt, and that she needs your help to return to the living.
The spirit sends you back to Hugel (hugel 78,148), which moves the quest on to 8063.
8062.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8063.description: Kanainne's spirit speaks to El Schatt through her sister Manainne's body, and their reunion completes the quest.
guide: Talk to Manainne (hugel 191,172) after returning from Niflheim; she does not believe you met her dead sister and says she suddenly feels cold.
Talk to Manainne (hugel 191,172) again; she says she is Kanainne, the spirit you saw in Niflheim, and speaks to El Schatt through her sister's body.
Keep talking to Manainne (hugel 191,172) until she sings the song you wrote together and El Schatt (hugel 196,164) asks whether it is really Kanainne.
Talk to El Schatt (hugel 196,164) until Kanainne fades away; the quest is completed and you receive an Old Blue Box (item 603).
8063.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8064.description: Cellette Lavit hires you to deliver Fish Cake Soup orders, and your first order goes to her friend Neha.
guide: Talk to Cellette Lavit (hu_in01 15,372) and choose 'Sure, I'll work for you!' to take a delivery order; this order is a Fish Cake Soup (item 584) for Neha.
Deliver the Fish Cake Soup to Neha (hugel 76,134), who says the soup is late and asks for a Whip (item 1960), which completes this order and moves the quest on to 8068.
8064.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8065.description: Deliver Fish Cake Soup to Maewan as part of Cellette Lavit's quest.
guide: Talk to Cellette Lavit (hu_in01 15,372) and choose 'Sure, I'll work for you!' to receive a Fish Cake Soup (item 584) for Maewan.
Deliver the Fish Cake Soup to Maewan (hugel 87,139), who says you are late and asks you to bring a Bookclip in Memory, which moves the quest on to 8069.
8065.level_basis: Bookclip in Memory (item 7015) is dropped by Rideword (level 59).

8066.description: Deliver Fish Cake Soup to Layoma as part of Cellette's quest.
guide: Talk to Cellette Lavit (hu_in01 15,372) and choose 'Sure, I'll work for you!' to receive a Fish Cake Soup (item 584) for her roommate Layoma.
Deliver the Fish Cake Soup to Layoma (hugel 84,125), who scolds you for being late and asks you to bring a Mushroom Spore (item 921), which moves the quest on to 8070.
8066.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8067.description: Deliver Fish Cake Soup to Erjan, who wants a China to go with his meal.
guide: Talk to Cellette Lavit (hu_in01 15,372) and choose 'Sure, I'll work for you!' to receive a Fish Cake Soup (item 584) for Erjan.
Deliver the Fish Cake Soup to Erjan (hugel 102,161), who says you are awfully late and commands you to bring him a China (item 736), which moves the quest on to 8071.
8067.level_basis: China (item 736) is dropped by Peco Peco Egg (level 3).

8068.description: Neha, who got her Fish Cake Soup late, asks you to bring her a Whip (item 1960) before she accepts the soup.
guide: Talk to Neha (hugel 76,134) with the Fish Cake Soup (item 584); she says the soup is late and asks you to bring her a Whip (item 1960).
Bring the Whip (item 1960) and the Fish Cake Soup (item 584) to Neha (hugel 76,134); she takes both, hits you with the Whip and moves the quest on to 8072.
8068.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8069.description: Maewan asks you to bring him a Bookclip in Memory with his Fish Cake Soup, which he will add to his collection.
guide: Talk to Maewan (hugel 87,139) with a Fish Cake Soup (item 584) and a Bookclip in Memory (item 7015) in your inventory.
Maewan (hugel 87,139) takes the Bookclip in Memory and the soup and thanks you, which moves the quest on to 8073.
8069.level_basis: Death Word (level 65) drops the Bookclip in Memory (item 7015).

8070.description: Layoma wants a Mushroom Spore (item 921) with the Fish Cake Soup, and she takes both to finish this stage.
guide: Talk to Layoma (hugel 84,125) with a Mushroom Spore (item 921) and a Fish Cake Soup (item 584) in your inventory.
Layoma (hugel 84,125) takes the Mushroom Spore and the soup and asks you to tell Cellette not to come home so late, which moves the quest on to 8074.
8070.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8071.description: Deliver Fish Cake Soup and China to Erjan, first son of the Franchefeschu family.
guide: Talk to Erjan (hugel 102,161)
Deliver Fish Cake Soup (item 584) and China (item 736) to Erjan
8071.level_basis: China (item 736) is dropped by Peco Peco Egg (level 3).

8072.description: Neha, a hugel NPC, asks for a Whip and Fish Cake Soup as part of Cellette's soup delivery. You hand both items to her.
guide: Deliver Fish Cake Soup (item 584) to Neha (hugel 76,134)
Deliver a Whip (item 1960) to Neha (hugel 76,134)
8072.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8073.description: Deliver Fish Cake Soup to Maewan (hugel 87,139) by bringing the required Bookclip in Memory item.
guide: Bring 1 Bookclip in Memory (item 7015) to Maewan (hugel 87,139).
Hand Maewan your Fish Cake Soup (item 584) at the same visit.
8073.level_basis: Bookclip in Memory (item 7015) is dropped by Rideword (level 59).

8074.description: Deliver Fish Cake Soup to Layoma in Hugel. The quest requires bringing Mushroom Spore and Fish Cake Soup to the NPC.
guide: Bring 1 Mushroom Spore (item 921) and 1 Fish Cake Soup (item 584) to Layoma.
Layoma will accept the items and advance the quest to 8070, 8074.
8074.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8075.description: Deliver Fish Cake Soup and China to Erjan, the first son of the Franchefeschu family.
guide: Deliver Fish Cake Soup (item 584) and China (item 736) to Erjan (hugel 102,161).
Erjan asks for China first; once you have both items, he accepts them and dismisses you.
8075.level_basis: China (item 736) is dropped by Peco Peco Egg (level 3), which sets the level.

8076.description: Klitzer tells you about his love for Calla, and Calla asks you to take her Violin (item 1901) to him.
guide: Talk to Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101), who tells you how much he misses Calla (ein_in01 31,138).
Talk to Calla (ein_in01 31,138), who asks you to take her Violin (item 1901) to Klitzer and hands it to you.
8076.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8077.description: Calla's Violin (item 1901) is taken to Klitzer, who then asks you to bring Calla a Flower (item 712).
guide: Give Calla's Violin (item 1901) to Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101). He takes it and asks you to bring Calla a Flower (item 712).
If you touch Megass (ein_in01 21,147) while carrying the Violin, he takes it and sends you out, moving the quest to 8078.
8077.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8078.description: After Megass takes the Violin (item 1901), Calla gives it back to you and asks you to try again with Klitzer.
guide: Talk to Calla (ein_in01 31,138) after Megass has taken the Violin; she gives you a Violin (item 1901) again.
Calla asks you to take the Violin to Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101) this time.
8078.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8079.description: Klitzer asks you to bring a Flower (item 712) to Calla as a gift from him.
guide: Bring a Flower (item 712) to Calla (ein_in01 31,138).
When Calla asks, type your character name; she takes the Flower and asks you to tell Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101) that she misses him.
8079.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8080.description: After the Flower is delivered to Calla, Klitzer asks for your name and thanks you for your help.
guide: Talk to Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101) after Calla has the Flower.
When Klitzer asks, type your character name exactly; he thanks you and suggests you talk to his mother.
8080.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8081.description: Kaijeta asks how the hatred between the two towns can end, and Satra then asks you to bring Coal (item 1003).
guide: Talk to Kaijeta (ein_in01 191,102), Klitzer's mother, who asks how the hatred between the two towns can end.
Talk to Satra (ein_in01 31,151), who asks you to bring her Coal (item 1003).
8081.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8082.description: Kaijeta, Klitzer's mother, laments the hatred between the two towns that keeps her son from seeing the woman he loves. Satra then asks you to bring Coal (item 1003).
guide: Talk to Kaijeta (ein_in01 191,102), who says the feud between the two towns keeps her son from seeing the woman he loves.
Talk to Satra (ein_in01 31,151), who asks you to bring her Coal (item 1003).
8082.level_basis: Coal (item 1003) is dropped by monsters from level 25 to 61, too wide to pick one level.

8083.description: Satra asks you to bring her 10 Coal (item 1003). She accepts the Coal and moves the quest on.
guide: Bring 10 Coal (item 1003) to Satra (ein_in01 31,151).
Satra accepts the Coal and asks whether you hail from Einbech.
8083.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8084.description: Satra keeps asking for Coal (item 1003), then asks who gathered it. Answering Klitzer moves the quest on.
guide: Bring Satra (ein_in01 31,151) 10 Coal (item 1003) when she asks; she asks for more Coal after each delivery.
Bring 10 Coal (item 1003) once more and, when Satra asks who gathered it, type Klitzer.
8084.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8085.description: Satra asks you to tell Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101) to visit her soon and dress appropriately. Klitzer then hears about the tea invitation and worries about what to wear.
guide: Tell Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101) that Satra (ein_in01 31,151) wants him to visit soon and dress appropriately.
Klitzer hears that Calla's mother wants to have tea with him and says his monkey suit will not do.
8085.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8086.description: Klitzer needs something nicer to wear before meeting Calla's mother, and his mother Kaijeta says a man should wear a Formal Suit or a Tuxedo.
guide: Talk to Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101), who is worried he has nothing good enough to wear for Calla's mother.
Talk to Kaijeta (ein_in01 191,102), who says a man should wear a Formal Suit or a Tuxedo for important meetings.
8086.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8087.description: Klitzer asks for a Tuxedo (item 7170) to wear to meet Calla's mother. If you give it to him, he hands you one of several ores in return.
guide: Talk to Klitzer (ein_in01 200,101) while carrying a Tuxedo (item 7170) and choose 'Give it to him.'
Klitzer takes the Tuxedo and gives you one of several ores: Olivine, Phlogopite, Agate, Rose_Quartz, Turquoise, Citrine or Pyroxene.
8087.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8088.description: Calla thanks you for helping Klitzer and gives you a massage, which completes the quest.
guide: Talk to Calla (ein_in01 31,138), who says her mother is planning tea with Klitzer and offers you a massage.
Accept the massage; Calla thanks you and the quest is completed.
8088.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8089.description: Vincent asks you to find the gem taken from Sir Zhed's mansion and to find Phobe, the servant he suspects took it.
guide: Talk to Vincent (ra_in01 384,246), who asks you to retrieve the gem and find out who stole it.
Talk to Logan (rachel 114,232), who tells you Phobe has been missing since he went to the market.
8089.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8090.description: Manson, a mansion servant, says he sent the missing servant Phobe to the market for errands and thinks he is hiding.
guide: Talk to Manson (ra_in01 372,200) inside the mansion; he says he sent Phobe to the market for errands and thinks Phobe is hiding somewhere.
8090.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8091.description: Manson sends you to Jenny, the gardener, who knows Phobe and suggests checking the market where he was last seen.
guide: Talk to Manson (ra_in01 372,200), who says Phobe is hiding somewhere and tells you to ask Jenny.
Talk to Jenny (rachel 48,237), who says Phobe is a good boy and suggests checking the market where he was last seen.
8091.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8092.description: A quest to find the missing boy Phobe. The player must search the market and the ice cave to locate him, with guidance from NPCs Jenny and the Idle Merchant.
guide: Speak with Jenny (rachel 48,237) about finding Phobe and searching the market
Talk to the Idle Merchant (rachel 120,47) at the market; he passes on a message asking you to come to the ice cave.
8092.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8093.description: The player must find information about a missing boy named Phobe and deal with the mysterious man Rogan. The quest involves conversations with the Idle Merchant and Suspicious Man.
guide: Talk to Idle Merchant (rachel 120,47) to learn about Phobe and the ice cave.
Ask the Suspicious Man (ra_fild01 245,325) about Rogan; he attacks, then says Vincent hired him to kill anyone asking about Rogan.
8093.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8094.description: The quest Double Crossed involves retrieving a stolen gem from Phobe before Sir Zhed returns, as revealed by Vincent and Suspicious Man.
guide: Talk to the Suspicious Man (ra_fild01 245,325), who says Vincent set you up.
Talk to Vincent (ra_in01 384,246), who admits Phobe is his son and asks you to keep it secret.
Agree to help Vincent find Phobe and the jewel before Sir Zhed returns.
8094.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8095.description: Find Phobe, the missing servant who disappeared around the time Sir Zhed's jewel was stolen.
guide: Find Phobe, the Kid at rachel 263,32, and talk to him.
He refuses to go home but hands you the red jewel he had in his pocket; take the jewel to Vincent (ra_in01 384,246).
8095.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8096.description: Phobe has handed you the stolen jewel, which you bring back to Vincent. Vincent then asks you to tell his wife that their boy is safe.
guide: Give the red jewel to Vincent (ra_in01 384,246). He asks whether you found Phobe and thanks you.
Tell Vincent that Phobe is safe near Freya's Spring; he asks you to tell his wife that their boy is okay.
8096.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8097.description: Vincent asks you to tell his wife Jenny that Phobe is safe. You then tell Jenny, who thanks you for your help.
guide: Talk to Vincent (ra_in01 384,246), who asks you to tell his wife Jenny that their boy is okay.
Tell Jenny (rachel 48,237) that Phobe is safe and the gem was returned; she thanks you.
8097.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8098.description: Vincent sends you to his master with a note and package, and rewards you with an Old Violet Box (item 617).
guide: Talk to Vincent (ra_in01 384,246), who thanks you for telling Jenny and asks you to take a note and package to his master.
Vincent gives you an Old Violet Box (item 617) and a letter of recommendation for his master.
8098.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8099.description: Deliver Vincent's note and package to High Priest Zhed, who reads the note and completes the quest with thanks.
guide: Talk to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159) and say you are here on Vincent's behalf.
Hand over the note and package; Zhed reads Vincent's note and thanks you for your help.
8099.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8100.description: High Priest Zhed asks you to gather 40 Glacial Hearts, then show them with his recommendation to the soldiers at the pope's office.
guide: Meet High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159) to receive the recommendation
Gather 40 Glacial Hearts as required by the recommendation
Head west from the chapel to the pope's office
Show the recommendation and Glacial Hearts to the soldiers guarding the office
8100.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8101.description: After your audience with the pope, High Priest Zhed asks about your conversation, warns you to feign ignorance of the Holy Ground, and has you wait in the next room.
guide: Talk to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159) after seeing the pope; he asks about your conversation with her.
Tell him she mentioned the Holy Ground; he asks you to feign ignorance of it and to wait in the next room.
8101.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8102.description: High Priest Zhed has you wait in the next room while he finishes his business, then asks what your conversation with High Priestess Niren was about.
guide: Talk to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159) after the pope's audit; he asks you to wait and relax in the next room.
When Zhed calls you back, tell him about your conversation with High Priestess Niren.
8102.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8103.description: High Priest Zhed explains that Bekento is his full name, asks about your talk with Niren, and warns you to stay away from the Holy Ground.
guide: Talk to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159); he apologizes for the wait and lets you ask about Bekento.
Tell him about your talk with High Priestess Niren; he says he will explain later and warns you not to go near the Holy Ground.
8103.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8104.description: High Priest Zhed repeats his warning to stay away from the Holy Ground, which you feel more and more compelled to enter.
guide: Talk to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159); he asks you to stay away from the Holy Ground whatever journeys you take.
Speak to Zhed again; he repeats the warning, and you feel compelled to enter the Holy Ground anyway.
8104.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8105.description: After you visit the Holy Ground, High Priest Zhed says he is suspended, asks you to keep quiet about what you saw, and completes the quest.
guide: Talk to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159) after you have visited the Holy Ground; he says he has been temporarily suspended from work.
Listen as Zhed asks you not to tell anyone what you saw in the Holy Ground; the quest then completes.
8105.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8106.description: Mr. Shendar worries that his daughter Bruspetti has gone off with a boyfriend without writing home, and Lachellen says the boyfriend grew up in Lighthalzen.
guide: Talk to Mr. Shendar (ra_in01 250,19); he says his daughter Bruspetti went to another town for a boy and has not written since.
Talk to Lachellen (rachel 73,244); she says Bruspetti is serious about him, but she knows only that he grew up in Lighthalzen.
8106.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8107.description: Katinshuell says he and his girlfriend are finished and that adventurers like you have nothing better to do than meddle.
guide: Talk to Katinshuell (ra_in01 235,194); he calls you one of the do-gooder adventurers and says you must have nothing else to do.
He says that he and his girlfriend are history and it is over between them; the quest moves on after this talk.
8107.level_basis: Knife (item 1201) is dropped by Soldier Skeleton (level 29).

8108.description: Mr. Shendar misses his daughter Bruspetti and says she always smelled pleasant, just like her mother.
guide: Talk to Mr. Shendar (ra_in01 250,19); he misses his daughter and says she had a distinctively pleasant scent, like her mother.
8108.level_basis: The recommended level is based on the item dropper level of Soldier Skeleton (level 29) which drops Knife (item 1201).

8109.description: Following the scent Mr. Shendar described, you find a spot on lhz_in02 where the smell of rose petals is strong.
guide: Go to lhz_in02 213,207, the spot where the scent trigger is.
Stand there; you notice the rose-petal scent that Mr. Shendar mentioned and the quest moves on.
8109.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8110.description: Lachellen says Bruspetti went travelling to learn about her boyfriend and suggests you check where the two of them used to go on dates.
guide: Talk to Lachellen (rachel 73,244); she says Bruspetti's father is known for her scent and that she has not come back from travelling.
She adds that Bruspetti may be in Lighthalzen learning about her boyfriend and suggests checking where the two of them went on dates.
8110.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8111.description: Lachellen knows where Bruspetti and her boyfriend used to meet but cannot give directions. The spring at rachel 265,47 then warns you that its ground is slippery.
guide: Talk to Lachellen (rachel 73,244); she knows the meeting place by feel but cannot give directions, and says the town is small enough to find it.
Walk to the spring at rachel 265,47; Grandma warns you that the ground is slippery and not to get too close to the water.
8111.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8112.description: Mr. Shendar says his daughter Bruspetti went to Lighthalzen to look into something that was bothering her, and he will not read her diary.
guide: Talk to Mr. Shendar (ra_in01 250,19); he says Bruspetti left only vague words about needing to go somewhere.
He says he cannot bring himself to read the diary she left on her drawer, and he worries about her.
8112.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8113.description: You find Bruspetti's diary on a book at ra_in01 255,25, but reading it would feel like a violation, so you leave it alone.
guide: Examine the book at ra_in01 255,25; it is Bruspetti's diary.
The text says reading it would make you feel like a real creep, so you leave it alone; the quest moves on.
8113.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8114.description: Katinshuell is depressed and answers one question you ask about Lighthalzen, Bruspetti or Freya's Spring before telling you to stop prying.
guide: Talk to Katinshuell (ra_in01 235,194); he says he is depressed and asks what you want to ask him about.
Ask him about Lighthalzen, Bruspetti or Freya's Spring; he answers briefly and tells you to quit prying into his personal business.
8114.level_basis: Knife (item 1201) is dropped by Soldier Skeleton (level 29).

8115.description: Lachellen says Katinshuell often goes to Freya's Spring, where Bruspetti and her boyfriend used to meet, and wonders whether the two of them were together.
guide: Talk to Lachellen (rachel 73,244); she offers to answer questions about Bruspetti and her boyfriend.
Ask her about Freya's Spring; she says Katinshuell goes there often and wonders whether he and Bruspetti were together.
8115.level_basis: Knife (item 1201) is dropped by Soldier Skeleton (level 29)

8116.description: Grandma at the spring says a young man often stares sadly into the water there, and she tells you to let go of your worries.
guide: Talk to Grandma (rachel 266,35); she says the same young man often comes to the edge of the spring and stares into the water.
Listen as she tells you to let go of whatever is bothering you and enjoy life; the quest moves on after this talk.
8116.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8117.description: Mr. Shendar mistakes you for a prowler and hits you, then asks you to find his daughter's diary to learn more about Katinshuell.
guide: Talk to Mr. Shendar (ra_in01 250,19); he takes you for the prowler and hits you, taking half your HP.
Tell him Katinshuell may be the one sneaking around; he asks you to find his daughter's diary and read it to learn about this guy.
8117.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8118.description: A conversation with Mr. Shendar about his daughter Bruspetti and her relationship with Katinshuell.
guide: Talk to Mr. Shendar (ra_in01 250,19); tell him you suspect Katinshuell is Bruspetti's boyfriend, and he says he will hate and distrust him.
Take Bruspetti's diary from the book at ra_in01 255,25; the book gives you permission to take it with you.
8118.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8119.description: Katinshuell is shown Bruspetti's diary, which you toss at his feet, and it opens to a page in the middle.
guide: Talk to Katinshuell (ra_in01 235,194) while carrying Bruspetti's Diary (item 7571); he says he is still coping with the break-up.
Tell him you think he is hiding something; then toss the diary (item 7571) at his feet, and it opens to a page in the middle.
8119.level_basis: Knife (item 1201) is dropped by Soldier Skeleton (level 29).

8120.description: Katinshuell refuses to say what Bruspetti learned at Freya's Spring, even after you read her diary and question him about it.
guide: Talk to Katinshuell (ra_in01 235,194); he says this is an interrogation and tells you to ask anything.
Ask him what Bruspetti learned about him at Freya's Spring; he says he does not have to tell you anything and the quest moves on.
8120.level_basis: Knife (item 1201) is dropped by Soldier Skeleton (level 29).

8121.description: Katinshuell confesses that he was paid to kill a wealthy boy and that Bruspetti drowned herself at Freya's Spring. The Knife (item 1201) is taken when he tells you to turn him in.
guide: Talk to Katinshuell (ra_in01 235,194) while carrying the Knife (item 1201); he confesses that he was paid to kill a wealthy boy.
Talk to him again with the Knife; he says to turn him in if you want, and the Knife is taken from you.
8121.level_basis: Knife (item 1201) is dropped by Soldier Skeleton (level 29).

8122.description: You return to the spring where Bruspetti drowned, a Grandma warns you about the slippery edge, and your reflection on Katinshuell's guilt completes the quest.
guide: Go to the spring at rachel 265,47 where Bruspetti drowned; a Grandma warns you that the ground is slippery.
Return to the spring; you reflect on Katinshuell's guilt, and the quest is completed with experience.
8122.level_basis: Knife (item 1201) is dropped by Soldier Skeleton (level 29).

8123.description: Einon recommends Mali the Spicy, who asks you to bring Shrimps, Chiles and Lemons so she can cook you a Tom Yum Goong.
guide: Talk to Einon (ayothaya 196,265), who recommends you ask Mali the Spicy to cook Tom Yum Goong for you.
Talk to Mali the Spicy (ayo_in01 145,163); she asks for Shrimps, Chiles and Lemons and tells you to buy the Shrimps from Thongpool.
8123.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8124.description: Mali the Spicy rejects scratched Shrimps and sends you back to Thongpool, then accepts fresh Shrimps and asks you to find Lemons.
guide: Talk to Mali the Spicy (ayo_in01 145,163); if your Shrimps are scratched she sends you back to Thongpool for fresher ones.
Bring her 20 fresh Shrimps; she takes them and asks you to bring Lemons.
Choose 'Where can I find Lemons?'; she says a lemon tree belongs to an ordinary man who is not a Fruit Merchant, and the quest moves on.
8124.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8125.description: Mali the Spicy rejects common Lemons, then takes 10 fresh Lemons and sends you to the Market for Chiles.
guide: Talk to Mali the Spicy (ayo_in01 145,163) with Lemons; she says common Lemons are not good enough for her Tom Yum Goong.
Bring 10 fresh Lemons; she takes them and tells you to buy Chiles and other materials in the Market.
8125.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8126.description: Mali the Spicy asks you to get the Chiles from the Market, then cooks Tom Yum Goong with 30 Chiles and gives you 10 of them.
guide: Talk to Mali the Spicy (ayo_in01 145,163); she asks you to take a look in the Market for the last ingredients.
Bring her 30 Chiles (Red Chile, item 7286) with room in your inventory; she cooks the Tom Yum Goong and gives you 10 of them.
8126.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8127.description: Grandma and Grandpa ask you to defeat the Dokebi who hacked their account, and Coach then reacts to your performance and offers a challenge.
guide: Walk up to Grandma at ama_test 50,93; she says someone hacked her account and stole her equipment, and Grandpa asks you to hunt Dokebi.
Talk to Coach (ama_test 50,100); his reply to your performance decides whether he offers a final challenge.
8127.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8128.description: The Publisher offers the Momotaro Field Trip, in which you become Momotaro and eliminate Dokebis, to players at Base Level 30 or higher.
guide: Talk to Publisher (amatsu 223,236) and choose 'I want to try!' to hear about the field trip.
At Base Level 30 or higher you fill out the registration card, and the Publisher sends you to the field trip at ama_test 52,35.
8128.level_basis: The level gate in the Publisher script requires BaseLevel > 29.

8129.description: After you accept Coach's challenge, you fight Am Mut in his final battle, and when time is up Coach sends you out.
guide: Accept Coach's challenge ('Bring it on') at ama_test 50,100; he starts the last battle against Am Mut (ama_test 34,17).
After the battle, walk up to Coach (ama_test 50,100); he says time is up and lets you go.
8129.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 29.

8130.description: After the field trip ends, Publisher thanks you and gives you a random reward for taking part.
guide: Talk to Publisher (amatsu 223,236) after the field trip; she asks how it was and says she hopes you had a good time.
She gives you a random reward item, and the quest is completed.
8130.level_basis: The level gate in the Publisher script requires BaseLevel > 29.

8131.description: The player must help the Lord of Palace (ama_in02) cure his sick mother in Amatsu. The mother has been ill for months and needs treatment.
guide: Talk to Gate Soldier (amatsu 164,174) to learn about the mother's illness and her need for rest.
Talk to Lord of Palace (ama_in02 200,176) to receive a reward if the player successfully cures his mother's disease.
8131.level_basis: 51 comes from Nine Tail (level 51), which drops Nine Tails (item 1022)

8132.description: Ishida Yoshinaga, lord of Toukoujyo in Amatsu, asks you to treat his mother's illness at her house outside the palace.
guide: Talk to Ishida Yoshinaga (ama_in02 200,176) at the palace; he asks you to cure his mother, who lives in a house outside the palace.
Talk to Kouji (amatsu 189,166), who says a fox is following him and that the North Shrine Priest should help.
Talk to Kitsune Mask (ama_in01 180,173) at the North Shrine; Takehue explains that a stronger spirit can expel the fox.
8132.level_basis: Nine Tail (level 51) is an item dropper that sets the recommended level for this quest.

8133.description: Kouji says a fox is following him and that the North Shrine Priest should help, and Takehue at the shrine explains how a stronger spirit can expel it.
guide: Talk to Kouji (amatsu 189,166), who says a fox is following him and that the North Shrine Priest should help.
Talk to Kitsune Mask (ama_in01 180,173) at the North Shrine; Takehue says a stronger spirit will expel the fox and asks you to yell to show your spirit.
8133.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8134.description: Takehue at the Northern Shrine teaches you to show spiritual energy, then you try to expel the fox that possesses Ishida Saoko, the lord's mother.
guide: Talk to Kitsune Mask (ama_in01 180,173) at the Northern Shrine; Takehue says to show your spiritual energy to the fox several times.
Talk to Grandma (ama_in01 22,111) and select 'Taaaah!!' to try to expel the fox from her body.
If the expulsion works, the script spawns and removes a Nine Tail monster and Grandma gives you Nine Tails (item 1022); if it fails, she warps you to Amatsu (amatsu 167,197).
8134.level_basis: The recommended level is fixed by Nine Tail (monster 1180, level 51), which the script spawns when the fox is expelled.

8135.description: Ishida Yoshinaga rewards you with a Lord's Passable Ticket (item 7160) once you bring him Nine Tails (item 1022) after his mother is freed of the fox.
guide: Ask Grandma (ama_in01 22,111) to expel the fox; if it works, she gives you Nine Tails (item 1022).
Talk to Lord of Palace (ama_in02 200,176) with Nine Tails (item 1022); he takes it, gives you a Lord's Passable Ticket (item 7160), and the quest is completed.
8135.level_basis: The recommended level is fixed by the monster Nine Tail (monster 1180, level 51) named in the script.

8136.description: A Sage on the forest road asks to see a Poring Card, then warns of a mysterious stone where the road splits and adventurers have been lost.
guide: Talk to Sage (mosk_fild02 198,252) and show him a Poring Card (item 4001); he tells you adventurers have been lost in the forest.
Read the Mysterious Stone (mosk_dun01 169,162) and choose Right, Left or Middle; Right drains your health, Left curses you, and Middle moves you on toward Gray Wolf (mosk_dun01 167,160).
8136.level_basis: Poring Card (item 4001) is dropped by Poring (level 1).

8137.description: Gray Wolf in the forest warns that Koshei, the Immortal, has been freed, and tells you to leave before he finds you.
guide: Take the middle path at the Mysterious Stone (mosk_dun01 169,162), then talk to Gray Wolf (mosk_dun01 167,160).
When Gray Wolf asks why you ignored the stone's warning, ask whether he is the reason adventurers are lost; he names Koshei, the Immortal, and warns you to leave.
If you stay after the warning, Gray Wolf (mosk_dun01 167,160) attacks you and jumps into the bushes, and you are warped to mosk_dun01 190,47.
8137.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8138.description: The Blacksmith requests materials to craft a Golden Key that can release Maria from captivity.
guide: Talk to Gray Wolf (mosk_dun01 167,160); he asks for your help against Koshei and carries you to mosk_dun01 45,257.
Talk to The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127), who says the Golden Key needs 2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair and 10 Golden Thread.
Ask The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127) where to find the Red Ring, Lusalka's Hair or Golden Thread; he points to Vassili, the mother of a lost maid in the village, and Marozka.
Wear Iron Boots (item 2429 or 2430) while gathering the materials; the Blacksmith says you cannot get anything for the key without them.
8138.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8139.description: Help Maria Morebna free herself from the wall by obtaining the Golden Key and using it to release her from imprisonment.
guide: Talk to Wall (mosk_dun01 45,259), where Maria Morebna asks you to find the Golden Key from a keymaker in Moscovia.
Talk to The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127), who explains the Golden Key needs 2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair and 10 Golden Thread.
Use the Golden Key (item 7876) at Wall (mosk_dun01 45,259) by shouting the phrase the girl's voice gives you; Maria appears and Koshei, the Immortal, attacks.
8139.level_basis: The recommended level is 85, fixed by the monster The Immortal Koshei (level 85) in the script.

8140.description: The Blacksmith explains that the Golden Key needs Cursed Ruby, Gold, a Red Ring, Lusalka's Hair and Golden Thread, and that the Red Ring is with his friend Vassili.
guide: Talk to The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127), who says he will explain the Golden Key once you bring him 25 Steel (item 999).
Ask The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127) about the Red Ring; he gave his to his friend Vassili and says you must ask Vassili for it.
Wear Iron Boots (item 2429 or 2430) while gathering the materials, since the Blacksmith says you cannot get anything for the key without them.
8140.level_basis: The Immortal Koshei (monster 1890, level 85) sets the recommended level in the script.

8141.description: Once you bring 25 Steel (item 999), The Blacksmith forges Iron Boots for you and lists the materials for the Golden Key, including the Red Ring (item 7877).
guide: Bring 25 Steel (item 999) to The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127); he melts it down and gives you Iron Boots (item 2429 or 2430).
Wear the Iron Boots while gathering the materials; The Blacksmith needs 2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring (item 7877), 2 Lusalka's Hair (item 7878) and 10 Golden Thread (item 7879).
Bring the materials to The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127), who says he can make the key whenever you deliver them.
8141.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8142.description: The Blacksmith confirms you have the Golden Key materials, casts Spellshield Protection on you, and sends you to the keymaker's cabin deep in the forest.
guide: Talk to The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127) with the Golden Key materials while wearing Iron Boots (item 2429 or 2430); he says you have everything.
The Blacksmith (moscovia 178,127) casts Spellshield Protection on you, takes your Iron Boots (item 2429 or 2430), and says the keymaker's cabin is deep inside the forest.
8142.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8143.description: Vassili Grandpapa says he gave the Red Ring to his daughter Mashenka, who died, and Ryubaba later says Mashenka disappeared near the marsh. Playing the Wooden Flute (item 7883) for Vassili gets you the Red Ring (item 7877).
guide: Ask Vassili Grandpapa (moscovia 206,81) about the Red Ring; he says he gave it to his youngest daughter Mashenka, who died.
Ask Ryubaba (moscovia 213,216) about the Red Ring; she says Mashenka went out and disappeared around the marsh.
Play the Wooden Flute (item 7883) for Vassili Grandpapa (moscovia 206,81); he hears Mashenka's voice, takes the flute, and gives you the Red Ring (item 7877).
8143.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8144.description: Ryubaba says her baby sister Mashenka disappeared around the marsh while wearing the Red Ring, and the Shepherdess asks you to gather 25 Pointed Branches (item 7882) for a flute.
guide: Ask Ryubaba (moscovia 213,216) about the Red Ring; she says her baby sister Mashenka went out and disappeared around the marsh.
Ask Shepherdess (mosk_fild02 157,233) about Mashenka; she may have heard something and asks you to gather 25 Pointed Branches (item 7882) for a flute.
8144.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8145.description: The Shepherdess makes a flute from 25 Pointed Branches (item 7882), and when she plays it she hears a voice and gives you the Wooden Flute (item 7883).
guide: Wear Iron Boots (item 2429 or 2430), then talk to Shepherdess (mosk_fild02 157,233) while carrying 25 Pointed Branches (item 7882).
She plays the flute she makes, hears a voice she does not like, and gives you the Wooden Flute (item 7883) to take away.
8145.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8146.description: Ryubaba hears her sister Mashenka's voice in the Wooden Flute (item 7883), begs you not to tell their father, and offers the Red Ring (item 7877) in exchange for the flute.
guide: Play the Wooden Flute (item 7883) for Ryubaba (moscovia 213,216); she recognizes Mashenka's voice and begs you not to tell her father.
Choose 'Exchange' when Ryubaba offers the Red Ring (item 7877) for the flute; she takes the flute and gives you the Red Ring.
Choose 'Not exchange' instead, and Ryubaba is warped to moscovia 203,80 after you say you must let her father know.
8146.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8147.description: Vassili Grandpapa hears Mashenka's voice in the Wooden Flute (item 7883), says the ring has brought him nothing but grief, and gives you the Red Ring (item 7877).
guide: Play the Wooden Flute (item 7883) for Vassili Grandpapa (moscovia 206,81); he hears Mashenka's voice and asks you to play it again.
Talk to Vassili Grandpapa (moscovia 206,81) after the second playing; he says the ring has brought him nothing but grief and gives you the Red Ring (item 7877).
8147.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8148.description: The Worried Mother asks you to find her missing daughter, who may have become the aqua nymph Lusalka near the marsh.
guide: Talk to Worried Mother (moscovia 166,145), who asks you to find her missing daughter, who may have become Lusalka.
Bring Holy Water (item 523) with you; the Worried Mother says it protects you from Lusalka's gaze.
Look for Lusalka near water from 5 pm to 6 am PST, as the Worried Mother says she is nocturnal.
8148.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8149.description: Lusalka asks you to find her lover Igor, who went to the capital of Rune-Midgarts, and to give him her golden earrings.
guide: Talk to Lusalka (mosk_fild02 124,202) while carrying Holy Water (item 523); she asks you to find her lover Igor in Rune-Midgarts.
Lusalka (mosk_fild02 124,202) gives you her golden earrings for Igor and asks you to tell him to stop suffering and be happy.
8149.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8150.description: The Wanderer in Prontera says Igor, who called himself Igg, wanted to travel to a desert. Lusalka then asks for two locks of her hair, which you pick up as Lusalka's Hair (item 7878).
guide: Talk to Wanderer (prontera 228,279) and say 'Igor'; he says Igor wanted to travel to a desert.
Ask Lusalka (mosk_fild02 124,202) for two locks of her hair; she cuts them, a curse hits you, and a voice speaks from the marsh.
Pick up the hair at Lusalka (mosk_fild02 116,202) after the scene; you receive two Lusalka's Hair (item 7878).
8150.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.
sources: A Wanderer from a strange land

8151.description: The Morocc Villager says Igor was in Morocc a few days ago and left for the Pyramid, which he was warned was dangerous.
guide: Talk to Wanderer (prontera 228,279) and say 'Igor'; he says Igor wanted to travel to a desert.
Talk to Morocc Villager (morocc 165,82) and describe Igor as a sad man from Moscovia; he says Igor left to see the Pyramid, which the villager called dangerous, and was not seen after.
8151.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.
sources: A Wanderer from a strange land

8152.description: The gloomy soldier at moc_pryd04 126,120 is Igor; when you give him Lusalka's golden earrings and her message, he tells you how Svetlana fell into the marsh.
guide: Talk to Soldier (moc_pryd04 126,120) and tell him that Lusalka sends a message not to suffer anymore and to be happy.
Give the Soldier (moc_pryd04 126,120) Lusalka's golden earrings; he recognizes them and tells you how Svetlana sank into the marsh.
Tell the Soldier (moc_pryd04 126,120) that Svetlana still loves him; he says he will return to Moscovia before the full moon.
8152.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8153.description: The gloomy soldier asks you to tell Lusalka that he still loves her and will return to Moscovia before the full moon, and Lusalka then cuts two locks of her hair for you.
guide: Talk to Soldier (moc_pryd04 126,120) after he gives you his message; he asks you to go to Lusalka and tell her he still loves her.
Tell Lusalka (mosk_fild02 124,202) that Igor remembers every moment with her and will come back before the full moon; she asks you to cut two locks of her hair.
8153.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.
