8155.description: A voice in Marozka's cave says you must prove your strength by escaping the cave with 100 Well Baked Cookies and 100 Apples, past the monsters near the Stone Furnace and the Apple Tree.
guide: Walk into the cave trigger at mosk_que 49,22; the Voice unidentified asks whether you are Marozka and sets a test of strength.
The Voice says to escape the cave with 100 Well Baked Cookies from the Stone Furnace and 100 Apples from the Apple Tree, past the monsters that wander around them.
8155.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8156.description: Marozka makes the Golden Thread after you hand over the cookies and apples and wait an hour, then tells you one more test of mind and wisdom remains.
guide: Give Marozka (mosk_fild02 243,270) the cookies and apples; he says he will begin making the Golden Thread and asks you to come back in an hour.
Return to Marozka (mosk_fild02 243,270) after an hour; he says the Golden Thread is ready, but one more test of mind and wisdom comes before he gives it.
8156.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8157.description: Marozka gives you a five-question test of mind and wisdom; if all five answers are correct, he gives you 10 Golden Thread (item 7879).
guide: Talk to Marozka (mosk_fild02 243,270) and choose 'I will take it!' to start the test of mind and wisdom.
Answer all five questions correctly; a wrong answer ends the test, and Marozka tells you to try again later.
After all five answers are correct, Marozka gives you 10 Golden Thread (item 7879).
8157.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8158.description: After Baba Yaga takes your Golden Key materials and starts the key, she gives you a favor based on your job, such as finding her cow or buying a magic book.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) with the Cursed Ruby, Gold, Red Ring, Lusalka's Hair and Golden Thread; she takes them and starts the Golden Key.
Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) again; she gives you a favor based on your job, such as finding her cow as an Archer or buying a magic book as a Mage.
8158.level_basis: The Alarm (monster 1193, level 58) is the level gate that fixes the recommended level at 58

8159.description: Baba Yaga's cow has run away, and you must find it at mosk_dun02 257,193 and cast the Return Spell 'Good feed is orange-flavored' on it.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) as an Archer; she says her cow has run away and gives you the Return Spell 'Good feed is orange-flavored'.
Touch the Cow (mosk_dun02 257,193) and cast the spell on it; if it works, the cow disappears and reappears at another spot on mosk_dun02.
8159.level_basis: The recommended level is 58, fixed by the Alarm monster (monster 1193, level 58) named in the script.

8160.description: After you bring back Baba Yaga's cow, she finishes the Golden Key and gives it to you to help Maria.
guide: Tell Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) that you have got her cow; she says she has just finished the Golden Key.
Take the Golden Key (item 7876) from Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214); she tells you to help Maria with it and watch out for Koshei.
8160.level_basis: The recommended level is 58, fixed by the monster Alarm (1193, level 58) in the script.

8161.description: Baba Yaga asks an Acolyte to silence the Noisy Coffin behind her house, which keeps her from sleeping, using Holy Water, prayer, a hymn or a kick.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) as an Acolyte; she says the noisy coffin behind her house keeps her from sleeping and asks you to silence it.
Talk to Noisy Coffin (mosk_dun02 65,232) and choose the actions in this order: Pour Holy Water (item 523) on him, Pray, Sing a hymn, then Kick him.
When the coffin is silenced, go back to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) and tell her the job is done.
8161.level_basis: The recommended level is 58, fixed by the Alarm monster (1193, level 58) mentioned in the script.

8162.description: After the Noisy Coffin is silenced, Baba Yaga finishes the Golden Key and gives it to you to help Maria.
guide: Tell Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) that the Noisy Coffin is silenced; she says she can sleep at night now.
Take the Golden Key (item 7876) from Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214); she tells you to help Maria with it and watch out for Koshei.
8162.level_basis: The Alarm monster (level 58) sets the recommended level.

8163.description: Baba Yaga sends a Thief to find her silver spoons, which pirates stole and left near a wrecked ship. The search leads to an old bed at treasure01 24,39, where an unidentified voice drives you off.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) as a Thief; she says pirates stole her silver spoons and she can feel them around the wrecked ship.
Examine the Old Bed (treasure01 24,39) and choose 'Bed sheet'; the scar on the sheet shows four marked locations.
An unidentified voice asks who is there, and you run away to treasure01 68,28.
8163.level_basis: The recommended level is fixed by the Alarm monster (monster 1193, level 58) mentioned in the script.

8164.description: After the Old Bed clue sends you running, an engraved wall at treasure01 98,119 warns about a Mermaid's song, sleeping eyes and protecting your mirror.
guide: After the unidentified voice chases you from the Old Bed (treasure01 24,39), you are warped to treasure01 68,28.
Examine the Dirty Wall (treasure01 98,119); the engraving says to be careful of the Mermaid's song and the sleeping eyes, and to protect your mirror.
8164.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 58 (Alarm monster is level 58).

8165.description: The Dirty Wall warns about a Mermaid's song and your mirror, and then the Old_Wooden_Box at treasure01 61,183 may give you the handle of a broken key.
guide: Examine the Dirty Wall (treasure01 98,119); the engraving warns about a Mermaid's song, the sleeping eyes and protecting your mirror.
Choose 'Put hand inside the box' at the Old_Wooden_Box (treasure01 61,183); on some tries you find the handle of a broken key, and on others the gap is too small.
8165.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8166.description: Searching the Opened Treasure Chest at treasure01 27,115 is the last step: most searches turn up junk, but the right one finds the handle, and the broken piece becomes a key.
guide: Search the Opened Treasure Chest (treasure01 27,115) and reach into the junk; most tries turn up items such as a bone or a Thief Bug egg.
On the right search you find the handle of a broken key, and adjusting the piece with its handle turns it into a key.
8166.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8167.description: The assembled key opens the Old Treasure Box at treasure01 165,58 only with help from a Crystal Mirror, which reflects the woman's jewel eyes, and the box then gives you Baba Yaga's Silver Spoon (item 7880).
guide: Insert the key into the lock of the Old Treasure Box (treasure01 165,58); the woman's jewel eyes look at you.
Without a Crystal Mirror (item 747), you are blinded and Medusa and Obeaune appear around the box.
With the Crystal Mirror (item 747) in your bag, its light opens the box, and you find Baba Yaga's Silver Spoon (item 7880).
8167.level_basis: The recommended level is 79, fixed by the monster Medusa (monster 1148, level 79) named in the script.

8168.description: Baba Yaga takes the Silver Spoon (item 7880) you found in the box and gives you the Golden Key (item 7876) to help Maria.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) with Baba Yaga's Silver Spoon (item 7880); she says they are expensive ones.
Baba Yaga takes the spoon and gives you the Golden Key (item 7876), telling you to help Maria and watch out for Koshei, who is very dangerous.
8168.level_basis: Fixed by the monster Medusa (monster 1148, level 79) in the script

8169.description: Baba Yaga sends a Mage to buy a magic book from the Momotoro Publisher in Amatsu, who sells the Mystery Magic Book (item 7881) for 5,000 Zeny.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) as a Mage; she asks you to buy a magic book published by Momotaro in Amatsu.
Talk to Momotoro Publisher (amatsu 233,234) and answer 'Baba Yaga' when he asks your name; he finds the reserved book.
Pay 5,000 Zeny to Momotoro Publisher (amatsu 233,234); he gives you the Mystery Magic Book (item 7881).
8169.level_basis: The level is fixed by the Alarm monster (monster 1193, level 58) in the script.

8170.description: After you give Baba Yaga the Mystery Magic Book, Violent, Dangerous and Brutal Gardener monsters appear, then Alarm monsters, before she gives you the Golden Key (item 7876).
guide: Give the Mystery Magic Book (item 7881) to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214); gardener monsters appear at mosk_dun02 52-54,210.
Defeat the gardener monsters; Baba Yaga stays disabled until they are gone, and then talking to her summons Alarm monsters.
Defeat the Alarm monsters, then talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) again; she says she can make the Golden Key now.
Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_dun02 48,214) once more; she gives you the Golden Key (item 7876) to help Maria and warns about Koshei.
8170.level_basis: The quest is fixed by the Alarm monster (1193, level 58) mentioned in the script

8171.description: Gray Wolf's voice asks whether you have the Living Water and Dead Water, and you pour them on Maria at the Wall (mosk_dun01 45,259) to save her.
guide: Talk to Wall (mosk_dun01 45,259) with the Living Water and Dead Water; Gray Wolf's voice asks whether you got them and says Maria is still unstable.
Choose 'Death Water' first when asked which water to pour; pouring Living Water first fails, Gray Wolf scolds you, and the quest does not advance.
Pour Living Water as the second choice; Maria's wounds and curses are removed and Gray Wolf says the rescue succeeded.
Maria Morebna thanks you, and you receive a random food dish and experience as a reward.
8171.level_basis: The Immortal Koshei (monster 1890, level 85) fixes the recommended level at 85.

8196.description: The Research Official asks you to help the Tripartite Union researchers, who keep clashing over document files, and Ryosen then gives you a Meeting Invitation (item 6036) with a document to deliver.
guide: Talk to Research Official (mid_campin 376,120); he says the researchers collide over document files and asks you to talk to them first.
Talk to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245) three times; he offers Rafflesia tea, then explains that Ash-Vacuum is separate from Midgard and the three countries keep their information to themselves.
When Ryosen asks you to deliver a document to the Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz researchers, choose 'Alright.'; he gives you the Meeting Invitation (item 6036).
8196.level_basis: Fixed by the monster Thief Bug (level 6) named in the script

8197.description: Ryosen sends you to get the Meeting Invitation (item 6036) signed at the Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz offices, then to bring it back to him.
guide: Take the Meeting Invitation (item 6036) to Hue (mid_camp 247,255) at the Schwarzwald office first; Ryosen says Hue will whine if you go to Hansenne first.
Have Hue sign it, then take it to Hansenne (mid_camp 222,218) at the Arunafeltz office so he reads it and signs it at the bottom.
Bring the signed Meeting Invitation back to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245); he takes it, then hands it back and asks you to send it to the Research Official.
8197.level_basis: Mystic Horn (item 6023) is dropped by Cornus (level 108), the item dropper level the section names.

8198.description: Ryosen asks you to take the signed Meeting Invitation (item 6036) to the Research Official, who asks you to check on the three researchers before the meeting.
guide: Talk to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245) again; he hands back the signed Meeting Invitation (item 6036) and asks you to send it to the Research Official.
Give the Meeting Invitation (item 6036) to the Research Official (mid_campin 376,120); he accepts it and asks you to meet the three researchers and check on them before the meeting.
8198.level_basis: Fixed by the monster Thief Bug (monster 1051, level 6) named in the script.

8199.description: The Research Official asks you to check on the three researchers before the meeting, and Ryosen then asks you to get the document he requested from Hansenne.
guide: Talk to the Research Official (mid_campin 376,120); he asks you to meet the three researchers and check on them before the meeting.
Talk to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245); he asks whether you gave the invitation to the Official, offers tea, and asks you to get the requested document from Hansenne (mid_camp 222,218).
8199.level_basis: The level is fixed by the monster Thief Bug (monster 1051, level 6) mentioned in the script.

8200.description: Ryosen asks you to get the document he requested from Hansenne in Arunafeltz, and Hansenne says he lost it on a bridge while treasure hunting.
guide: Talk to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245); he says he requested a document from the Arunafeltz office and asks you to get it from Hansenne.
Talk to Hansenne (mid_camp 222,218) and choose 'I came to pick up the requested document.'; he says he lost it on a bridge while treasure hunting and suggests fishing for it.
8200.level_basis: Mystic Horn (item 6023) is dropped by Cornus (level 108).

8201.description: Hansenne says the requested document was lost on a bridge and suggests fishing for it; once you bring back the Messy File (item 6037), he sends you to Hue to restore it.
guide: Talk to Hansenne (mid_camp 222,218) about the lost document; he suggests fishing for it, since he dropped it on a bridge while treasure hunting.
Bring the Messy File (item 6037) to Hansenne (mid_camp 222,218); he says it looks like the file he made and asks you to ask Hue to restore it.
8201.level_basis: Peaked Hat (item 6021) is dropped by Tatacho (level 106).

8202.description: Hansenne sends you to Hue to restore the Messy File (item 6037), and Hue asks for a Fan, an Old Frying Pan, a Flame Stone and a Chinese Ink to do it.
guide: Talk to Hansenne (mid_camp 222,218) with the Messy File (item 6037); he says it is his ruined file and suggests asking Hue to restore it.
Talk to Hue (mid_camp 247,255) with the Messy File (item 6037); he says it is completely soaked and asks for 1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone and 1 Chinese Ink.
8202.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8203.description: Hue asks you to bring a Fan, an Old Frying Pan, a Flame Stone, a Chinese Ink and the Messy File (item 6037), then restores the file and gives you the Neat Report (item 6038).
guide: Give Hue (mid_camp 247,255) the Fan, Old Frying Pan, Flame Stone, Chinese Ink and Messy File (item 6037); he takes them and asks you to wait while he restores the file.
Keep talking to Hue (mid_camp 247,255) while he works; on a successful try he re-binds the file and gives you the Neat Report (item 6038).
8203.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8204.description: Hue finishes re-binding the restored file, and you deliver the Neat Report (item 6038) to Ryosen, who accepts it and asks you to tell the Research Official to wait.
guide: Talk to Hue (mid_camp 247,255); he says the binding is fixed and reminds you to deliver the file to Ryosen before the meeting.
Give the Neat Report (item 6038) to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245); he accepts it and asks you to ask the Research Official to wait while he finds another document.
8204.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8205.description: Ryosen asks you to tell the Research Official to wait while he finds another document, and the Official then says the meeting is about to begin.
guide: Talk to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245) after he accepts the Neat Report; he asks you to ask the Research Official to wait while he finds another document for the meeting.
Talk to the Research Official (mid_campin 376,120); he says the meeting is about to begin and asks you to come in.
8205.level_basis: The level is fixed by the monster Thief Bug (level 6) named in the script.

8206.description: The Research Official's meeting with Ryosen, Hue and Hansenne about Satan Morocc breaks down when a Thief Bug appears, and the quest ends when you tell the Official that Hansenne did not ruin the cake.
guide: Talk to the Research Official (mid_campin 376,120) to start the meeting; Ryosen, Hue and Hansenne then give their reports in the meeting room.
After the Thief Bug scene, talk to the Research Official (mid_campin 376,120) until the researchers leave the room.
Talk to the Research Official (mid_campin 376,120) and say Hansenne is not the one who ruined the cake; the quest moves on.
8206.level_basis: The recommended level is 6, fixed by the monster Thief Bug (monster 1051, level 6) named in the script.

8207.description: Hansenne says he did not ruin the cake, since Hue pressed his hand on it when the Thief Bug came out, and he asks you to help Ryosen and Hue get along.
guide: Talk to Hansenne (mid_camp 222,218) and tell him you saw Hue press his hand on the cake; he says it was just a mistake and Ryosen will forget about it.
Talk to Hansenne (mid_camp 222,218) again; he asks you to help Ryosen and Hue get along and gives you an Arunafeltz Desert Sandwich (item 12321).
8207.level_basis: Fixed by the monster Thief Bug (monster 1051, level 6) named in the script.

8208.description: Hue admits he pressed his hand on the cake and asks you to deliver his Rune-Midgarts' report, the Neat Report (item 6038), to Ryosen in return for a Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee (item 12320).
guide: Talk to Hue (mid_camp 247,255) after the Hansenne talk; he admits he caused the cake trouble and says he is too embarrassed to face Ryosen.
Hue gives you the Neat Report (item 6038) and a Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee (item 12320) and asks you to deliver the report to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245).
8208.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8209.description: Ryosen takes the Neat Report (item 6038) from you, admits he went too far, and asks you to set up a new meeting with the Research Official, giving you a Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake (item 12319).
guide: Talk to Ryosen (mid_camp 165,245) and tell him Hue wanted him to have the report; he takes the Neat Report (item 6038) and glances at the memo stuck to it.
Ryosen says he went too far and asks you to go to the Research Official (mid_campin 376,120) and set up another meeting in his stead; he gives you a Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake (item 12319).
8209.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

8210.description: After Ryosen asks you to set up another meeting, you tell the Research Official how the three researchers talked, and he thanks you with a special tea, experience and a First Aid Kit (item 12110).
guide: Talk to the Research Official (mid_campin 376,120) and tell him about the conversation between the three researchers; he says he may have been too worried.
He offers you a special tea, which gives you experience, and gives you a First Aid Kit (item 12110); the quest is completed.
8210.level_basis: Fixed by the monster Thief Bug (monster 1051, level 6) as stated in the quest facts.

8211.description: Shurank, the Swordman instructor in Izlude, gives new Swordmen their first lectures on the job path and its skills.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) once you are a Swordman to hear his first lecture.
8211.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8212.description: Shurank, the Swordman instructor in Izlude, gives new Swordmen their first lectures on the job path and its skills.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) once you are a Swordman to hear his first lecture.
8212.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8213.description: Shurank, the Swordman instructor in Izlude, gives new Swordmen their first lectures on the job path and its skills.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) once you are a Swordman to hear his first lecture.
8213.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8214.description: Shurank, the Swordman instructor in Izlude, gives new Swordmen their first lectures on the job path and its skills.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) once you are a Swordman to hear his first lecture.
8214.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8215.description: Shurank, the Swordman instructor in Izlude, gives new Swordmen their first lectures on the job path and its skills.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) once you are a Swordman to hear his first lecture.
8215.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8216.description: Shurank says he has an important task for you: to deliver a message to the Knight Dequ'ee in Geffen.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163); he says his important task only requires you to deliver a message to a Knight named Dequ'ee in Geffen.
8216.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8217.description: Shurank sends you to Dequ'ee in Geffen with a message about the murderer, and you bring Dequ'ee's reply back to Shurank.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163); he gives you the message about the murderer to take to Dequ'ee and asks you to remember his reply.
Shurank sends you to Geffen (gef_fild07 35,192); give the message to Dequ'ee (geffen 154,143) and remember his answer.
Return to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) and tell him Dequ'ee's answer; he then starts teaching you Provoke.
8217.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8218.description: Shurank explains Provoke, which infuriates enemies, and asks you to train it before he continues the lesson.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) to hear about Provoke; it infuriates enemies, so they attack you with more strength but less defense.
Shurank explains that Provoke is an Active Skill that uses a little SP like Bash, and that a higher Provoke level gives a bigger attack increase and defense decrease on the target.
Train Provoke and come back to Shurank once you understand it well enough.
8218.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8219.description: Shurank rewards you for Provoke at level 5 to 9 and says he will teach Endure next time.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) with Provoke at level 5 to 9; he says you have a fairly good understanding of it and gives you a small reward.
Shurank says the next lesson will be about Endure, and asks you to come back when you are ready to learn it.
8219.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8220.description: After your Provoke reward, Shurank explains Endure and asks you to train it; mastering Provoke at level 10 also completes this step.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) after the Provoke reward; he says he will teach you Endure next.
Talk to Shurank again; he explains that Endure lets you shrug off attacks, though you still take damage, and asks you to train it.
If your Provoke is at level 10, Shurank gives you a reward and moves on to Endure.
8220.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8221.description: Shurank explains Endure, which lets you shrug off enemy attacks, and asks you to train it until you can use it well.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) to hear about Endure; it lets you shrug off attacks, though you still take damage and the skill has a delay.
Train Endure, then talk to Shurank again; at Endure level 2 or higher he says you have done well and sends you on to Dequ'ee.
8221.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8222.description: After you learn Endure, Shurank sends you to visit Dequ'ee in Geffen, who wants your help with a murder case.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) after learning Endure; he sends you to visit Dequ'ee in Geffen, who has something to ask of you.
Talk to Dequ'ee (geffen 154,143); he is investigating a murder and asks you to help figure out who the killer is.
8222.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8223.description: Dequ'ee asks you to help find the killer by interrogating the suspects in Morocc and collecting the codes of Hans, Bankley, Muetro and Geil.
guide: Talk to Dequ'ee (geffen 154,143); he says he is investigating a murder and asks you to help figure out who the killer is.
Interrogate the suspects in Morocc; Dequ'ee asks for each suspect's code, starting with Hans, then Bankley, Muetro and Geil.
Give Dequ'ee (geffen 154,143) the four codes; when they are all correct, he says they are the only clue and asks for your ideas.
8223.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8224.description: Dequ'ee tries to decode the four suspects' codes by guessing their order, and the cipher points to Bankley as the murderer.
guide: Talk to Dequ'ee (geffen 154,143); he says the codes must be arranged in a certain order and asks you to guess that order.
Choose the suspect order in his menus; a wrong order gets 'Let's try another combination', and after the right one he asks who the murderer might be.
Answer Bankley when Dequ'ee asks who the murderer is; he confirms Bankley and sends you to Morocc (moc_fild07 359,201).
8224.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8225.description: Dequ'ee sends you to Morocc to watch Bankley, the suspect his cipher points to, and to report at once if Bankley does anything desperate.
guide: Go to Morocc (moc_fild07 359,201) and keep watch on Bankley in case he does anything desperate.
If something happens to Bankley, report to Dequ'ee (geffen 154,143) right away.
8225.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8226.description: You report that Bankley killed himself, and Dequ'ee closes the case for now and sends you back to Shurank.
guide: Report Bankley's death to Dequ'ee (geffen 154,143); he is surprised it was suicide and says the case is closed for now, with the other three suspects watched.
Dequ'ee sends you back to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) to continue the Swordman lessons.
8226.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8227.description: After Dequ'ee closes his case, you return to Shurank, who teaches One Handed and Two Handed Sword Mastery.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) after Dequ'ee sends you back; he says Dequ'ee's message reports you worked hard and you still need Swordman skills.
Shurank explains One Handed Sword Mastery and Two Handed Sword Mastery, which are passive skills that raise Attack Power as they are leveled up.
If a Sword Mastery is at Level 10 or higher, Shurank gives you a small reward and says he will tell you about Magnum Break next time.
8227.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8228.description: Shurank teaches Magnum Break, a skill mastered at Level 10 that deals splash damage around you, and gives you a Scimiter (item 1113) when the lessons end.
guide: Talk to Shurank (izlude_in 82,163) after the Sword Mastery lesson; he will tell you about Magnum Break, which requires Level 5 Bash to learn.
Shurank explains that Magnum Break hits enemies around you, pushes them back with a Fire property attack and also hurts you a little.
Shurank tells you to reach Job Level 40 to be promoted to a Knight or Crusader, then gives you a Scimiter (item 1113) before you go.
8228.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8229.description: Guarnien offers to teach you Merchant basics, starting with Increase Weight Limit up to Level 4 before he covers Item Appraisal.
guide: Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) and choose 'Sure!' to hear about the basics of the Merchant job.
Learn Increase Weight Limit up to Level 4; Guarnien says you need it before anything else.
Talk to Guarnien again with Increase Weight Limit at Level 4; he introduces Item Appraisal, which identifies unknown items like a Magnifier.
8229.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8230.description: Guarnien explains Mammonite, which deals heavy damage to a target using Zeny, and then promises to teach Discount next.
guide: Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) after Item Appraisal; he explains that Mammonite greatly damages a target and uses a little SP, but also consumes your Zeny.
Guarnien says Mammonite's attack and Zeny use both rise with its level, and he says the next lesson is Discount.
8230.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8231.description: Guarnien explains the Discount passive skill, which lowers prices at NPC shops, and asks you to learn it to Level 4.
guide: Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) about Discount; it is a passive skill that lowers the price you pay at NPC shops and uses no SP.
If Discount is at Level 4 or higher, Guarnien gives a small reward and sets the Red Potion challenge; otherwise he asks you to learn Discount to Level 4 first.
8231.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8232.description: Guarnien asks you to learn Discount up to Level 4 before he continues his lessons.
guide: Learn the Discount skill up to Level 4; Guarnien says bargaining is an essential skill for a Merchant.
Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) once Discount is at Level 4; he gives you a small reward and moves on to the Red Potion challenge.
8232.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8233.description: Guarnien gives you a challenge: buy 10 Red Potions from the cheapest NPC in Prontera, and he sends you there.
guide: Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) after Discount; he says his next lesson is a challenge to bring him 10 Red Potions bought at the cheapest price.
Guarnien warps you to Prontera (prontera 155,46) to find the NPC selling Red Potions at the cheapest price.
8233.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8234.description: Research the Red Potion price in Prontera and buy 10 from the cheapest NPC; if the seller scams you, Guarnien sends you back to try again.
guide: Buy 10 Red Potions from the cheapest NPC seller in Prontera; Guarnien warns that a price that is too good to be true is usually a scam.
Return to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) with the 10 Red Potions; if you were scammed, he sends you back to Prontera to try again.
8234.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8235.description: Guarnien explains Over Charge, a passive skill that raises the Zeny you get when selling to NPC shops, and asks you to learn it to Level 4.
guide: Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) after the market task; he explains that Over Charge is a passive skill that needs no SP.
He says Over Charge gives more Zeny when you sell items to NPC shops; if it is below Level 4, he sets the Over Charge task.
8235.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8236.description: Guarnien asks you to learn Over Charge up to Level 4 before he lectures on Push Cart.
guide: Learn Over Charge up to Level 4; Guarnien says he cannot lecture on anything else until you finish this task.
Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) once Over Charge is at Level 4; he gives you a small reward and moves on to the Push Cart lesson.
8236.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8237.description: Guarnien gives the Push Cart lecture: it needs Level 5 Increase Weight Limit first, lets you carry up to 100 kinds of items under 8,000 weight, and almost halves movement speed until Level 10.
guide: Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51); he says Push Cart needs Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can learn it.
Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) again; he explains that a PushCart can be rented from most Kafra Ladies and that it almost halves your movement speed until Push Cart reaches Level 10.
Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) once more; at Push Cart Level 4 or higher he gives a reward and starts the Vending lecture, otherwise he asks you to learn Push Cart up to Level 4.
8237.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8238.description: Guarnien asks you to learn Push Cart up to Level 4, which needs Level 5 Increase Weight Limit first, before he continues his lectures.
guide: Learn the Push Cart skill up to Level 4; Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) reminds you that you need Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can learn Push Cart.
Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) once Push Cart is at Level 4; he gives you a reward and moves on to the Vending lecture.
8238.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8239.description: Guarnien gives his final lecture on Vending, the definitive Merchant skill for opening a shop, but you can only sell items stored in a PushCart.
guide: Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51); he says his final lecture is on Vending, the definitive skill of the Merchant.
Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) again; he explains that Vending opens your own shop where you stand, sells only items stored in your PushCart, and needs Push Cart learned first.
Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) says Vending is mastered at Level 10, Level 1 lets you vend 3 items, and each level adds one more item.
Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) with Vending at Level 4 or higher to receive a reward; below Level 4 he sets the Vending task for you.
8239.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8240.description: Guarnien gives you a final task: learn the Vending skill up to Level 4 to finish the Merchant lectures.
guide: Learn the Vending skill up to Level 4; Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) set this as your final assignment.
Talk to Guarnien (alberta_in 70,51) once Vending is at Level 4; he gives you a reward and says you have mastered the fundamentals of the Merchant class.
8240.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8241.description: The Rune-Midgarts Magician needs the Red Jewel, a gem Assassins buried under a Mushroom-like structure near the Fairy's village, to extract a recorded language sample.
guide: Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256); he says the first gem is buried under the Mushroom-like structure near the Fairy's village.
Dig out the Red Jewel (item 7575) at that spot; the Magician warns that Assassins installed a trap to protect the gems, so be careful when you dig.
Bring the Red Jewel (item 7575) and Blue Jewel (item 7576) back to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256) once you have both; he then extracts the voice recordings.
8241.level_basis: Red Jewel (item 7575) is dropped by Rafflesia (level 17).

8242.description: The Rune-Midgarts Magician needs the Blue Jewel, a gem Assassins buried under the tree near the Giant's village, to extract a recorded language sample.
guide: Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256); he says the second gem is buried under the tree near the Giant's village.
Dig out the Blue Jewel (item 7576) at that spot; watch for the trap the Assassins set to protect the gems.
Bring the Blue Jewel (item 7576) and Red Jewel (item 7575) back to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256) to finish the gem collection.
8242.level_basis: Rafflesia drops Red Jewel (item 7575) and Blue Jewel (item 7576) at level 17.

8243.description: Dorance, the Schwarzwald Mechanic, asks you to find out how far the Arunafeltz Linguist has got in decoding the other world's language for the Triple Alliance Research Group.
guide: Talk to the Schwarzwald Mechanic (mid_camp 197,237) Dorance; he asks you to find out how far the Arunafeltz Linguist's decoding has progressed.
Go to the Arunafeltz Linguist (mid_campin 168,82) on the second floor of the Alliance Headquarters and ask him about his progress.
Talk to the Arunafeltz Linguist (mid_campin 168,82) again; he asks whether you have met the fairies or wooden giants and sends you outside the camp to memorize their words.
8243.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8244.description: The linguist Arunafeltz asks you to find fairies and wooden giants outside the camp and memorize their languages to help the Alliance Research Group communicate with these intelligent races.
guide: Talk to the Arunafeltz Linguist (mid_campin 168,82); after he sends you out, find the fairies and wooden giants outside the Expedition Camp and remember their words.
Talk to the Arunafeltz Linguist (mid_campin 168,82) once you have met both peoples; he asks you to type the fairy's three sentences, then the wooden giants' three sentences.
Type the sentences exactly; if a race's sentences are not all right, the Linguist asks you to go back and check what they said.
Talk to the Arunafeltz Linguist (mid_campin 168,82) again; he cannot decode the language and sends you to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256) for help.
8244.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8245.description: The Arunafeltz Linguist sends you to the Rune-Midgarts Magician, who says he needs a Recorded Language Sample from the fairy and giant villages before he can help.
guide: Talk to the Arunafeltz Linguist (mid_campin 168,82); he admits he cannot decode the language and sends you to the Rune-Midgarts Magician inside the Expedition Camp.
Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256) and choose 'Uh, Mr. Dictionary sent...'; he says he needs a Recorded Language Sample.
The Magician (mid_camp 147,256) explains that magical gems buried near the fairy and giant villages record their speech and asks you to retrieve them.
8245.level_basis: Red Jewel (item 7575) is dropped by Rafflesia (level 17).

8246.description: The Rune-Midgarts Magician asks you to recover the two magical gems that Assassins buried near the fairy and giant villages, so he can extract their language recordings.
guide: Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256); he says the first gem is under a Mushroom-like structure near the Fairy's village and the second under a tree near the Giant's village.
Dig out the Red Jewel (item 7575) and Blue Jewel (item 7576); the Magician warns that Assassins trapped the gems, so be careful when you dig.
Return both gems to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256); he extracts their voice recordings and sends them to the Arunafeltz Linguist, which finishes this task.
8246.level_basis: Red Jewel (item 7575) and Blue Jewel (item 7576) are dropped by Rafflesia (level 17).

8247.description: After the Rune-Midgarts Magician extracts the voices from the two gems, the Arunafeltz Linguist reports his decoding progress and asks you to take the translator problem to the Mechanic.
guide: Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256) with the Red Jewel (item 7575) and Blue Jewel (item 7576); he extracts their voices and sends them to the Arunafeltz Linguist.
Talk to the Arunafeltz Linguist (mid_campin 168,82); he says the decoding is going too well, but he cannot turn the data into a portable translator and asks you to go see the Mechanic.
8247.level_basis: Red Jewel (item 7575) is dropped by Rafflesia (level 17).

8248.description: Dorance, the Schwarzwald Mechanic, is buried in research documents and asks you to get suggestions from the Rune-Midgarts Magician on storing the data in a gem.
guide: Talk to the Schwarzwald Mechanic (mid_camp 197,237) Dorance; he is overwhelmed by the research documents and says the data is too much to store.
Dorance (mid_camp 197,237) asks you to ask the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256) for suggestions on storing the data in a gem, which completes this quest.
8248.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

8249.description: The Rune-Midgarts Magician says the data is more than expected and asks you to find a Mysterious Ore outside the Expedition Camp that could store it.
guide: Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256); he says there is more data than expected and no known jewel has enough storage space.
The Magician (mid_camp 147,256) says a Mysterious Ore that cannot be found in Midgard lies on the cold side of a field outside the Expedition Camp and asks you to find one.
8249.level_basis: Rafflesia (level 17) is the monster that drops the Red Jewel and Blue Jewel items, which defines the recommended level.

8250.description: Bring the Unidentified Mineral (item 6048) to the Rune-Midgarts Magician, who tests it and crafts it into a gem that can store the language data.
guide: Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256) with the Unidentified Mineral (item 6048); he says it is unrefined but holds a mysterious power.
The Magician (mid_camp 147,256) tests the ore with a spell and says it can store both languages, then asks you to wait while he crafts it into a gem.
8250.level_basis: Red Jewel (item 7575) is dropped by Rafflesia (level 17).

8251.description: The Rune-Midgarts Magician infuses the magical data into the crafted gem, which may take several visits before it is ready.
guide: Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256); he says he is crafting the ore into a gem and asks you to come back after a rest.
Talk to the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256) again; once the magical data is infused he gives you the crafted gem and asks you to deliver it to the Schwarzwald Mechanic.
8251.level_basis: Red Jewel (item 7575) is dropped by Rafflesia (level 17).

8252.description: Deliver the crafted gem from the Rune-Midgarts Magician to Mechanic Engineer Dorance, who will use it to build the translator.
guide: Receive the crafted gem from the Rune-Midgarts Magician (mid_camp 147,256); he asks you to deliver it to the Schwarzwald Mechanic.
Talk to the Schwarzwald Mechanic (mid_camp 197,237) Dorance and choose 'Give him the Gem.'; he says the machine will take about one hour to finish (completes this quest).
8252.level_basis: Red Jewel (item 7575) and Blue Jewel (item 7576) are dropped by Rafflesia at level 17.

8253.description: Dorance builds the translator from the crafted gem over about an hour, then gives you the Ring of Wise King (item 2782).
guide: Return to the Schwarzwald Mechanic (mid_camp 197,237) once the time limit has passed; if he is still working he tells you to leave him alone.
When Dorance (mid_camp 197,237) is done, he shows the Ring of Wise King, explains that it turns the magical wave into a signal for your brain, and gives you the ring (item 2782).
8253.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9000.description: Swordmen at Job Level 40 with no unused skill points apply to the Prontera Chivalry to become Knights, passing tests from six Knights before a unanimous vote.
guide: Talk to the Chivalry Captain (prt_in 88,101), Captain Herman in dialogue, and choose to apply; he sets up the tests and sends you to Sir Andrew.
Talk to Sir Andrew (prt_in 75,107) for the first test and gather the battlefield items he lists.
Visit Sir Siracuse (prt_in 71,91), Sir Windsor (prt_in 79,94), Lady Amy (prt_in 69,107) and Sir Edmond (prt_in 70,99) in the order each one names.
Visit Sir Gray Prospheiro, who runs the final test after Sir Edmond sends you to him.
Return to the Chivalry Captain (prt_in 88,101) after all tests; if every Knight approves, he makes you a Knight and gives you 7 Awakening Potions (item 656).
9000.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9001.description: Sir Andrew's first test, one of two random item sets, asks you to gather five each of six battlefield items, then you go on to Sir Siracuse.
guide: Talk to Sir Andrew (prt_in 75,107) and choose 'I would like to take the test.'; he explains the loyalty test and lists the items to gather.
Gather 5 each of Elder Pixie's Beard (item 1040), Wing of Red Bat (item 7006), Orcish Voucher (item 931), Moth Dust (item 1057), Reptile Tongue (item 903) and Wild Boar's Mane (item 1028).
Return to Sir Andrew (prt_in 75,107) with the full set; he takes the items and sends you to Sir Siracuse for the next test.
9001.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9002.description: Sir Andrew's first test, the second of two random item sets, asks you to gather five each of six battlefield items, then you go on to Sir Siracuse.
guide: Talk to Sir Andrew (prt_in 75,107) and choose 'I would like to take the test.'; he explains the loyalty test and lists the items to gather.
Gather 5 each of Short Leg (item 1042), Heart of Mermaid (item 950), Blossom of Maneater (item 1032), Flesh of Clam (item 966), Old Frying Pan (item 7031) and Snail's Shell (item 946).
Return to Sir Andrew (prt_in 75,107) with the full set; he takes the items and sends you to Sir Siracuse for the next test.
9002.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9003.description: After Sir Andrew's first test, Sir Siracuse quizzes you on Knight weapons, skills and ethics, and a wrong answer sends you back to study.
guide: Talk to Sir Siracuse (prt_in 71,91) after Sir Andrew sends you to him; he says he will test your knowledge of Knighthood and honor.
Answer Sir Siracuse's (prt_in 71,91) questions on Two-Handed Swords, Spears, Peco Peco riding, helping Novices, party behavior and the value of honor; a wrong answer sends you back to study.
When every answer is right, Sir Siracuse (prt_in 71,91) ends his test and sends you to Sir Windsor (prt_in 79,94).
9003.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9004.description: Sir Windsor takes over your test after Sir Siracuse sends you to him, and he accepts you to begin his part.
guide: Talk to Sir Windsor (prt_in 79,94) and choose 'Sir Siracuse sent me to you.'; he accepts you for his test (changequest 9004,9005).
Sir Windsor (prt_in 79,94) says he will take you to the test area and starts the next part of the Knight test.
9004.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9005.description: Sir Windsor leads you to the Tenacity test area at job_knt 89,101 after you accept his test.
guide: Talk to Sir Windsor (prt_in 79,94) and accept his test; he says 'Follow me.' or 'This way.'
Sir Windsor (prt_in 79,94) warps you to the test area at job_knt 89,101; Windsor Benedict is listed at job_knt 89,106.
9005.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9006.description: In the job_knt test area you must defeat a group of goblins, including a Goblin Archer and a Goblin Steamrider, before Sir Windsor sends you to Lady Amy.
guide: In the job_knt test area, defeat the goblins that appear: a Goblin Archer, a Steam Goblin (Goblin Steamrider) and five Goblins.
The test times out after about three minutes, and the goblins disappear if you take too long.
When the last goblin falls, the Knight speaks as Sir Windsor, tells you to talk to Amy Beatrice, and warps you to Prontera (prt_in 80,100).
9006.level_basis: Fixed by the monster Goblin Steamrider (monster 1280, level 35) named in the script.

9007.description: After Sir Windsor's goblin test, you go to Lady Amy, who starts her etiquette test once you say Sir Windsor sent you.
guide: Talk to Lady Amy (prt_in 69,107) after the goblin test and choose 'Sir Windsor told me to--' to start her test.
Lady Amy (prt_in 69,107) says she will test your etiquette as a Knight through a story where you choose answers.
9007.level_basis: The level is fixed by the Goblin Steamrider (monster 1280, level 35) mentioned in the script

9008.description: Lady Amy's etiquette test is a story about a Knight forming a party in Morocc and the Pyramids, and your choices decide whether you pass.
guide: Talk to Lady Amy (prt_in 69,107) and answer her questions about forming a party in Morocc and going to the Pyramids.
Answer her later questions about rude players, needy players, rare items, Peco Peco riding and healing; each choice counts toward your score.
If your score is high enough (90 or 100), Lady Amy sends you to Sir Edmond (prt_in 70,99); a lower score sends you back to retake her test.
9008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9009.description: After Lady Amy passes you, Sir Edmond (prt_in 70,99) explains the Knight's duty to act with modesty and calm and begins his test.
guide: Talk to Sir Edmond (prt_in 70,99) and choose 'Lady Amy sent me.'; he introduces himself and explains that a Knight must think modestly about the world's order.
Sir Edmond (prt_in 70,99) warns you not to make careless decisions or to kill monsters without reason, then warps you to the test area at job_knt 143,57.
9009.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9010.description: Sir Edmond sends you into the Knight test area at job_knt 143,57 to show reverence and patience, and the test ends when you leave by the warp.
guide: Talk to Sir Edmond (prt_in 70,99) and choose 'Lady Amy sent me.'; he asks you to keep the quality of reverence in mind before the test begins.
Walk onto the warp at job_knt 143,57; it sends you to Prontera (prt_in 80,100) and completes this test (changequest 9010,9011).
9010.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9011.description: Sir Gray, the last Knight to test you, asks casual questions about why you want to become a Knight, and his talk decides whether you go on to the captain.
guide: Talk to Sir Gray (prt_in 87,92) and choose 'I would like to take the test to change jobs.'; he says it is not really a test, just a casual talk.
Answer his questions about why you want to be a Knight and what you would do first; if your answers are weak, he asks you to think again and come back.
When Sir Gray (prt_in 87,92) is satisfied, he sends you to the Chivalry Captain (prt_in 88,101) to decide your job change (changequest 9011,9012).
9011.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9012.description: After Sir Gray's talk, the Chivalry Captain Herman gathers the Knights' opinions and, if all approve, makes you a Knight and gives you 7 Awakening Potions (item 656).
guide: Talk to the Chivalry Captain (prt_in 88,101) once all tests are done; he will not proceed while you still have unused skill points.
The captain reads each Knight's review in turn (Sir Andrew, Sir Siracuse, Sir Windsor, Lady Amy, Sir Edmond and Gray), and all of them approve.
Captain Herman (prt_in 88,101) declares you a member of the Prontera Chivalry, completes this quest and gives you 7 Awakening Potions (item 656).
9012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9013.description: Catherine's first test for the Wizard job change: collect 10 each of Red Gemstone (item 716), Blue Gemstone (item 717) and Yellow Gemstone (item 715) and return them to her.
guide: Talk to Wizard Guildsman Catherine (gef_tower 111,37) and accept her application at Job Level 40 with no unused skill points; she then asks you to collect 10 each of Red Gemstone, Blue Gemstone and Yellow Gemstone yourself.
Return to Wizard Guildsman Catherine (gef_tower 111,37) with the 10 Red Gemstone, 10 Blue Gemstone and 10 Yellow Gemstone; she takes them and says you passed the first test.
Catherine (gef_tower 111,37) sends you to the Gloomy Wizard (gef_tower 102,24), the man in the corner, for the written and practical tests.
9013.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

9014.description: Catherine's alternate first test for the Wizard job change: bring 5 each of Crystal Blue (item 991), Green Live (item 993), Red Blood (item 990) and Wind of Verdure (item 992) to her.
guide: Talk to Wizard Guildsman Catherine (gef_tower 111,37) and accept her application; she then asks you to collect 5 each of Crystal Blue, Green Live, Red Blood and Wind of Verdure yourself.
Return to Wizard Guildsman Catherine (gef_tower 111,37) with those four items; she takes them and sends you to the Gloomy Wizard (gef_tower 102,24) for the remaining tests.
9014.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

9015.description: After Catherine's item test, or directly at Job Level 50, the Gloomy Wizard in the tower takes over your Wizard job change tests.
guide: Talk to Wizard Guildsman Catherine (gef_tower 111,37) after passing the item test; she sends you to the Gloomy Wizard (gef_tower 102,24). A Job Level 50 mage skips the item test and is sent there directly.
Talk to the Gloomy Wizard (gef_tower 102,24), who speaks as Raulel, and choose 'I would like to continue with the tests.'; he says he is in charge of your testing from now on.
He then gives you the 10-question written test, which is the next part of the Wizard job change.
9015.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9016.description: The written part of the Wizard test: the Gloomy Wizard (gef_tower 102,24) asks 10 questions about magic, monsters and Mages, where 90 or 100 points pass and on a retry 80 also passes.
guide: Talk to the Gloomy Wizard (gef_tower 102,24) and answer his 10 questions; each question has four choices and he does not tell you which answer was wrong.
Your score decides the result: 90 or 100 passes the written test, and a lower score sends you back to retry, where 80 or more passes.
After passing, the Gloomy Wizard says the final test is being prepared and tells you to rest before it.
9016.level_basis: Worn Out Scroll (item 618) is dropped by Bongun (level 32).

9017.description: After passing the written test, the Gloomy Wizard sends you into the Water, Earth and Fire rooms of the job_wiz test area to defeat their monsters within the time limit.
guide: Talk to the Gloomy Wizard (gef_tower 102,24) after passing the written test; he says the final test is being prepared and asks you to rest first.
Talk to the Gloomy Wizard (gef_tower 102,24) again and choose 'No, it's ok, I'm ready.' to be sent straight to the test area at job_wiz 57,154; 'I would like to listen.' gives the explanation first.
In the test area, defeat all the monsters of the Water Room, then the Earth Room and then the Fire Room, each within the time limit; each room has monsters of its element.
If you fail the battle test, the Gloomy Wizard asks you to bring him a Worn Out Scroll (item 618), and with the scroll he says he will tell Catherine that you passed.
9017.level_basis: Worn Out Scroll (item 618) is dropped by Bongun (level 32).

9018.description: The last step of the Wizard job change: defeat the guard monsters in the Room of Fire at job_wiz 1,6, then Wizard Guildsman Catherine makes you a Wizard.
guide: Enter the Room of Fire at job_wiz 1,6 and defeat the guard monsters, Greatest General or Horong, at job_wiz 43-45,99 within two minutes.
When every guard is defeated, the room announces that you passed the job change test and the quest moves on.
Talk to Wizard Guildsman Catherine (gef_tower 111,37) with Job Level 40 and no unused skill points; she makes you a Wizard and gives you 6 Blue Potions (item 505).
9018.level_basis: The Greatest General (monster 1277, level 40) in the Room of Fire guard spawn sets the recommended level.

9028.description: A quest to capture Strange Hydra (^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000) at the south beach. NPC Lucia (brasilis 192,133) gives the quest and provides a Hydra Ball (^006400Hydra Ball^000000) to use for capturing the Hydra.
guide: Talk to Lucia (brasilis 192,133) and choose 'Yes.' when she asks whether you came to hunt Strange Hydras; she gives you a Hydra Ball (item 12408).
Use the Hydra Ball on a Strange Hydra you find at the south beach to capture it.
Bring the Mystic Leaf Cat Ball (item 6221) back to Lucia (brasilis 192,133); she rewards you with 5 Blue Potions (item 505) and starts the next quest.
9028.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9029.description: After returning the captured Strange Hydra's ball, you wait 24 hours before Lucia gives you another Hydra Ball for the next hunt.
guide: Talk to Lucia (brasilis 192,133) after returning the Mystic Leaf Cat Ball; she says each Hydra Ball is provided every 24 hours, so come back later.
Come back to Lucia (brasilis 192,133) once 24 hours have passed; she completes this quest and asks whether you came to hunt Strange Hydras.
Choose 'Yes.' and she gives you a new Hydra Ball (item 12408) to start the hunt again.
9029.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9030.description: Find the 3 missing puppies that have gone out of the village. Angelo asks the player to locate them in the field outside the village.
guide: Talk to Angelo (brasilis 297,307); he says the puppies have been disappearing and asks you to find all 3 of them in the field outside the village.
Find the Puppy NPCs in the field outside the village, such as bra_fild01 98,96 and bra_fild01 59,116; talk to each puppy you find, and after the third one it says it will tell Angelo.
9030.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9031.description: All three puppies are found, and Angelo (brasilis 297,307) gives you experience for returning them.
guide: Talk to Angelo (brasilis 297,307) now that all 3 puppies are found; he thanks you and gives you experience.
9031.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

9032.description: After you return the three puppies, you must wait 24 hours before Angelo (brasilis 297,307) lets you search for missing puppies again.
guide: Talk to Angelo (brasilis 297,307) while this quest runs; he says the day is not finished yet and you can only help once a day.
When the 24-hour time limit has passed, talk to Angelo (brasilis 297,307) again; he starts a new search for his pets in the field outside the village.
9032.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10000.description: The player must go to the Prontera Royal Court to appraise candidates for the next king and complete the selection process.
guide: Talk to the Messenger (prontera 153,353); he says King Tristan has passed away and asks you to help the Royal Court choose the next king.
Talk to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) and choose 'The Messenger directed me here.'; at Base Level 90 or higher he gives you his character test right away.
Below Base Level 90, the Inspector sends you to Glastheim to defeat Abysmal Knights (level 79) and bring back 2 Reins (item 1064) before he will test you.
10000.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10001.description: Below Base Level 90, the Inspector's qualification test is to bring back 2 Reins (item 1064) from the Abysmal Knight (level 79) in Glastheim.
guide: Talk to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) and choose 'The Messenger directed me here.'; below Base Level 90 he says you must prove your strength first.
Go to Glastheim and beat the Abysmal Knights (level 79) to collect 2 Reins (item 1064).
Give the 2 Reins to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163); he takes them and says the next examination tests your character.
10001.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10002.description: The Inspector's character test: about a dozen situational questions whose answers build up your bravery, intelligence and solidity.
guide: Talk to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) after bringing the Reins; he says the next examination tests your character with simple questions.

Answer his questions about leading a hunt, a lost party member, sharing loot, curing, befriending someone, training, encouragement, virtue, a deserted island, stories, a new monster and ruling the kingdom.
When the questions end, he says you are qualified to evaluate others and asks you to rest before starting work (changequest 10002,10003).
10002.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10003.description: After your character test, the Inspector explains that you must appraise the seven prince candidates one by one and then report back to him.
guide: Talk to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) once the character test is finished; he says he will explain what to do before you start.

Ask him what to do; he explains that the seven candidates from seven families wait in one place, and you must meet them one by one, ask about their quality or observe them, then report back in detail.
When you have no more questions, he says the secret door is behind a soldier at the medic officer's room in the castle (prt_castle); talk to the soldier to get in.
10003.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10004.description: The Interim Report quest has you appraise candidates for the prince position in Rune-Midgarts kingdom, meeting each candidate one by one and answering questions about their qualities.
guide: Talk to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) after appraising the candidates; he says he heard your impressions and thanks you for your work.
He has heard a rumor about Prince Eigen Ahrum of the Walter family and asks you to appraise all the candidates once more; he completes this quest and starts the re-appraisal.
10004.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10005.description: Prince Eigen Ahrum of the Walter family is one of the seven candidates you appraise after the Inspector sends you to the secret door.
guide: Talk to the soldier at the secret door behind the medic officer's room in prt_castle to get in where the princes are.
Meet Prince Eigen Ahrum, ask him questions or observe his actions, then return to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) and explain what you saw.
10005.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89, setting the recommended level to 90.

10006.description: Prince Ernst is one of the seven candidates you appraise after the Inspector's instructions, through the secret door at the medic officer's room in the castle.
guide: Talk to the soldier at the secret door behind the medic officer's room in prt_castle to get in to meet Prince Ernst.
Ask Prince Ernst questions or observe his actions, then return to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) and explain what you observed in detail.
10006.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10007.description: Prince Poe is one of the seven candidates you appraise after the Inspector's instructions, through the secret door at the medic officer's room in the castle.
guide: Talk to the soldier at the secret door behind the medic officer's room in prt_castle to get in to meet Prince Poe.
Ask Prince Poe questions or observe his actions, then return to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) and explain what you observed in detail.
10007.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10008.description: Prince Peter is one of the seven candidates you appraise after the Inspector's instructions, through the secret door at the medic officer's room in the castle.
guide: Talk to the soldier at the secret door behind the medic officer's room in prt_castle to get in to meet Prince Peter.
Ask Prince Peter questions or observe his actions, then return to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) and explain what you observed in detail.
10008.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10009.description: Prince Urugen of the Wigner family is appraised by asking him about his background, his view of the nation and his hobbies.
guide: Talk to Prince Urugen (prt_castle 339,202) and ask about his background, his view of the nation and his hobbies or tastes; he answers each question.
When you have asked all three, choose 'Let me leave.'; he finishes the appraisal and this quest is completed.
10009.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89, so the recommended level is 90.

10010.description: Prince Helmut of Roewenburg is appraised by choosing a subject to ask him about: his background, his ambition or his view of the nation.
guide: Talk to Prince Helmut (prt_castle 289,201) and choose one of his subjects: your background, your ambition or your view of the nation.
He answers and says he is tired of questions; after his answer this appraisal is completed.
10010.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89, so recommended_level is 90.

10011.description: Prince Erich of the Nerius family asks you to confirm that you are the adventurer appraiser, which completes his appraisal.
guide: Talk to Prince Erich (prt_castle 272,375) and answer 'Yes, I am.' when he asks whether you are the adventurer appraiser.
He gives his name and tells you to ask his servant about him; this completes his appraisal.
10011.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10012.description: This quest starts once all seven prince appraisals are complete, and it covers the princes' own conversations with you: Peter, Poe, Urugen and Helmut.
guide: Talk to Prince Peter (prt_castle 364,375); he asks whether you have met the little girl in Aldebaran.
Talk to Prince Poe (prt_castle 391,205); he tests your intuition with a higher or lower card game that you must win twice in a row.
Talk to Prince Urugen (prt_castle 339,202) and Prince Helmut (prt_castle 289,201); each one talks about his background, his view of the nation or his hobbies.
10012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10013.description: Prince Peter gives you a Bouquet (item 744) to take to the unknown girl in Aldebaran (aldebaran 132,184) and asks you to pass on his thanks.
guide: Talk to Prince Peter (prt_castle 364,375) and choose 'Okay, no problem.' to take the Bouquet (item 744) for the girl in Aldebaran.
Give the Bouquet (item 744) to the girl at aldebaran 132,184; she says she loves the flowers and asks you to give her regards to Uncle Peter.
10013.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10014.description: After the girl in Aldebaran receives the flowers, you go back to Prince Peter (prt_castle 364,375); he thanks you and gives you a Gift Box (item 644).
guide: Talk to Prince Peter (prt_castle 364,375) and answer 'Yes, I saw her for you.' or 'No, I don't want to.' when he asks about the little girl in Aldebaran.
He thanks you and gives you a Gift Box (item 644), which completes this quest.
10014.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10016.description: Prince Eigen Ahrum and Prince Ernst both ask whether you have met the Walter family man who was due at the castle, and overhearing two nobles at prt_castle 163,319 moves the quest on.
guide: Talk to Prince Eigen Ahrum (prt_castle 314,373); he says a person from his Walter family is coming today and asks whether you have seen him.
Talk to Prince Ernst (prt_castle 368,312); he has not seen the man either and says Ahrum has not met him.
Walk onto the spot at prt_castle 163,319 near the two nobles; you overhear their plan, and the quest moves on.
10016.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10017.description: After you overhear the nobles, Prince Ahrum sends you away when you tell him you saw a Walter family man, and Prince Ernst then says his brother is acting strange.
guide: Talk to Prince Eigen Ahrum (prt_castle 314,373) and choose 'I have something...' to tell him you saw a person from the Walter family; he says he wants to be left alone and sends you out to prt_castle 318,273.
Talk to Prince Ernst (prt_castle 368,312); he says Ahrum seems strange these days and asks you to slow down your work.
10017.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10018.description: Prince Poe (prt_castle 388,205) argues with Eigen Ahrum about gambling and luck, and the quest completes when Ahrum leaves the room without answering him.
guide: Be in Prince Poe's room (prt_castle 388,205) when Eigen Ahrum arrives; Ahrum tells Poe that his pride and gambling have ruined him.
When Ahrum leaves the room, Poe calls after him and the quest completes.
10018.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10019.description: Eigen Ahrum argues with Prince Peter (prt_castle 364,372) about meaningless actions and then leaves the room with a gloomy face, and the quest completes.
guide: Be in Prince Peter's room (prt_castle 364,372) when Eigen Ahrum arrives; Ahrum talks to Peter about meaningless work and being manipulated.
When Ahrum leaves, Peter is left puzzled and the quest completes.
10019.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10020.description: Prince Erich of the Nerius family argues with Eigen Ahrum, who insults him and leaves the room, and this quest completes when Ahrum goes.
guide: Be in Prince Erich's room (prt_castle 272,372) when Eigen Ahrum comes in; Ahrum calls Erich a junk addict and Erich answers that he represents the Nerius family.
When Ahrum storms out of the room, Erich says he is nuts and the quest completes.
10020.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10021.description: Prince Urugen (prt_castle 336,202) argues with Eigen Ahrum, who insults his looks and leaves the room, and the quest completes when Ahrum goes.
guide: Be in Prince Urugen's room (prt_castle 336,202) when Eigen Ahrum comes in; Ahrum calls Urugen ugly and Urugen orders him out.
When Ahrum leaves, Urugen says he misjudged him and the quest completes.
10021.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10022.description: Prince Helmut (prt_castle 286,201) argues with Eigen Ahrum, who calls him a war monger and leaves the room, and the quest completes when Ahrum goes.
guide: Be in Prince Helmut's room (prt_castle 286,201) when Eigen Ahrum comes in; Ahrum calls Helmut a war monger and Helmut calls Ahrum a coward.
When Ahrum leaves, Helmut calls him a villain and the quest completes.
10022.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89, setting recommended_level to 90.

10023.description: After Eigen Ahrum has clashed with Erich, Urugen, Helmut, Poe and Peter, you are sent to the room where Ernst and Ahrum argue about Ahrum's corruption.
guide: Step onto the warp at prt_castle 336,276, which takes you to prt_castle 368,308 where Ernst and Ahrum talk.
Listen to Ernst and Ahrum (prt_castle 368,310) argue about the kingdom and Ahrum's corruption; Ahrum leaves and the quest moves on.
10023.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10024.description: Eigen Ahrum refuses to be king, gives Ernst a Bazerald and asks him to keep their promise, and the quest completes after Ernst kills his brother.
guide: Talk to Prince Eigen Ahrum (prt_castle 314,373); he says he does not want to be king, throws a Bazerald to Ernst and asks him to remember their promise.
Keep talking to Ahrum (prt_castle 314,373) and Ernst (prt_castle 368,312); Ernst kills his brother, and the quest completes after Ahrum's last words.
10024.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10025.description: After Eigen Ahrum dies by Ernst's hand, you report the accident to the Inspector, who thanks you and asks you to keep it confidential.
guide: Talk to the Inspector (prt_castle 117,163) after Ahrum's death and tell him about the Ahrum and Ernst accident.
He is shocked to hear that Ernst did it, thanks you for your work, asks you to keep everything confidential, and gives you experience based on your Base Level.
10025.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 89.

10034.description: Han Ran Jiao (gonryun 237,226) dropped her ancestor's knife and is too scared of the monsters to go and look for it, so you search the field for it.
guide: Talk to Han Ran Jiao (gonryun 237,226) at Base Level 20 or higher; she says she dropped her irreplaceable knife and is too scared of the monsters to go get it.
Go to gon_fild01 245,257 and step onto the spot where something is hidden under the leaves; you find an old knife (item 1201).
10034.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel >= 20 to start the quest.

10035.description: Deliver Han Ran Jiao's irreplaceable knife to her and return it to complete the quest.
guide: Talk to Han Ran Jiao (gonryun 237,226) who mentions she dropped her irreplaceable knife.
Return the knife to Han Ran Jiao (gonryun 237,226) to complete the quest.
10035.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel >= 20 to start the quest.

10036.description: Magumagu, the Sushi Master in Amatsu, asks you to bring him 10 Candy (item 529) for a dessert and gives you 15 Fish Slices in return.
guide: Talk to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17) and choose 'Do you need assistance?'; when his random request is for candy, he asks you to bring him 10 Candy (item 529).
Bring 10 Candy (item 529) to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17); he thanks you and gives you 15 Fish Slices (item 544).
10036.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10037.description: Magumagu, the Sushi Master in Amatsu, asks you to bring him 10 Crab Shells (item 964) for his sauce and rewards you with 20 Shusi (item 551).
guide: Talk to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17) and choose 'Do you need assistance?'; when his random request is for crab shells, he asks you to bring 10 Crab Shells (item 964) for a sauce.
Bring 10 Crab Shells (item 964) to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17); he thanks you and gives you 20 Shusi (item 551).
10037.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10038.description: Magumagu asks you to bring him 10 Conches (item 961) for an appetizer, and he gives you 30 Shusi (item 551) in return.
guide: Talk to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17) and choose 'Do you need assistance?'; when his random request is for conches, he asks you to bring 10 Conches (item 961) for an appetizer.
Bring 10 Conches (item 961) to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17); he thanks you and gives you 30 Shusi (item 551).
10038.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10039.description: Magumagu asks you to bring him 10 Fish Tails (item 1023) to decorate a platter, and he gives you 20 Fish Slices (item 544) and 30 Shusi (item 551) in return.
guide: Talk to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17) and choose 'Do you need assistance?'; when his random request is for fish tails, he asks you to bring 10 Fish Tails (item 1023) to decorate a platter.
Bring 10 Fish Tails (item 1023) to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17); he thanks you and gives you 20 Fish Slices (item 544) and 30 Shusi (item 551).
10039.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10040.description: Magumagu needs a white platter to serve his fish slices and asks you to bring him 1 China (item 736), for which he gives you 20 Shusi (item 551).
guide: Talk to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17) and choose 'Do you need assistance?'; when his random request is for a white platter, he asks you to bring 1 China (item 736).
Bring 1 China (item 736) to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17); he takes it, thanks you and gives you 20 Shusi (item 551).
10040.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10041.description: Magumagu asks you to bring 100 Hearts of Mermaid (item 950) for a special cuisine, and if he has chosen you as his successor he gives you his knife and completes the quest.
guide: Talk to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17) and choose 'Do you need assistance?'; when his request is for Hearts of Mermaid, he asks for 100 and tells you not to ask why.

Bring 100 Hearts of Mermaid (item 950) to the Sushi Master (ama_in01 162,17); if he has chosen you to inherit his cooking, he takes them, gives you his knife and a Sasimi (item 1144), and completes the quest.
10041.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10057.description: The Recruiter for the Brave_ in Prontera (prt_in 88,105) picks you for a mission to Ash-Vacuum and sends you to the Promotional Staff in Aldebaran for permission.
guide: Talk to the Recruiter for the Brave_ (prt_in 88,105) and choose 'Yes, I am interested.'; he sends you to the Promotional Staff in Aldebaran (aldebaran 127,138).
Talk to the Promotional Staff in Aldebaran (aldebaran 127,138) and choose 'I have something for you.'; he says he will accept you only if you bring 300 Jellopy (item 909).
10057.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.
sources: Recruiter for the Brave_ (no fixed position)

10058.description: Collect 300 Jellopy (item 909) and hand them to the Promotional Staff in Aldebaran (aldebaran 127,138), who then sends you on to Geffen.
guide: Bring 300 Jellopy (item 909) to the Promotional Staff in Aldebaran (aldebaran 127,138); he takes them and says you did the first step.
He tells you to go to the Promotional Staff in Geffen (geffen 90,67) next, where you will be tested again.
10058.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10059.description: After the Aldebaran test, the Promotional Staff in Geffen (geffen 90,67) asks you to bring him an Emerald (item 721) as the second part of your test.
guide: Talk to the Promotional Staff in Geffen (geffen 90,67) and choose 'The Staff in Aldebaran sent me.'; he says it is time for the second part and asks you to bring 1 Emerald (item 721).
10059.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10060.description: The Promotional Staff in Geffen (geffen 90,67) accepts an Emerald (item 721) as evidence and then asks for a Ruby as well.
guide: Bring 1 Emerald (item 721) to the Promotional Staff in Geffen (geffen 90,67); he accepts it as evidence and takes it.
He says he cannot judge you with only one jewel and asks you to bring a Ruby (item 723) next.
10060.level_basis: No gate and no monster level apply. The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10061.description: The Promotional Staff in Geffen asks for a Ruby (item 723) as your second jewel, and once you hand it over he sends you on to Izlude.
guide: Bring 1 Ruby (item 723) to the Promotional Staff in Geffen (geffen 90,67); he says you are absolutely qualified and takes the Ruby.
He says the next step is Izlude, where another Promotional Staff tests you.
10061.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10062.description: The Promotional Staff in Izlude makes the final check, and if you are above Base Level 69 he passes you and sends you back to the Recruiter.
guide: Talk to the Promotional Staff in Izlude and choose 'I have something for you.'; at Base Level 70 or higher he says no more testing is needed.
He tells you to go back to the Recruiter for Brave_ (prt_in 88,105), who will hear that you passed all the steps.
10062.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 69.

10063.description: The Promotional Staff in Izlude refuses adventurers below Base Level 70 and passes you once you reach Base Level 70, then sends you back to the Recruiter for Brave_.
guide: Talk to the Promotional Staff in Izlude while below Base Level 70; he says you are not strong enough and asks you to level up before trying again.
Talk to the Promotional Staff in Izlude at Base Level 70 or higher; he says you are stronger now, passes you, and sends you back to the Recruiter for Brave_ (prt_in 88,105).
10063.level_basis: fixed by a level gate in the script (if (BaseLevel > 69) {)

10064.description: After the Izlude staff passes you, the Recruiter for Brave_ (prt_in 88,105) appoints you to investigate Ash-Vacuum and sends you to Lighthalzen to register for the United Midgard Alliance.
guide: Talk to the Recruiter for Brave_ (prt_in 88,105) after the Izlude test; choose 'Ash-Vacuum?' to hear about the unknown land.
