Go to Lighthalzen (lhz_in01 132,259), where Sikaiz registers adventurers for the United Midgard Alliance, as the Recruiter instructs.
10064.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 69, setting the recommended level to 70.
sources: Recruiter for the Brave_ (no fixed position)

10065.description: At Lighthalzen, Sikaiz gives a speech about researching Ash-Vacuum and the alliance of the three kingdoms, saying the team will leave through the Dimensional Rift soon.
guide: Go to Lighthalzen (lhz_in01 132,259) and talk to Sikaiz; he is giving a speech about the Ash-Vacuum research and the Midgard continent.
Listen to the speech until it ends; the quest moves on and Sikaiz's next talk begins.
10065.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.
sources: Recruiter for the Brave_ (no fixed position)

10066.description: Sikaiz, head of the United Midgard Alliance, explains Ash-Vacuum, Satan Morocc's escape gate and the Dimensional Rift known as the Time-Gap of Dimension.
guide: Talk to Sikaiz (lhz_in01 132,259) at Lighthalzen; he asks whether you want to hear about the status here and you choose 'Sure.'
He explains that Ash-Vacuum is not the world of mortals and that Satan Morocc left an open gate there, which is the Dimensional Rift; the quest moves on when he finishes.
10066.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10067.description: Sikaiz asks you to tell the managers in Rune-Midgarts to prepare for the trip through the Dimensional Rift, because he cannot report the alliance status himself.
guide: Talk to Sikaiz (lhz_in01 132,259) and choose 'The three kingdoms...' when he asks what else you want to know.
He asks you to tell the managers in Rune-Midgarts to prepare for the trip to the Dimensional Rift; the quest moves on once he asks.
10067.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10068.description: Go to the Alliance Manager in Prontera and tell him the alliance is doing well and that you are entering the rift; he thanks you and sends you on.
guide: Talk to Sikaiz (lhz_in01 132,259) again; he says to go to Prontera in Rune-Midgarts and find the Manager there.
In Prontera, talk to the Alliance Manager (no fixed position in the facts) and tell him the Alliance is doing well and you are entering the rift; he thanks you for reporting and says you can go.
10068.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10069.description: Sikaiz tells you the story of the three kingdoms, Rune-Midgarts, Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz, united in one alliance, and introduces Munkenro as his helper.
guide: Talk to Sikaiz (lhz_in01 132,259) at Lighthalzen; he says you did it already and begins the long story of the three kingdoms.
He introduces Munkenro (lhz_in01 136,260), a manager from Schwarzwald and the main contact for its people; the quest moves on when the story ends.
10069.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10070.description: Sikaiz asks you to deliver Munkenro's message to the Cheshrumnir Guard in Rachel, the same kind of errand you did for Rune-Midgarts.
guide: Talk to Sikaiz (lhz_in01 132,259) at Lighthalzen; Munkenro (lhz_in01 136,260) interrupts because he has information to send to Arunafeltz.
Sikaiz asks you to go to the Cheshrumnir Guard in Rachel and deliver Munkenro's message; the quest moves on when he finishes the request.
10070.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10071.description: Report the status of the alliance to the Alliance Manager at Cheshrumnir in Rachel (ra_temple 119,113); he says everything is going well and sends you back to Sikaiz.
guide: Talk to Sikaiz (lhz_in01 132,259) once more; he says there is a Manager in Cheshrumnir in Rachel who handles the alliance.
Go to the Alliance Manager (ra_temple 119,113) and say you came to report the status of the alliance; he says everything is going well and asks you to tell Sikaiz that he received the report.
10071.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10072.description: Sikaiz thanks you for reporting back from Rachel, asks you to investigate Ash-Vacuum and report as much as possible, and says he will tell you the last step of membership.
guide: Talk to Sikaiz (lhz_in01 132,259) after reporting to the Alliance Manager in Rachel; he thanks you and says the preparations will soon be complete.
He asks you to investigate Ash-Vacuum and report as much as possible, then explains the last step to become a member of the alliance; the quest moves on when he finishes.
10072.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10073.description: Sikaiz registers you as a member of the three kingdoms by asking you to type your character name, then sends you to the Officer of Schwarzwald.
guide: Talk to Sikaiz (lhz_in01 132,259) at Lighthalzen; he says he already accepted you and asks you to write your character name.

Type your exact character name; a wrong name makes him ask again, and the correct one completes the registration. He then sends you to the Officer of Schwarzwald in the banquet hall downstairs and asks you to come back after you report to the officer.
10073.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10074.description: Tell the Schwarzwald officers in Lighthalzen that you are leaving for the mission; they talk about Sikaiz and Munkenro, and the quest moves on.
guide: Go to Officer A (lhz_in01 32,22) and Officer B (lhz_in01 30,24) in Lighthalzen, the officers Sikaiz sent you to.
Talk to the officers; they say Sikaiz is hard to understand and that Munkenro is easier to lead, and the quest moves on when they ask your business.
10074.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10075.description: The Schwarzwald officers in Lighthalzen receive your report that you are leaving for the mission and send you back to the meeting room where your allies are.
guide: Talk to Officer A (lhz_in01 32,22) or Officer B (lhz_in01 30,24); they ask why you came, and you were sent by Sikaiz to report your departure.
They accept your report, wish you luck and tell you to go back to the meeting room where your allies are; the quest moves on.
10075.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10076.description: Munkenro, who took over the alliance after Sikaiz retired, tells you that you must pass a short test with the soldiers before he sends you to Ash-Vacuum.
guide: Talk to Munkenro (moc_fild22b 230,197); he says Sikaiz retired urgently and that he is the head of the Three Kingdoms Alliance now.
He says you must be tested again with a short test where the soldiers attack, and asks you to let him know once you are ready; the quest moves on when he finishes.
10076.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10077.description: Munkenro asks whether you are ready for his short test; once you choose 'Ready!!' the test starts and the quest moves on.
guide: Talk to Munkenro (moc_fild22b 230,197); he asks whether you are ready to discover Ash-Vacuum and starts the test when you say so.
Choose 'Ready!!' to start the test; this enables the Head of the Alliance at moc_fild22b 1,1 and moves the quest on. Munkenro warns that being too late counts as a failure, so come back soon.
10077.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10078.description: After you pass Munkenro's test, he completes the quest and lets you go to Ash-Vacuum once you say you are ready, then warps you to mid_camp.
guide: After the test, talk to Munkenro (moc_fild22b 230,197); he says you did a good job and completes this quest.
Talk to Munkenro again and choose 'Yes, of course!' when he asks if you are ready to discover Ash-Vacuum; he warps you to mid_camp (210,291).
10078.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

10079.description: Iromo's mother says her son stopped going out to play with friends, and Iromo says he would rather stay home, although he misses the food sold outside the village.
guide: Talk to Iromo's Mother (alberta_in 120,93) at Base Level 41 or higher; she says her son stopped going out and asks what happened to him, which starts this quest.
Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95); he says his mother wants him to play with friends outside, but he would rather stay home and eat the food he has.
10079.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 40 to start the quest.

10080.description: Little Boy (alberta 45,106), Iromo's friend, says he has not seen Iromo for a long time and asks for a banana before he will remember Iromo's favorite food.
guide: Talk to Little Boy (alberta 45,106), the friend Iromo's mother sent you to; he asks you to buy him a banana (item 513) before he can remember Iromo's favorite food.
Finish the talk; he says he will try to remember Iromo's favorite food if you bring him a banana, and the quest moves on.
10080.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10081.description: Little Boy wants a Banana (item 513) before he remembers Iromo's favorite food, so bring him one banana to finish his talk.
guide: Bring 1 Banana (item 513) to Little Boy (alberta 45,106); he smells it, thanks you and takes it to eat.
After he finishes eating, he says he will tell you what Iromo likes once he is done; talk to him again to start the next step.
10081.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10082.description: Little Boy (alberta 45,106) thanks the player for the Banana and then describes the junk food Iromo used to hide from his mother.
guide: Talk to Little Boy (alberta 45,106) in Alberta to hear his thanks for the Banana.
Listen as Little Boy describes the junk food Iromo used to hide, such as Monster's Feed eaten with Red Potion soup.
10082.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10083.description: Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) takes the Monster's Feed and Red Potion the player brings, then says he is too scared to go outside after a weird cat bit him.
guide: Talk to Little Boy (alberta 45,106) in Alberta, who says Iromo used to like Monster's Feed and Red Potion.
Bring Monster's Feed and Red Potion to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95), who takes them and tells you about the weird cat that bit him.
10083.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10084.description: Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) is scared after a weird cat that walks on two feet bit and scratched him, and the player must make the furious cat leave the village.
guide: Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95), who says the cat that walks on two feet scratched and bit him.
Make the furious cat go away from the village, then talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) to report it.
10084.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10085.description: Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) thanks the player for caring but still refuses to go outside after the cat incident.
guide: Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95), who thanks you for caring but says no thanks to your help.
Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) again, and he may ask whether you have any stories about siblings.
10085.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10086.description: The player tells Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) a story about the siblings Kazien and Lyozien, and Iromo gets annoyed and sends the player away.
guide: Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) and choose the option for a story about a pair of siblings.
Tell him about Kazien and Lyozien, then say that you don't need to be related by blood to be brothers.
Iromo says he is an only child and tells you to get out because he is not in the mood.
10086.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10087.description: Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) refuses to talk for now, then later tells the player about an old friend who forgot him.
guide: Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95), who says he does not want to hear anything and tells you to go away.
Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) again after some time, and he tells you about a friend he met when he went out to play.
10087.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10088.description: The player tells Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) a story about friends and encourages him to get out of his house and see the world.
guide: Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) and tell him a story about a friend who dies in a tragedy, but whose friendship lasts.
Choose the options that urge him to get out of his house and see the world, such as 'You need to get out of your house and see the world.'
10088.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

10089.description: The player tells Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) about journeys, adventures and losses outside the village, and Iromo says he will one day become an adventurer.
guide: Talk to Iromo (alberta_in 131,95) and tell him about the monsters you fought and the people you met outside.
Choose 'It's true, you'll get more than you pay.' when Iromo asks if you just want him to go outside.
10089.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11000.description: Help Alex Helmut with the Odin Shrine Expedition by retrieving Runes of the Darkness from the shrine.
guide: Talk to Alex (hu_in01 19,161) to begin the quest and learn about the expedition.
Accept the task to bring Runes of the Darkness (item 7511) from the Odin Shrine.
11000.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59.

11001.description: Alex Helmut asks the player to bring him 5 Runes of the Darkness from the shrine and gives an Old Blue Box once they are handed over.
guide: Talk to Alex (hu_in01 19,161), who asks you to bring him 5 Runes of the Darkness.
Hand 5 Runes of the Darkness to Alex (hu_in01 19,161) to receive an Old Blue Box; fewer runes are not enough.
11001.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59.

11002.description: After the runes are delivered to Alex (hu_in01 19,161), Laura (hu_in01 14,11) asks the player to spy on the Schwarzwald Republic office.
guide: Talk to Laura (hu_in01 14,11), who says you are a volunteer from the other office and asks for your help.
Agree to Laura's request to spy on Alex of the Schwarzwald Republic office and eavesdrop by the door.
11002.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59.

11003.description: The Odin Shrine Expedition requires the player to assist Laura Laurence in uncovering relics from the Odin Shrine, which is infested with powerful creatures.
guide: Talk to Laura (hu_in01 14,11) at the Odin Shrine office to accept the recruitment notice.
Follow Laura's instructions to go to the Odin Shrine and survey the area for your own benefit.
11003.level_basis: The recommended level of 69 comes from the Rune of Darkness (item 7511) which is dropped by Frus at level 69.

11004.description: Laura (hu_in01 14,11) asks the player to fetch 5 Runes of the Darkness from the Odin Shrine for her research.
guide: Talk to Laura (hu_in01 14,11) and choose 'Yes!' to take on her request for Runes of the Darkness.
Hand 5 Runes of the Darkness to Laura (hu_in01 14,11) to receive an Old Blue Box; fewer runes are not enough.
11004.level_basis: Rune of Darkness (item 7511) is dropped by Frus at level 69.

11005.description: Laura (hu_in01 14,11) and Ashe (hu_in01 16,21) discuss the runes the player delivered, and Laura then asks the player to spy on Alex.
guide: Talk to Laura (hu_in01 14,11) after handing in the runes, and listen as she and Ashe (hu_in01 16,21) talk about the research.
Talk to Laura (hu_in01 14,11) again and agree to spy on Alex of the Schwarzwald Republic office.
11005.level_basis: Rune of Darkness (item 7511) is dropped by Frus (level 69), Skogul (level 70), and Skeggiold (level 81, 83).

11006.description: Laura (hu_in01 14,11) asks the player to eavesdrop on the Schwarzwald Republic office and then report what the team learned.
guide: Talk to Laura (hu_in01 14,11), who asks you to spy on Alex of the Schwarzwald Republic office for her.
Eavesdrop on the Schwaltvalt Office by putting your ear close to the door, as Laura asks.
Talk to Laura (hu_in01 14,11) and report what you learned about the Schwarzwald Republic Research Team, such as Giantes or Ymir's Heart.
11006.level_basis: The recommended level is 69, which comes from the Rune of Darkness (item 7511) being dropped by Frus (level 69), Skogul (level 70), Skeggiold (level 81), or Skeggiold (level 83).

11007.description: Laura (hu_in01 14,11) asks the player to check the inner island of the Odin Shrine while she investigates the Schwarzwald Research Team.
guide: Talk to Laura (hu_in01 14,11) and choose Ymir's Heart when she asks what you learned about the Schwarzwald Republic Research Team.
Check the inner island of the Odin Shrine and see what you can find, as Laura asks.
11007.level_basis: Rune of Darkness (item 7511) is dropped by Skeggiold (level 81).

11008.description: Ashe asks the player to bring a file to Morocc at the South Gate. The quest involves retrieving a file from Laura and delivering it to Morocc.
guide: Talk to Ashe (hu_in01 162,85) to receive the file delivery task
Bring the file to Morocc at the South Gate as requested by Ashe
11008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11009.description: Morriphen (ein_in01 16,36) asks the player to visit his wife Siria in Hugel and ask her for his medicine, telling her only that he ran out.
guide: Talk to Morriphen (ein_in01 16,36) and agree to help him when he asks for a favor.
Visit Siria (hu_in01 326,307) in Hugel and ask her for Morriphen's medicine, telling her only that he ran out.
11009.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11010.description: Siria (hu_in01 326,307) says she ran out of medicine too and asks the player to get Morriphen's medicine from Dono in Lighthalzen.
guide: Talk to Siria (hu_in01 326,307), who asks you to go to Lighthalzen and get Morriphen's medicine from his friend Dono.
Talk to Dono (lighthalzen 88,79) to learn which ingredients he needs.
11010.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11011.description: Dono (lighthalzen 88,79) asks the player to gather ingredients to make medicine for Morriphen and Siria.
guide: Talk to Dono at Lighthalzen (lighthalzen 88,79) to begin the quest
Collect Coal, Brigan, Cyfar, Unripe Apple, Detrimindexta, Shells, Red Herb, Blue Herb, Green Herb, White Herb, and Yellow Herb as instructed by Dono
Return the collected ingredients to Dono at Lighthalzen to complete the quest
11011.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11012.description: Find Makkie and obtain the Red Plant Stem Powder he has for making medicine for Morriphen and Siria.
guide: Go to the Lighthalzen Pub and find Makkie (lhz_in03 193,28), who has the Red Plant Stem Powder Dono asked for.
Tell Makkie that Dono sent you, and receive the small bag of Red Plant Stem Powder from him.
11012.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11013.description: Bring the Red Plant Stem Powder from Makkie to Dono in Lighthalzen, who uses it to finish the medicine for Morriphen.
guide: Talk to Dono (lighthalzen 88,79) and give him the Red Plant Stem Powder from Makkie.
Watch Dono mix the powder into the medicine, then take the medicine to Morriphen.
11013.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11014.description: Dono's finished medicine is taken to Morriphen (ein_in01 16,36), who then sends the player back to Hugel to bring it to Siria.
guide: Take the finished medicine from Dono (lighthalzen 88,79) back to Morriphen (ein_in01 16,36).
Talk to Morriphen (ein_in01 16,36), who learns that Siria also ran out and asks you to bring the medicine to her.
11014.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11015.description: Morriphen (ein_in01 16,36) sends the player back to Hugel to give the medicine to his wife Siria (hu_in01 326,307).
guide: Return to Hugel with the medicine and talk to Siria (hu_in01 326,307), who needs it.
Give the medicine to Siria (hu_in01 326,307), who recovers and thanks you.
11015.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11016.description: After Siria recovers, Morriphen (ein_in01 16,36) tells the player the story of how he and Siria left Rekenber, and asks the player to see Dono.
guide: Talk to Morriphen (ein_in01 16,36), who asks whether Siria is alive, and tell him she is fine.
Listen to his story about Dono and Siria, and suggest that he go see Dono in Lighthalzen.
11016.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11017.description: Fayruz (Scholar at yuno_in04 190,125) asks the player to bring ancient documents, such as Transparent Plates, from Juperos for her thesis.
guide: Talk to Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) in the Juno Library and tell her you read her thesis paper, 'The Fall of Juperos.'
Hear Fayruz ask you to bring any ancient documents from Juperos for her research.
11017.level_basis: Transparent Plate (item 7354) is dropped by Dimik (level 80)

11018.description: Fayruz (Scholar at yuno_in04 190,125) asks the player to read the engraved stone statue at the entrance of a Juperos dungeon and report the message.
guide: Talk to Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) in the Juno Library, who tells you about a stone statue at the entrance of a Juperos dungeon.
Read the engraved message on the stone statue at the entrance of the Juperos dungeon.
Tell Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) what you found, and she translates the message.
11018.level_basis: Transparent Plate (item 7355) is dropped by Dimik (level 82).

11019.description: The player brings Fayruz (Scholar at yuno_in04 190,125) a Transparent Plate from Juperos and hears an ancient tale from her in return.
guide: Talk to Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) and choose 'Please, be my guest.' when she asks to keep a Transparent Plate.
Listen to Fayruz's ancient tale about Juperos while she keeps the Transparent Plate.
11019.level_basis: Transparent Plate (item 7355) is dropped by Dimik (level 82).

11020.description: The player brings Fayruz (Scholar at yuno_in04 190,125) another Transparent Plate from Juperos and hears a tragic tale from her in return.
guide: Talk to Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) and choose 'Take a look at this.' to show her another Transparent Plate.
Listen to Fayruz's tragic story while she keeps the Transparent Plate you gave her.
11020.level_basis: Transparent Plate (item 7354) is dropped by Dimik (level 80).

11021.description: The player brings Fayruz (Scholar at yuno_in04 190,125) another Transparent Plate from Juperos and hears a scary story from her in return.
guide: Talk to Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) and choose 'Yeah, take a look at this.' to show her another Transparent Plate.
Listen to Fayruz's scary story while she keeps the Transparent Plate.
11021.level_basis: Transparent Plate (item 7354) is dropped by Dimik (level 80).

11022.description: Fayruz (Scholar at yuno_in04 190,125) is working through the Transparent Plate you brought and says she has made a breakthrough in her translation. She asks you to come back with any further finds from Juperos.
guide: Talk to Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) in the Juno Library, who says she is struggling to translate the Transparent Plate you brought.
Talk to Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) again, who says she has made a real breakthrough and asks you to wait a moment.
Talk to Scholar (yuno_in04 190,125) once more and tell her whether you found anything new in Juperos.
11022.level_basis: Transparent Plate (item 7352) is dropped by Dimik (level 79)

11029.description: Grandpa Turtle, a drunk in Alberta, tells the player about Turtle Island and sends them to the sailor Gotanblue, who knows the way there.
guide: Talk to Grandpa Turtle (alberta_in 23,104) and choose 'How can I get there?' to hear that Gotanblue knows the way.
Talk to Gotanblue (Sailor, no fixed position) in Alberta, who tells the story of his voyage to Turtle Island.
Pay Gotanblue 10,000 zeny to be taken to Turtle Island, if you still want to go.
11029.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11030.description: The player reads the Voyage log in Alberta until the page about the poisonous fruit gives a Skull key, then uses it on the Skull Stone on Turtle Island.
guide: Read the Voyage log (alberta 246,117) until a page about the poisonous fruit appears, which gives you the Skull key.
Use the Skull key on the Skull Stone (tur_dun01 160,81) on Turtle Island, which opens the stone and gives Banana or Banana Juice.
11030.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11031.description: The player finds the records of the swordsman One in the Voyage log, then uses the Roots key on the tree roots on Turtle Island to read his old scroll.
guide: Read the Voyage log (alberta 246,117) until the page about the swordsman One's records appears, which gives you the Roots key.
Use the Roots key on the Turtle Tree Roots (tur_dun02 132,251) to open a little door and read the old scroll.
11031.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11032.description: The player finds a Security key in the Voyage log about hidden treasure, then uses it on the Turtle stone (tur_dun01 203,155) to reveal the red bead.
guide: Read the Voyage log (alberta 246,117) until the page about the hidden treasure appears, which gives you the Security key.
Use the Security key on the Turtle stone (tur_dun01 203,155) to reveal the red bead, then set the red bead into the Security key.
11032.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11033.description: The player uses the Turtle Crystal key from the old scroll on a pile of turtle crystal on Turtle Island to find a crystal plate and the Turtle Pillar key.
guide: Use the Turtle Crystal key on the pile of turtle crystal (tur_dun02 46,125) to open its key hole.
Read the message on the crystal plate that appears between the crystals, then take the long key at its edge, the Turtle Pillar key.
11033.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11034.description: The player uses the Turtle Pillar key on the Turtle Pillar on Turtle Island, which opens a little door that releases a stone bead and items.
guide: Use the Turtle Pillar key in the key hole at the base of the Turtle Pillar (tur_dun02 49,158).
Listen to the Turtle Stone Bead that rolls out of the door, then take the items under the pillar.
11034.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11035.description: The player takes the Security key with the red bead to the Turtle stone on tur_dun02 75,249, which reveals the yellow bead and the location of the third stage.
guide: Use the Security key in the keyhole of the Turtle stone (tur_dun02 75,249), which reveals the hidden words of the second stage.
Set the yellow bead that rests under the stone's words into the Security key, which points you to the third stage at tur_dun03 118,233.
11035.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11036.description: The player takes the Security key with the yellow bead to the Turtle Stone on tur_dun03 118,233, which reveals the blue bead and the location of the Turtle Statue.
guide: Use the Security key in the keyhole of the Turtle Stone (tur_dun03 118,233), which splits the stone to reveal its words.
Set the blue bead that rests under the words into the Security key, which points you to the Turtle Statue (tur_dun04 113,178).
11036.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11037.description: The player uses the Security key on the Turtle Statue (tur_dun04 113,178), which opens a metal plate with a lever and a drawer holding a reward.
guide: Use the Security key in the keyhole on top of the Turtle Statue (tur_dun04 113,178), which splits the statue and reveals a metal plate.
Pull the lever at the bottom of the metal plate to open the drawer and take the reward, usually a Dead Branch.
11037.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11038.description: Erious (prt_in 161,20) asks the player to deliver a message to his late wife Elly in the town of the dead.
guide: Talk to Erious (prt_in 161,20) and choose 'Comfort him.' to hear that Elly died while he was away on a trip.
Hear Erious say he hopes to reach the town of the dead, but he cannot leave his children behind.
Choose 'I can deliver your message to her.' to accept his message that what happened a month ago was all his fault.
11038.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11039.description: Billik (umbala 215,181) sends the player to find Feylin in Niflheim and bring him a rose, since Feylin likes roses.
guide: Talk to Billik (umbala 215,181), who asks you to find Feylin and tell him that Billik introduced you.
Bring a rose for Feylin, so that he knows for sure that Billik sent you.
Talk to Feylin (niflheim 153,215), who says nobody in Niflheim can perform that kind of miracle and tells you to leave.
11039.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79.

11040.description: Feylin (niflheim 153,215) tells the player to leave Niflheim because he knows nothing about the dead, and the player presses him to reveal more.
guide: Talk to Feylin (niflheim 153,215), who tells you to leave immediately because he knows nothing about what you ask.
Choose 'But...' and Feylin says you must know something, but he will not speak of contacting the dead, which is taboo.
11040.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79.

11041.description: Feylin (niflheim 153,215) agrees to try a summoning spell for the player, which costs 10 Yggdrasil Leaf and a Witherless Rose and may fail.
guide: Talk to Feylin (niflheim 153,215), who says Billik must have sent you and warns that the price may be more than you expect.
Choose 'I'm willing to do this.' and then 'Yes' to accept the sorcery, which requires 10 Yggdrasil Leaf and a Witherless Rose.
Let Feylin cast the spell: if it fails, he says the spirit cannot be summoned, and if it works, Elly appears and gives you a box.
11041.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79.

11042.description: After the summoning failed, Erious (prt_in 161,20) thanks the player for trying and gives 10 Yggdrasil Leaf as a token of gratitude.
guide: Talk to Erious (prt_in 161,20), who asks whether you were able to meet Elly.
Choose 'Sorry, I couldn't.' and Erious thanks you for your effort and gives you 10 Yggdrasil Leaf.
11042.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79.

11043.description: After Elly gives the player a box to deliver, Erious (prt_in 161,20) asks what she said and rewards the player with Yggdrasilberry and Yggdrasil Leaf for the box.
guide: Talk to Erious (prt_in 161,20), who asks whether you were able to meet Elly.
Choose 'Yes.' and then 'Yes. And she gave me...this.' to hand over the Memento that Elly gave you.
Receive the reward from Erious, which includes Yggdrasilberry and Yggdrasil Leaf, if your inventory has room.
11043.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 79.

11044.description: Hua Tuo (Doctor, lou_in02 265,69) asks the player to visit the Tool Shop in Luoyang, because he has run out of medicine for a patient.
guide: Talk to Doctor (lou_in02 265,69) and choose 'I can help you.' to hear that he has run out of the medicine he needs.
Choose 'I don't mind, I'd be glad to help.' and the Doctor asks you to visit the Tool Shop Master (lou_in02 248,166).
Talk to Tool Shop Master (lou_in02 248,166) and say you are here to get something for the doctor, and he sends you to check the storage.
11044.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11045.description: Jiang Xiayou (Storage Keeper, lou_in02 201,166) asks the player to fetch official documents from City Hall, and tells the player which document type to request.
guide: Talk to Storage Keeper (lou_in02 201,166) and choose 'I'm on an errand for the doctor.' to hear his request.
Choose 'Um, what is it?' and Jiang Xiayou asks you to get official documents from City Hall for him.
Go east to the building that looks like it was made in gauge form, which is City Hall, and remember the document type Jiang Xiayou names.
11045.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11046.description: The player takes the Residence Transfer Application request to the City Hall Officer (Jin Chiyuan, lou_in02 210,47), who hints that a payment will speed up the paperwork.
guide: Talk to City Hall Officer (lou_in02 210,47) and choose 'I need a document.' to hear that the line is long.
Choose 'A little zeny to cut the red tape, eh?' and enter at least 10000 zeny that you carry.
Go upstairs, where another officer gives you the document, as Jin Chiyuan says.
11046.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11047.description: The player takes the Summer SAT Class Application request to the City Hall Officer (Jin Chiyuan, lou_in02 210,47) and pays at least 10000 zeny to have it processed.
guide: Talk to City Hall Officer (lou_in02 210,47) and choose 'I need a document.' to hear that the line is long.
Choose 'A little zeny to cut the red tape, eh?' and enter at least 10000 zeny that you carry.
Go upstairs, where another officer gives you the document, as Jin Chiyuan says.
11047.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11048.description: Help a doctor by obtaining the Sandy Dust Phenomenon Report document from City Hall.
guide: Talk to City Hall Officer (lou_in02 210,47) and choose 'I need a document.' to hear that the line is long.
Choose 'A little zeny to cut the red tape, eh?' and enter at least 10000 zeny that you carry.
Go upstairs, where another officer gives you the Sandy Dust Phenomenon Report, as Jin Chiyuan says.
11048.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11049.description: The player takes the Communication Proposal request to the City Hall Officer (Jin Chiyuan, lou_in02 210,47) and pays at least 10000 zeny to have it processed.
guide: Talk to City Hall Officer (lou_in02 210,47) and choose 'I need a document.' to hear that the line is long.
Choose 'A little zeny to cut the red tape, eh?' and enter at least 10000 zeny that you carry.
Go upstairs, where another officer gives you the Communication Proposal, as Jin Chiyuan says.
11049.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11050.description: After the player declines Jiang Xiayou's errand, the player searches the Supply Stacks in the Luoyang storage area for the Herb Medicine the doctor needs.
guide: Talk to Storage Keeper (lou_in02 201,166), choose 'I'm on an errand for the doctor.', then 'Sorry, I'm busy.' to decline his errand.
Search the Supply Stacks around the storage, such as lou_in02 204,169, and rummage through them for the medicine.
When a stack gives up the Herb Medicine, the quest moves on to the Doctor (lou_in02 265,69).
11050.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11051.description: After the bribe, Jin Chiyuan (City Hall Officer, lou_in02 210,47) tells the player that the officer who holds the document is waiting upstairs.
guide: Talk to City Hall Officer (lou_in02 210,47), who says you have been handled and that the officer you need is upstairs.
Go upstairs to find that officer and ask for the Residence Transfer Application.
11051.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11052.description: After the bribe, Jin Chiyuan (City Hall Officer, lou_in02 210,47) tells the player that the officer who holds the Summer SAT Class Application is waiting upstairs.
guide: Talk to City Hall Officer (lou_in02 210,47), who says the officer you need has been contacted and is waiting upstairs.
Go upstairs to find that officer and ask for the Summer SAT Class Application.
11052.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11053.description: After the bribe, Jin Chiyuan (City Hall Officer, lou_in02 210,47) tells the player that the officer who holds the Sandy Dust Phenomenon Report is waiting upstairs.
guide: Talk to City Hall Officer (lou_in02 210,47), who says the officer you need has been contacted and is waiting upstairs.
Go upstairs to find that officer and ask for the Sandy Dust Phenomenon Report.
11053.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11054.description: After the bribe, Jin Chiyuan (City Hall Officer, lou_in02 210,47) tells the player that the officer who holds the Communication Proposal is waiting upstairs.
guide: Talk to City Hall Officer (lou_in02 210,47), who says the officer you need has been contacted and is waiting upstairs.
Go upstairs to find that officer and ask for the Communication Proposal.
11054.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11055.description: The player asks the Studying Officer (Huang Zhishu, lou_in02 156,38) for the document named by Jiang Xiayou, then returns it to the storage keeper for the Herb Medicine.
guide: Talk to Studying Officer (lou_in02 156,38), choose 'I came to pick up my documents.', and wait for him to ask what document you need.
Type the exact document name that Jiang Xiayou gave you, such as Residence Transfer Application; a wrong name is refused.
Return to Storage Keeper (lou_in02 201,166) with the document, and he gives you the Herb Medicine.
11055.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11056.description: Bring herb medicine to Doctor Hua Tuo to treat his patient. The medicine is needed urgently and cannot be obtained from monsters.
guide: Talk to Doctor (lou_in02 265,69) and hand over the Herb Medicine for his patient.
Choose 'I'm sorry, I can't help you.' to finish the quest and take a reward, or 'No problem.' to hear his next request.
11056.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11057.description: The Doctor (Hua Tuo) in Luoyang needs medicine and herbal items to treat his patients. You must bring the required items to complete the quest.
guide: Talk to Doctor (lou_in02 265,69), who lists the medicines he still needs for his patients.
Gather 2 Leopard Claw, 10 Solid Peach, 5 Poisonous Toad Skin, 20 Brown Root, 10 Sprout and 5 Honey Pot.
Return to Doctor (lou_in02 265,69) with all the items, and he gives you a reward and a warning about dosage.
11057.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11070.description: Poison King Nagash Arses (lou_in02 123,39) starts this quest by sending the player to his last disciple, Song Zhi Du, when the player asks about the use of poison.
guide: Talk to Poison King (lou_in02 123,39) and choose 'Ask about use of Poison.' to ask him to teach you.
If he says he is too old to teach and remember everything, nothing starts.
If he agrees, he sends you to Song Zhi Du (Employee, lou_in02 253,45), who works at the doctor's office, and the quest is set.
11070.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11071.description: Song Zhi Du (Employee, lou_in02 253,45) is disappointed that you said revenge is not good, and if you apologize he asks you to help him gather materials for a poison.
guide: Talk to Employee (lou_in02 253,45), who says he is disappointed that you cannot understand his feelings.
Choose 'I'm sorry for last time.' to apologize; choosing 'No matter what, revenge isn't good.' ends the talk without progress.
Hear him ask for 4 Bee Sting, 10 Venom Canine, 10 Empty Potion and 30 Green Potion, then answer whether you have any problem with that.
11071.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11072.description: Song Zhi Du (Employee, lou_in02 253,45) takes 4 Bee Sting, 10 Venom Canine, 10 Empty Potion and 30 Green Potion from you for his poison.
guide: Talk to Employee (lou_in02 253,45) and choose 'Yes.' when he asks whether you gathered everything.
Hand over 4 Bee Sting, 10 Venom Canine, 10 Empty Potion and 30 Green Potion; if any are missing, he says you are still missing some of the items.
After he takes them, he says he accepts your apology and that he is nearly ready to make the poison.
11072.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11073.description: Song Zhi Du (Employee, lou_in02 253,45) is waiting for a delivery, which the Lady at the Luoyang entrance (lou_fild01 224,348) gives you for a 1,000 zeny fee.
guide: Talk to Lady (lou_fild01 224,348) at the entrance of Luoyang and choose 'Yes.' when she asks whether someone sent you.
Type 'Song Zhi Du' as the sender; she says she has no package for anyone else.
Pay the 1,000 zeny delivery fee, and she gives you the Large Jellopy to bring to Song Zhi Du.
11073.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11074.description: The Large Jellopy from the Lady goes to Song Zhi Du (Employee, lou_in02 253,45), whose first poison attempt fails.
guide: Talk to Employee (lou_in02 253,45) and hand over the Large Jellopy, which he says he needed.
Watch him make the poison; the attempt fails, and he says he spent a long time preparing the materials.
11074.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11075.description: Song Zhi Du (Employee, lou_in02 253,45), who works in the doctor's medicine storage and was Nagash Arses's disciple, asks you to gather the materials for a second poison attempt.
guide: Talk to Employee (lou_in02 253,45), who says the poison failed again and asks you to help him.
Bring him 4 Bee Sting, 10 Venom Canine, 10 Empty Potion Bottle, 30 Green Potion and 1 Large Jellopy, then talk to him to start the attempt.
If the poison succeeds, he gives it to you; talk to him again and he asks you to sneak into the Castle of the Dragon with it.
11075.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11076.description: Song Zhi Du asks you to sneak the finished poison into the Castle of the Dragon and put it into a drink bottle that is possibly Lord Bai Long's.
guide: Talk to Employee (lou_in02 253,45), who warns that the Castle of the Dragon is under heavy surveillance.
Click the drink bottle at lou_in01 107,163 in the castle to put the poison into it.
After the poison is in the bottle, the quest moves on to its next stage.
11076.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

11077.description: The Poison King quest involves a conversation with Nagash Arses about a poem and his past as a poison expert.
guide: Poison King (lou_in02 123,39) asks about the poem and its meaning.
Poison King (lou_in02 123,39) discusses his hometown Morocc and the Canine of Desert organization.
11077.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11078.description: The Poison King (Nagash Arses) shares his backstory as a renowned poison expert and former assassin from the 'Canine of Desert' organization.
guide: Talk to Poison King (Nagash Arses) at his location
He asks about a famous poem by Li Tai Bai
He mentions his hometown Morocc and his past as a poison expert
He recounts his story as an assassin and poison specialist
11078.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11079.description: The Poison King quest involves learning about the legendary Nagash Arses, his past as an assassin, and his connection to the Canine of Desert organization through a series of questions.
guide: Speak with Poison King (lou_in02 123,39) about a famous old poem by Li Tai Bai.
Ask Poison King about his hometown Morocc
Inquire about the Canine of Desert organization
Discuss the use of poison and his expertise
11079.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11080.description: A conversation with Poison King (Nagash Arses) where he shares his story as a renowned poison expert and his organization 'Canine of Desert'.
guide: Talk to Poison King (lou_in02 123,39) in the quest.
Listen to his story about his past as a poison expert and his time with the 'Canine of Desert' organization.
11080.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11081.description: The Poison King (Nagash Arses) is an old poison expert who asks the player about his past, his famous poem, and his hometown of Morocc. The quest involves answering questions about his life and the poem by Li Tai Bai.
guide: Speak with Poison King (lou_in02 123,39) in Luoyang
Answer questions about the poem by Li Tai Bai
Discuss his hometown of Morocc
Learn about the use of poison and his past as a poison expert
11081.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11082.description: The Poison King (Nagash Arses) from Luoyang tells the player about his past as a renowned poison expert from the Canine of Desert organization and asks about a famous poem. The quest involves dialogue and learning about poison use.
guide: Talk to Poison King (Nagash Arses) in Luoyang to learn about his history as a poison expert.
Answer his questions about the poem, his hometown Morocc, and his past to progress the quest.
11082.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11083.description: The Poison King (Nagash Arses) shares his story as a former poison expert and quizzes the player on his poem; the player can also ask about his hometown and the Canine of Desert organization.
guide: Poison King (lou_in02 123,39) tells the player about his past as a poison expert and asks about the poem
Ask him about his hometown, and he describes Morocc, a city built in the middle of the desert
Choose 'Info about Canine of Desert' to hear about the Assassin organization he used to belong to
If you ask him about the use of poison, he says he is too old to teach and may send you to his last disciple, Song Zhi Du
11083.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11084.description: Marian (mid_camp 222,283) sends a newcomer to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284), who asks whether they will join the federal survey team.
guide: Talk to Marian (mid_camp 222,283), who gives you a Chocolate Pie and sends you to Instructor Lugen.
Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) and choose 'Yes.' when he asks whether you will join the survey team.
11084.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11085.description: Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) sends the player to Receptionist Brink (mid_campin 106,122) in the big building to register for the federal survey team.
guide: Go to the big building in the center of the camp and talk to Receptionist Brink (mid_campin 106,122).
Answer his registration questions, give your name, and confirm when he asks whether it is finished.
11085.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11086.description: After registering with Receptionist Brink, the player returns to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284), who gives a nameplate and sends the player to the barracks.
guide: Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284), who says he got a call from the receptionist.
Take your nameplate from Lugen and go to your accommodations in the barracks; he gives you a Chocolate Pie.
11086.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11087.description: Repair the broken tent at the camp by gathering materials from the surrounding area.
guide: Talk to Diego (mid_camp 264,263) and choose 'Help him.' to hear what he needs for the broken post.
Get Ordinary Branches from the trees west of the camp, since they can be used as posts.
Get Strong Vine from Nepenthes in the field east of the camp, since its vines are very strong.
Bring 20 Ordinary Branches and 20 Strong Vine to Diego, and he asks you to attach the branches and tie the post.
11087.level_basis: Strong Vine (item 6041) is dropped by Nepenthes (level 75).

11088.description: Diego has the branches and vines, and the player fixes the first broken barracks post at Post (mid_camp 267,263) by attaching the branches and tying them with vines.
guide: Talk to Post (mid_camp 267,263) and choose 'Attach the tree bar.' to attach the branch to the broken post.
Choose 'Tie it with the vines.' until the post seems fixed; if the vines are not enough, you need more branches.
When the post seems fixed, choose 'Knot it.' to finish the knot; Diego says to do the same to the other post.
11088.level_basis: Strong Vine (item 6041) is dropped by Nepenthes (level 75).

11089.description: The second barracks post at mid_camp 267,258 needs the same repair: attach a tree bar, tie it with vines, and knot it, after which Diego says the broken posts are perfectly fixed.
guide: Talk to Post (mid_camp 267,258), which says the barracks posts are broken and must be fixed.
Choose 'Attach the tree bar.' and then 'Tie it with the vines.' on this post; keep tying until it seems fixed.
When it seems fixed, choose 'Knot it.' to finish the knot; Diego then says the broken posts are perfectly fixed.
11089.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11090.description: Diego (mid_camp 264,263) thanks the player for repairing the barracks posts, gives a Chocolate Pie and sends the player inside to rest before tomorrow's expedition.
guide: Talk to Diego (mid_camp 264,263) now that the broken posts are perfectly fixed; he says the barracks are protected thanks to your help.
Tell Diego that you were assigned to stay in the barracks; he says it must be fate and gives you a Chocolate Pie, the special product of this camp.
Diego asks you to come in and rest for the expedition, and you are taken inside the camp building at mid_campin 291,128.
11090.level_basis: Strong Vine (item 6041) is dropped by Nepenthes (level 75).

11091.description: Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) asks the player to fetch supplies from the motherland from Marian (mid_camp 222,283) so they can be delivered around the camp.
guide: Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284), who asks you to distribute supplies from the motherland and sends you to Marian.
Talk to Marian (mid_camp 222,283) and say the Instructor sent you to get supplies from the motherland.
Marian hands over the supplies: 3 Supply Box (item 6045) and a Chocolate Pie.
11091.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11092.description: Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) checks the supply boxes from Marian and sends the player to deliver the first box to Jan, northwest of the camp.
guide: Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284), who asks whether you received the supplies and wants to see them.
If you have at least 3 Supply Box (item 6045), he says the first box goes to Jan, northwest of the camp, who may be around the fence.
If you do not have enough boxes, Lugen asks you to check with Marian (mid_camp 222,283).
11092.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11093.description: Jan (mid_camp 160,298), who ordered a product a month ago, receives the first Supply Box from the motherland and asks you to tell the Instructor she is grateful.
guide: Talk to Jan (mid_camp 160,298), northwest of the camp, who has been waiting for a product she ordered a month ago.
Give her the Supply Box (item 6045); she is excited and asks you to tell the Instructor she is grateful.
Jan gives you a Chocolate Pie in return.
11093.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11094.description: Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) hears that Jan received her supply box and sends the next box on to Gerard across the west bridge outside the camp.
guide: Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284), who asks whether the supplies reached Jan.
If you have at least 2 Supply Box (item 6045), he gives you the next box for Gerard, who is investigating across the west bridge outside the camp.
If you do not have enough boxes, Lugen asks you to check with Marian (mid_camp 222,283).
11094.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11095.description: Gerard (mid_camp 30,168), who is investigating across the west bridge outside the camp, receives the second Supply Box and asks you to tell the Instructor he will not be back for some time.
guide: Talk to Gerard (mid_camp 30,168) and say Instructor Lugen sent you for an errand; he says he is starving.
Give him the Supply Box (item 6045); he says he really appreciates it and asks you to tell the Instructor he will not be back for some time.
11095.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11096.description: Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) asks after Gerard, then sends the last Supply Box to Alberto at the entrance of the eastern field.
guide: Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284), who asks whether Gerard is well; he has been worried since Gerard went out for the investigation.
He says the last Supply Box (item 6045) is for Alberto at the entrance of the eastern field, who may have ordered a heavy coat, and asks you to hurry.
11096.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11097.description: Alberto (man_fild01 80,248), who is cold at the entrance of the eastern field, receives the last Supply Box with the heavy coat he ordered and asks you to tell the Instructor he is still alive.
guide: Talk to Alberto (man_fild01 80,248) and say the Instructor sent you on an errand with his coat.
Open the Supply Box (item 6045) for him, since his hands are too cold; he says the coat makes him feel alive.
Alberto asks you to tell the Instructor that he is still alive.
11097.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11098.description: Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) thanks the player for the supply deliveries after Alberto's message that he is still alive, and completes the quest.
guide: Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) after delivering the last box to Alberto; he says your work was a great help.
He tells you to take care of yourself, and the quest is completed.
11098.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11099.description: Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) asks the player to take a letter to his friend Otto (mid_camp 123,290), who is working on the barrier in the west, and bring back Otto's reply.
guide: Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) and choose 'Help.' when he says he is worried about his friend Otto; he gives you the Letter from Lugen (item 6043).
Take the Letter from Lugen to Otto (mid_camp 123,290), who is working on the barrier in the west.
Give Otto the letter; he asks you to tell Lugen that he is ok and gives you the Letter from Otto (item 6044) to take back.
11099.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11100.description: Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) thanks the player for meeting Otto and taking back his letter, then gives an Old Violet Box and Chocolate Pie.
guide: Talk to Instructor Lugen (mid_camp 261,284) and say you met Otto, who is doing very well.
Hand over the Letter from Otto (item 6044), which Lugen takes; he then gives you an Old Violet Box and a Chocolate Pie.
Lugen says Otto would come to see him and thanks you, and the quest is completed.
11100.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11101.description: Bazett Teablack (mid_camp 283,198), who believes fairies and giants live nearby, asks the player to help search the Manuk and Splendide fields for signs of them.
guide: Talk to Bazett Teablack (mid_camp 283,198) while wearing the Ring of the Ancient Wise King, and he asks whether you will help with his search.
Choose 'Sure.' to accept; he introduces himself as Bazett Teablack and asks you to search the Manuk and Splendide fields every day for signs of fairies or giants.
Share what you find in those fields; when he asks you to search for giants in the Manuk Field, he gives you Bazett's Order (item 6074) to bring back when you finish.
11101.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11102.description: The player receives a secret note from Bazett Teablack and must search for giants in the Manuk Field before returning the note.
guide: Bazett Teablack (mid_camp 283,198) gives the player the secret note (Bazett's Order, item 6074)
Bazett Teablack (mid_camp 283,198) asks the player to search for giants in the Manuk Field
Bazett Teablack (mid_camp 283,198) receives the note back upon completing the search
11102.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11104.description: After the player reports the search, Bazett Teablack (mid_camp 283,198) thanks them for the notes, tells them to rest, and says they will continue tomorrow.
guide: Talk to Bazett Teablack (mid_camp 283,198) and choose 'Yes.' when he asks whether you are done with the investigation.
He reads the notes and praises your work, and may give you a Manuk Coin (item 6080) that the giants use.
If you lost the notes, he says you must rest and that he will prepare new notes for you to investigate again.
11104.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

11105.description: Gill, a worker at the Manuk tent, asks the player for 30 Horn of Hillslion (item 6032) to make sturdy screws after the tent screw breaks.
guide: Talk to the Worker (manuk 193,135) while wearing the Ring of the Ancient Wise King; without it he speaks a language you cannot understand.
When the screw breaks, Gill introduces himself and asks you to collect 30 Horn of Hillslion, which can be found from the Hillslion monster.
Bring 30 Horn of Hillslion to Gill (manuk 193,135), who makes the screws and thanks you for preventing a disaster.
11105.level_basis: Horn of Hillslion (item 6032) is dropped by Hillslion (level 105).

12000.description: Maku (lighthalzen 337,232) talks about his old friend Digotz, who lives in Uptown Lighthalzen, and Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210) calls Maku just a jerk and says they are no longer friends.
guide: Talk to Maku (lighthalzen 337,232), who explains that the poor are not allowed to explore the city and mentions a rich friend he used to have.
Talk to Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210) in Uptown Lighthalzen and choose the option asking whether he knows someone named Maku.
Digotz says Maku is his childhood friend who is now just a jerk, asks you to forget what he said, and the quest moves on to 12001.
12000.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12001.description: After the player says they met Digotz, Maku (lighthalzen 337,232) recalls their old friendship, says Digotz probably hates him, and insists that he hates Digotz.
guide: Talk to Maku (lighthalzen 337,232) and choose 'I actually met Digotz and...' when he asks what you are doing back there.
Maku says they were real close once, but he probably hates his penniless guts, and the quest moves on to 12002.
He then insists he hates Digotz and will beat him to a pulp the next time he sees him.
12001.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12002.description: Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210) has the player carry an insulting message to Maku, and Maku's furious reaction is brought back to Digotz.
guide: Talk to Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210), who gives you a message for Maku to deliver line by line, starting with 'Hopeless bastard!'
Talk to Maku (lighthalzen 337,232) and type each line of the message in order; after the last line he rages, and the outburst costs you half of your HP.
Return to Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210), who asks whether you delivered the message, and the quest moves on to 12003.
12002.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12003.description: Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210) says Benkaistein could not make Maku apologize, so the player finds Benkaistein, the Passionate Student (yuno_in04 96,106), and tells him about the quarrel.
guide: Talk to Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210), who says Benkaistein could not make Maku apologize and that he misses him.
Talk to the Passionate Student (yuno_in04 96,106) and keep calling 'Benkaistein' until he notices you.
Choose 'Tell him about Maku and Digotz.' and he says they are having a childish fight; he then starts looking for something, which starts 12004.
12003.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12004.description: Benkaistein (Passionate Student, yuno_in04 96,106) has lost his journal and asks the player to help find it, the Friend's Diary (item 7351).
guide: Talk to the Passionate Student (yuno_in04 96,106), who has lost something and asks you to help look for it.
Find the Friend's Diary (item 7351), which is Benkaistein's journal, and bring it back to him.
Hand over the journal; Benkaistein thanks you and asks you to give it to Digotz and Maku.
12004.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12005.description: Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210) reads Benkaistein's Journal (item 7351) that the player brings, says he will go see Maku, and later is stabbed by a man in a black suit and dies.
guide: Talk to Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210) while carrying Benkaistein's Journal (item 7351) and choose 'Show Benkaistein's Journal.'
Digotz reads the journal, which recalls the wing game, the monster fight and the oath of brotherhood, and then says he will go see Maku.
At friendship 14, talk to Digotz (lhz_in02 201,210) again; he is stabbed by a man in a black suit and dies, you take the Knife (item 1201) from his body, and the quest moves on to 12006.
12005.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12006.description: After Digotz dies and the player has taken the Knife (item 1201), the Passionate Student Benkaistein (yuno_in04 96,106) thanks the player, gives experience and a Pass (item 7350), and completes the quest.
guide: Talk to the Passionate Student (yuno_in04 96,106), who asks whether you brought his journal to Digotz and Maku.
Benkaistein thanks you, says he will be glad to see the two of them again, and says he will let you know when the three of them get together.
He gives you experience and a Pass (item 7350), which completes the quest.
12006.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12007.description: The Old Man (lighthalzen 141,162) sends the player to Kazien (Young Man, lhz_in01 174,258), who needs part-time help in the corporation building and asks whether the player can keep confidential information.
guide: Talk to the Old Man (lighthalzen 141,162), who says Kazien is short of help and suggests you find him inside the corporation building.
Talk to Kazien (Young Man, lhz_in01 174,258) and offer to help for a fee; he turns you away if you are under Base Level 70, and otherwise asks whether you can keep confidential information.
Answer 'Yes, of course.' and talk to Kazien again; he gives your first assignment and the quest moves on to 12008.
12007.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12008.description: Kazien sends the player to the Einbroch Laboratory to confirm that Researcher Garins received his order, but the Laboratory Guard (einbroch 55,52) refuses to let the player in.
guide: Talk to the Laboratory Guard (einbroch 55,52) and say you need to see Mr. Garins to confirm that he received a package.

The guard checks the employee list, says there is no Garins working there, and refuses entry; talk to Kazien (Young Man, lhz_in01 174,258) and report it, and he says you failed the test, which moves the quest to 12009.
If you instead say you will come back later or leave, the guard sends you away and the quest moves on to 12010.
12008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12009.description: After the failed test, Kazien (Young Man, lhz_in01 174,258) turns the player down, and on a random later visit he says he does not remember them, which erases the quest.
guide: Talk to Kazien (Young Man, lhz_in01 174,258) after the failed test; he says he cannot trust you and tells you to find another employer.
On some visits Kazien says he has never met you and is too busy to remember, and the quest is erased; otherwise he keeps refusing you.
12009.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12010.description: After the Laboratory Guard (einbroch 55,52) turns the player away, Kazien (Young Man, lhz_in01 174,258) reveals that Garins was a test the player passed, and sends the player on to Lyozien.
guide: Talk to the Laboratory Guard (einbroch 55,52), who blocks the entrance; choose to leave, or say you will come back later, which moves the quest to 12010.
Talk to Kazien (Young Man, lhz_in01 174,258) and report that you could not get past the guard; he says you passed the test, since Garins is a name he made up.
When you come back to Kazien, he tells you to meet Lyozien on the international flight Airship, which moves the quest to 12011.
12010.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12011.description: On the international flight Airship, Lyozien (airplane_01 96,48) asks the player to deliver his goods to Izlude and tell Mr. Ahman that his order has safely arrived.
guide: Talk to Lyozien (airplane_01 96,48) on the Airship, step around the fragile piles of packages, and say you are the one Kazien sent.
Lyozien says the goods must go to the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom and that he has to stay behind to guard them.
Lyozien asks you to go to Izlude, find Mr. Ahman at the Airport and tell him that his orders have safely arrived; this moves the quest to 12012.
12011.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12012.description: The player finds Mr. Ahman, a hidden NPC with no fixed position at Izlude Airport, tells him his packages have arrived, and is sent back to Lyozien.
guide: Talk to the hidden NPC at Izlude Airport (no fixed position) and ask where to find Ahman; he introduces himself as Ahman.
Tell Ahman that his packages have arrived and are being guarded until he picks them up; he asks whether you are a new worker for Lyozien and Kazien.
Ahman thanks you and says to go back to Lyozien, which moves the quest to 12013.
12012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12013.description: After escorted deliveries for Lyozien and Kazien, the player learns that the packages hold hi-tech weapons and guardians, and Kazien ends the part-time work, which completes the quest.
guide: Report to Lyozien (airplane_01 96,48) after Ahman's pickup; he says the work is done for today and asks you to ask Kazien for the next job.
Talk to Kazien (Young Man, lhz_in01 174,258), who says the Rune-Midgarts order was received and sends you back to Lyozien for the next delivery.
On the Airship, Lyozien (airplane_01 96,48) asks you to protect the packages when thugs attack, and Kazien sends you on to each next delivery.
Ask Kazien (lhz_in01 174,258) what the packages hold; after you say you saw the hi-tech weapons, he says he cannot have you working with him and Lyozien anymore, and the quest is completed.
12013.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12014.description: Fishbone (lighthalzen 341,224) offers a secret route into the Regenschirm Laboratory in exchange for 20 Jellopy (item 909), and the quest completes when the player returns from that route.
guide: Talk to Fishbone (lighthalzen 341,224), who asks for a huge amount of zeny and then settles for 20 Jellopy (item 909); choose 'Okay.' to accept.
Bring 20 Jellopy (item 909) back to Fishbone and choose 'Here you go!' to hand them over; he takes them and says he will prepare the route.
Talk to Fishbone again and choose 'Yes.' when he says he is ready; he warps you to the secret path to the Laboratory.
Return to Fishbone (lighthalzen 341,224) after the trip and say you got what you wanted; this completes the quest.
12014.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel >= 60.

12015.description: The player overhears a secret meeting by the hidden Switch (lighthalzen 173,167), then Ghalstein (Ordinary Man, lighthalzen 179,170) recruits the player to work against the Rekenber Corporation.
guide: Talk to Ghalstein (Ordinary Man, lighthalzen 179,170) about Lighthalzen; his talk sets up the hidden Switch (lighthalzen 173,167).
Step onto the hidden Switch (lighthalzen 173,167) and choose 'Keep listening.' to hear the two men; the quest begins when the other voice leaves.
Question Ghalstein (lighthalzen 179,170) about the meeting and choose 'Sure, I'll cooperate.' before taking the red tonic; refusing knocks you out and sends you back to Lighthalzen.
Ghalstein briefs you on the Rekenber Corporation and the underground Regenschirm laboratory, and the quest moves on to 12016.
12015.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12016.description: Ghalstein (Ordinary Man, lighthalzen 179,170) sends the player to find a contact in the eastside slums who can sneak them into the Laboratory, and the evidence the player brings back completes the stage.
guide: Talk to Ghalstein (Ordinary Man, lighthalzen 179,170), who says to look in the eastside slums for someone who can get you inside the Laboratory.
Inside the Laboratory, search for records and concrete evidence, then bring back a Ymir's Heart Piece (item 7346), 10 Research Chart (item 7347) and 10 Handcuffs (item 7345).
Hand the evidence to Ghalstein (lighthalzen 179,170), who keeps the items and gives you a Membership Card (item 7348), and the quest moves on to 12017.
12016.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12017.description: Ghalstein (Ordinary Man, lighthalzen 179,170) gives the player a Membership Card (item 7348), which Gushaar (Dismal Guy, yuno_fild04 165,245) checks before explaining the Secret Wing's goal.
guide: Talk to Ghalstein (Ordinary Man, lighthalzen 179,170) after handing in the evidence; he gives you the Membership Card (item 7348) and sends you to Gushaar near Juno.
Talk to Gushaar (Dismal Guy, yuno_fild04 165,245), choose 'Red Tonic' when asked which tonic to drink, then choose 'Oh, right!' to show him your Membership Card (item 7348).
Talk to Gushaar again to hear that Rekenber Corporation controls the Schwarzwald Republic and that the new president is sympathetic to the Secret Wing.
Talk to Gushaar once more; he gives the president's visiting hours and sends you to meet the president, and the quest moves on to 12018.
12017.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12018.description: Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79) of the Schwarzwald Republic explains the Secret Wing's background and goal, then gives the player a File Folder (item 7342) to take to Ms. Hes O'Neil and sends them to Benith at Kafra Headquarters.
guide: Talk to Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79), who offers to answer questions about the Secret Wing's background, Rekenber's purpose and the Secret Wing's goal.
Choose 'I'm ready for my mission.' and then 'Yes sir, Mr. President.' to hear that he is searching for the file.

Talk to Mr. President again to receive the File Folder (item 7342); he asks you to bring it to Ms. Hes O'Neil and visit Benith at the Kafra Headquarters in Al De Baran, which moves the quest to 12019.
12018.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12019.description: Benith (Kafra Employee, aldeba_in 155,240) at the Kafra Headquarters gives the player a rescue mission for Jargeah, a Secret Wing agent stuck in Grim Reaper's Valley, after the player shows the Membership Card (item 7348).
guide: Talk to the Kafra Employee (aldeba_in 155,240), who explains the Dungeon Teleport Service election in Prontera and Juno.
Choose 'Are you Benith' and then 'Show Membership Card.' to show the Membership Card (item 7348) to Benith.
Benith says the agent Jargeah is hiding near a broken bridge in Grim Reaper's Valley, between Einbroch and Lighthalzen, and the quest moves on to 12020.
12019.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12020.description: The player finds the wounded agent Jargeah (Wounded Man, lhz_fild02 228,214) in Grim Reaper's Valley, answers which organization he asks about, and receives the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) from him.
guide: Find the Wounded Man (lhz_fild02 228,214) near a broken bridge in Grim Reaper's Valley, between Einbroch and Lighthalzen.
Talk to him and choose 'Jargeah'; when he asks which organization you work for, answer Kafra Corporation or Secret Wing.
He hands you the Sealed File Folder (item 7343), and the quest moves on to 12021.
12020.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12021.description: Benith (Kafra Employee, aldeba_in 155,240) reads the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) that the player brings from Jargeah, then returns it and sends the player to take it to the president.
guide: Bring the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) to Benith (aldeba_in 155,240) at Kafra Headquarters, who says he will read the files first.
Talk to Benith again; he gives the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) back and the quest moves on to 12022.
Take the file to Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79), as Benith asks.
12021.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12022.description: Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79) reviews the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) and learns of Shinokas, a Rekenber researcher who vanished, which sends the player to find him.
guide: Hand the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) to Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79), who takes it to review.
Talk to Mr. President again until he finishes the review; he finds that Shinokas, a Rekenber researcher who vanished, was seen in Einbroch.
He asks you to find Shinokas and hurry, and the quest moves on to 12023.
12022.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12023.description: Find Shinokas, a researcher from Rekenber who vanished, and complete the mission to uncover his secret.
guide: Talk to Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79), who says Shinokas was seen in Einbroch and asks you to find him and learn his secret.
Once you know Shinokas's secret, talk to Mr. President again; he sends you to a Kafra contact near Lighthalzen, which completes this quest and starts 12024.
12023.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12024.description: After the president's briefing, the Mysterious Woman (Esuna, lhz_fild01 66,219) sends the player into the Rekenber Corporation to steal incriminating evidence from the Secret Archive, using a pass to meet Agent Lestin.
guide: Find the Mysterious Woman (lhz_fild01 66,219) in the fields just outside of Lighthalzen, who says she has been waiting for you.
Listen to Esuna's briefing: you need identification from one of the agents, then must find the Secret Archive, disable its security and steal the evidence.
She tells you to use your pass for the Rekenber buildings and meet Agent Lestin, which moves the quest to 12025.
12024.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12025.description: After Esuna's briefing about Rekenber Corporation, Agent Lestin (Researcher, lhz_in01 285,169) explains how to sneak into the Secret Archive and gives the player the Archive Permit (item 7349).
guide: Talk to the Mysterious Woman (Esuna, lhz_fild01 66,219), who says you must sneak into Rekenber Corporation and steal incriminating evidence, then asks you to meet Agent Lestin.
Use the pass you have for the Rekenber buildings to reach Agent Lestin (Researcher, lhz_in01 285,169) in the laboratory.
Lestin says the guards change shifts so you can sneak in, the Secret Archive is to the right of the laboratory, and he gives you the Archive Permit (item 7349); the quest moves on to 12026.
12025.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12026.description: With the Archive Permit (item 7349), the player sneaks past the guards into the Secret Archive, finds the Shinokas Case File (item 7344), and returns to Agent Lestin, who takes the permit back.
guide: Talk to Agent Lestin (Researcher, lhz_in01 285,169), who says to hide behind a corner and wait until the two guards change shifts, then sneak past them.

Inside the Secret Archive, to the right of the laboratory, use the File Search Engine next to the door to look for files about Rekenber's secret that Shinokas discovered; the pass lets you stay only 3 minutes at a time.
Return to Agent Lestin (lhz_in01 285,169) with the Shinokas Case File (item 7344); he takes the Archive Permit (item 7349) back and sends you to find Esuna, which moves the quest to 12027.
12026.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12027.description: The player takes the Shinokas Case File (item 7344) to Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79), then carries the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) from Esuna back to the president before Esuna reports the betrayal.
guide: Talk to the Mysterious Woman (Esuna, lhz_fild01 66,219), who asks you to bring the file to President Weierstrass and check on him first.
Talk to Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79) while carrying the Shinokas Case File (item 7344); he takes it and sends you back to Esuna.
Talk to Esuna (lhz_fild01 66,219) again, who gives you the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) and asks you to take it to the president right away.
Give the Sealed File Folder (item 7343) to Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79), who asks you to speak to Esuna one more time.
Talk to Esuna (lhz_fild01 66,219), who says the Secret Wing must leave the Schwarzwald Republic; this moves the quest to 12028.
12027.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12028.description: After Esuna reports that Kurelle betrayed the Secret Wing, Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79) confronts Kurelle, and Ghalstein (Ordinary Man, lighthalzen 179,170) completes the quest with an Old Violet Box (item 617) and experience.
guide: Talk to the Mysterious Woman (Esuna, lhz_fild01 66,219), who says Kurelle sold out the Secret Wing and that its members must leave the Schwarzwald Republic.
Talk to Mr. President (yuno_pre 69,79); he sends for Kurelle, who admits to reporting everything to the Rekenber Corporation.
Talk to Ghalstein (Ordinary Man, lighthalzen 179,170) after the confrontation; he gives you an Old Violet Box (item 617) and experience, and the quest is completed.
12028.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12029.description: Shuda asks the player to search the water for her engagement ring, and fishing at Dannai's rod rental (one Monster's Feed and 50 Zeny per cast) turns it up, which moves the quest to 12030.
guide: Talk to Powerful-Looking Woman (Shuda, ayothaya 233,105) and follow her dialogue until she asks you to look under the water for her engagement ring (item 7288).
Talk to the Fisherman (Dannai, ayothaya 253,99) and choose 'Yes.' to rent a rod; each cast costs one Monster's Feed (item 528) as bait and 50 Zeny.
Keep fishing until you take the engagement ring from the water, which moves the quest on to 12030.
12029.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12030.description: The player returns the engagement ring (item 7288), caught while fishing, to Shuda (Powerful-Looking Woman, ayothaya 233,105), and she asks the player to find Annon next.
guide: Talk to Shuda (Powerful-Looking Woman, ayothaya 233,105) while carrying the engagement ring (item 7288).
Shuda thanks you and asks you to find Annon and tell him to come back; either reply you choose leads to the same request.
