Shuda takes the engagement ring (item 7288), and the quest moves on to 12031.
12030.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12031.description: The player asks Tham (Old Man, ayothaya 193,171) about the man who ran into the forest toward the shrine, and Tham's answer moves the quest to 12032.
guide: Talk to the Old Man (Tham, ayothaya 193,171), who says he saw someone run into the forest that leads to the shrine.
Tham says the man was screaming about someone named Shuda, and the quest moves on to 12032.
12031.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12032.description: Following Tham's report of a man running toward the shrine, the player finds footprints and blood traces in the Ayothaya dungeon that lead north, which moves the quest to 12033.
guide: Step on AyoFootprint1 (ayo_dun01 255,62), which shows footprints heading north toward the shrine.
Step on AyoFootprint8 (ayo_dun02 86,254), which shows traces of blood leading north; the quest moves on to 12033 after either footprint.
12032.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12033.description: The player follows the trail of blood in the Ayothaya dungeon to a blood stain under a large tree at ayo_dun02 91,263, which leads to the hidden bushes where the injured man is hiding.
guide: Step on the blood stain at ayo_dun02 91,263 under the large tree; it is not always recognized as blood, so keep stepping on it.
When the stain is confirmed as blood ('That's definitely blood.'), the quest moves on to 12034.
12033.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12034.description: The player digs up the bushes at ayo_dun02 91,263 and finds the wounded Haggard Man (Annon, ayo_dun02 91,264), treats him with a White Potion (item 504), and completes the quest after he asks the player to keep his whereabouts secret from Shuda.
guide: Dig up the bushes at ayo_dun02 91,263 under the large tree until the burrow opens and the Haggard Man (ayo_dun02 91,264) appears.
Choose 'Treat his wound first.' and use a White Potion (item 504) if you have one; without one, he is too badly hurt for normal potions and you must bring back a stronger potion.
Agree to keep his whereabouts secret from Shuda; he gives you a massage, and the quest is completed.
12034.level_basis: White Potion (item 504) is dropped by Moonlight Flower (level 67)

12035.description: Dusit (ayothaya 83,132) tells the player about the Sa-mhing Tiger and sends them to Boonthom (Shaman, ayo_in01 181,193), who asks for the materials to make a holy object for the ancient ruins.
guide: Talk to Dusit (ayothaya 83,132) and choose 'What is it?' to hear the story of the Sa-mhing Tiger, then agree to be introduced to Boonthom.
Talk to Boonthom (Shaman, ayo_in01 181,193), who says the tiger is locked in a cave in the ancient ruins; choose 'I want to explore the ancient ruins.' and then 'Sure!'
Boonthom asks for the sewing items (Needle Pouch and Spool, or Transparent Cloth and Fox Tail), a Solid Husk (item 7190) and a Holy Water (item 523), and the quest moves on to 12036.
12035.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12036.description: The player brings the sewing items, a Solid Husk (item 7190) and a Holy Water (item 523) to Boonthom (Shaman, ayo_in01 181,193), who makes the first Thread Skein (item 7285).
guide: Gather the sewing items (Needle Pouch and Spool, or Transparent Cloth and Fox Tail), one Solid Husk (item 7190) and one Holy Water (item 523).
Return to Boonthom (Shaman, ayo_in01 181,193) with all four items; he makes the holy threads and gives you a Thread Skein (item 7285), and the quest moves on to 12037.
12036.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12037.description: With the first Thread Skein (item 7285), the player enters the ancient ruins, copies the stone slate message, and brings it back to Boonthom, who asks for stronger materials.
guide: Carry the Thread Skein (item 7285) into the ancient ruins; Boonthom says the building has two underground levels and asks you to return to him before entering the second.
Read the last piece of the stone slate at ayo_dun01 16,188, which completes the message you copied while exploring.
Show the copied message to Boonthom (Shaman, ayo_in01 181,193); he asks for Holy Water (item 523), Yggdrasil Leaf (item 610) and the sewing items, and the quest moves on to 12038.
12037.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12038.description: After the stone slate message, Boonthom asks the player to gather Holy Water (item 523) and Yggdrasil Leaf (item 610) so he can craft the stronger Holier Threads (item 7287) for the second underground level.
guide: Gather two Holy Water (item 523), one Yggdrasil Leaf (item 610) and two of each sewing item (Needle Pouch and Spool, or Transparent Cloth and Fox Tail).
Return to Boonthom (Shaman, ayo_in01 181,193) with those items; he crafts the Holier Threads (item 7287), and the quest moves on to 12039.
12038.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12039.description: With the Holier Threads (item 7287), the player finds the remains of Boonthom's comrade in the ruins (ayo_dun02 268,108), takes the Old Blue Box (item 603), and shows the old letter to Boonthom, which completes the quest.
guide: Enter the second underground level of the ruins with the Holier Threads (item 7287) and find the skeletal remains at ayo_dun02 268,108.
Read the paper beside the skeleton and take the box, which is the Old Blue Box (item 603).
Show the old letter to Boonthom (Shaman, ayo_in01 181,193); he thanks you, and the quest is completed.
12039.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

12040.description: Kurupe (hugel 56,104) asks the player to find his lazy worker Burupu outside Hugel, and Burupu agrees to help milk Booboo the cow if the player brings him a Rapier with 2 Slots (item 1110), which moves the quest to 12041.
guide: Talk to Kurupe (hugel 56,104) and choose 'Sure.' to accept the job of finding Burupu.
Find Burupu (hu_fild06 217,270) outside of town and talk to him; he complains about his sword and asks for a Rapier with 2 Slots (item 1110) in exchange for milking Booboo.
Choose 'Alright.' to agree, and the quest moves on to 12041.
12040.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 49.

12041.description: Burupu (hu_fild06 217,270) receives the Rapier with 2 Slots (item 1110) that the player brings, then tells the player where he hid his milking instructions, which moves the quest to 12042.
guide: Talk to Burupu (hu_fild06 217,270) while carrying the Rapier with 2 Slots (item 1110); without it he reminds you of the bargain.
Burupu takes the Rapier (item 1110) and says his secret instructions for milking Booboo the cow are hidden under the ground just northeast of her.
Burupu says to find and read the instructions; the quest moves on to 12042.
12041.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12042.description: After Burupu takes the Rapier, the player finds his small notebook of milking instructions at hugel 72,101 and reads it, which removes this quest.
guide: Find Burupu's Instructions (hugel 72,101), the small notebook Burupu hid northeast of Booboo the cow.
Read the notebook's table of contents; it covers how to milk Booboo, how to treat her, and that you need Kurupe's permission and 3 Concentration Potions (item 645).
Reading the notebook removes the quest.
12042.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12043.description: The player milks Booboo the cow (hugel 68,99) with the magic comb, which needs 3 Concentration Potions (item 645), then reports to Kurupe (hugel 56,104), who gives a reward and removes the quest.
guide: Talk to Kurupe (hugel 56,104), who asks you to milk Booboo the cow as soon as you can.
Talk to Booboo the Cow (hugel 68,99) and choose 'Attempt to Milk Booboo' with 3 Concentration Potions (item 645) in your bag; the comb uses them up.
Brush Booboo the number of times her song calls for, and type the changed word from her song without the tilde; success starts this quest.
Report to Kurupe (hugel 56,104); he gives you a reward and the quest is removed.
12043.level_basis: The level gate in the script (if (BaseLevel > 49)) sets the recommended level to 50.

12044.description: Torpy (hugel 107,67) tells the player that his Daddy has been missing, and the player goes to Torpy's Mom (hu_fild06 190,367), who says she is fine and asks the player to pass that on to Torpy, which moves the quest to 12045.
guide: Talk to Torpy (hugel 107,67), choose 'What's wrong?' and then 'Really? Tell me more...' to hear that his Daddy has not been home for days.
Talk to Torpy's Mom (hu_fild06 190,367), who says she only stepped out of the house and is looking for her husband.
Torpy's Mom asks you to tell Torpy that she is fine and will be home soon, and the quest moves on to 12045.
12044.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 49, setting recommended_level to 50.

12045.description: The player passes Torpy's Mom's message to Torpy (hugel 107,67): she is fine and only stepped out of town. Torpy hopes his Daddy comes back soon, which moves the quest to 12046.
guide: Talk to Torpy (hugel 107,67) and tell him that his Mom is fine and will be coming back home soon.
Torpy hears that his Mom was just outside of town and hopes his Daddy comes back soon, which moves the quest to 12046.
12045.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 49.

12046.description: The Suspicious Barrel at hugel 100,176 holds a hungry Strange Man who asks the player to cook Steamed Crab Nippers for him.
guide: Talk to the Suspicious Barrel (hugel 100,176), where the Strange Man says he is starving and asks for Steamed Crab Nippers; choose 'I'll bring you Steamed Crab Nippers.'
The Strange Man says the Steamed Crab Nippers must be cooked with 10 Green Herbs, 1 Yellow Potion and 10 Nippers, which moves the quest to 12047.
12046.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 49.

12047.description: The Strange Man hiding in the Suspicious Barrel (hugel 100,176) eats the Steamed Crab Nippers (item 12051) the player brings, then appears at hugel 100,174 and says he is playing Hide-and-Seek with his son.
guide: Dump the Steamed Crab Nippers (item 12051) into the Suspicious Barrel (hugel 100,176), where the Strange Man eats them.
Talk to the Strange Man (hugel 100,174) and ask why he is hiding in the barrel; he says he is playing Hide-and-Seek with his son, and the quest moves on to 12048.
12047.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12048.description: After Torpy's father is found hiding in the barrel, the player tells Torpy's Mom (hu_fild06 190,367), who thanks the player with Green Salad (item 12065) and experience and completes the quest.
guide: Talk to Torpy (hugel 107,67), who asks you to go and tell his Mom that Daddy is safe.
Talk to Torpy's Mom (hu_fild06 190,367), who learns that her husband was hiding inside a barrel; she thanks you with 3 Green Salad (item 12065) and experience, and the quest is completed.
12048.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12059.description: Orc's Memory is a party dungeon that the party leader reserves for a party of at least 2 members, all between Levels 30 and 80. Its 2-hour time limit (7200 seconds) erases the quest records so the dungeon can be regenerated.
guide: As the party leader, talk to Dimensional Gorge Piece (gef_fild10 242,202) and choose 'Reserve the Orc's Memory' to book the dungeon.
Choose 'Enter the Dungeon' to enter; the quest 12059 is set when a party member enters.
Talk to the Piece again after the 2-hour time limit (7200 seconds); it erases the quest and says you can regenerate or re-enter the dungeon.
12059.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12060.description: A fishing quest where the player must catch pieces of fish for Ferocious Gorurug.
guide: Talk to Ferocious Gorurug (mid_camp 69,144), choose 'Gyaruk has sent me.' and then 'What should I do?' to learn how to fish.
Click a School of Fish (spl_fild02 314,165) in the water outside the town to catch fish; Pieces of Fish (item 6039) are among the catches.
Bring 10 Pieces of Fish (item 6039) to Ferocious Gorurug to get experience; he is off-duty until the 86400-second time limit passes, then he takes fish again.
12060.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

12062.description: Collect Unidentified Mineral (item 6048) for Cat Paw Mining Agent by visiting the frozen land to the east.
guide: Cat Paw Mining Agent (mid_camp) asks the player to bring minerals for collection.
Cat Paw Mining Agent (mid_camp) instructs the player to go to the frozen land to the east to collect Unidentified Mineral (item 6048).
12062.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17000.description: An agent's message at the Event Switch (airplane_01 90,63) says Father Bamph is expecting the player at Prontera Church. Father Bamph then sends the player to Larjes, his informant in Comodo, which moves the quest to 17001.
guide: Step on the Event Switch (airplane_01 90,63) to receive the agent's message that Father Bamph is waiting at Prontera Church.
Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106), who says a high-ranking man has disappeared and sends you to Larjes in the Casino in Comodo, which moves the quest to 17001.
17000.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17001.description: Meet with Larjes (Ordinary Man) to discuss the investigation of a high ranking man who vanished, including details about suspicious bags being carried west and possible kidnapping by an organization.
guide: Find Larjes (Ordinary Man, cmd_in02 111,52) in the Casino in Comodo, who says he has new information about the missing official.
Larjes says the official left the guards to meet a woman, and that after he left, other people carried large baggage west.
Choose 'Why to the west?' and Larjes guesses the kidnappers are from Arunafeltz, which moves the quest to 17002.
17001.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17002.description: After Larjes's report, the player tells Father Bamph what was learned. Bamph asks the player to continue the investigation in Arunafeltz on the Church's behalf, and the player can accept.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) and choose 'Tell him what Larjes said.' to report the findings; he says he needs a moment to think.

Talk to Father Bamph again; after a random roll he asks for your help, and if you choose 'Of course, I'll help.' he gives you airship money and sends you by the Izlude airship to Rachel in Arunafeltz, which moves the quest to 17003.
17002.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17003.description: The player reaches Rachel and orders a meal at the MealConversation Trigger (ra_in01 301,43), where the Waiter serves a Fried Veins Stripe Stickleback and the player overhears talk about smugglers, which moves the quest to 17004.
guide: Step on the MealConversation Trigger (ra_in01 301,43) and choose '...Yes, that sounds good.' to order from the Waiter (ra_in01 308,59); the dish costs 3,000 zeny.
Listen to the diners at the next table talk about smugglers arrested at the southeast beach in Veins; the Waiter brings the dish and the quest moves on to 17004.
17003.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17004.description: In Veins, the player asks the Magistrate (Al Hamad, ve_in 78,314) about the smugglers, but he refuses to discuss his problems with a stranger, which moves the quest to 17005.
guide: Talk to the Magistrate (Al Hamad, ve_in 78,314) and choose 'Are you in trouble?'.
Al Hamad says he is not comfortable talking to strangers about his problems, and the quest moves on to 17005.
17004.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17005.description: The Magistrate is frustrated by the ongoing smugglers investigation involving a kidnapped official from Rune-Midgarts. The soldier (Himus) is also concerned about the magistrate's stress over the case.
guide: Try the Magistrate (Al Hamad, ve_in 78,314) again; he says you are not allowed to enter the office and must leave.
Talk to Soldier (Himus, ve_in 81,296) and choose 'Who are the smugglers?'; he says the Magistrate hates interference, and the quest moves on to 17006.
17005.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17006.description: The Magistrate (Al Hamad, ve_in 78,314) refuses to share details of the smugglers case, and he asks for a written order from a higher ranking officer before the player can learn more, which moves the quest to 17007.
guide: Talk to the Magistrate (Al Hamad, ve_in 78,314) and choose 'I want to know about the smugglers.'.
Al Hamad says he cannot disclose details of the ongoing investigation and asks you to bring a written order from a higher ranking officer; the quest moves on to 17007.
17006.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17007.description: The player asks High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159) in Rachel about the Veins incident, and Zhed says the smugglers were with a high ranking Rune-Midgarts official and sends the player to Niren, which moves the quest to 17008.
guide: Talk to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159) in Rachel and choose 'Ask About Veins Incident.'
Zhed says the smugglers were with a high ranking official from the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom and tells you to speak with Niren; the quest moves on to 17008.
17007.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17008.description: High Priestess Niren (ra_temple 165,57) reveals that the captive was held in a monastery southwest of Veins across the sea and asks the player to find out what happened there, which moves the quest to 17009.
guide: Talk to High Priestess Niren (Niren, ra_temple 165,57) and choose 'Ask About Veins Smugglers.'
Choose 'Accept' to take Niren's favor; she says the monastery is southwest of Veins across the sea, reached by a boat at South Veins Beach, and the quest moves on to 17009.
17008.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17009.description: Investigate the smugglers who kidnapped a high-ranking official from Rune-Midgarts. Continue the investigation into the Veins smugglers and their activities.
guide: Talk to the Magistrate (Al Hamad, ve_in 78,314) in Veins, who knows that Niren sent you and now explains the smugglers case.
Al Hamad says the smugglers kidnapped an official from Comodo and that temple men took the smugglers away before the interrogation ended; the quest moves on to 17010.
17009.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17010.description: A drunkard in Veins (ve_in 239,115) says a man who sailed out to sea came back early because he thought he saw a ghost, which points the player to Kurdi's father, a fisherman, and moves the quest to 17011.
guide: Talk to the Drunkard (Drunkard, ve_in 239,115), who says the man who sailed out to sea came back early after he thought he saw a ghost.
The player decides to check on Kurdi's father, since he is a fisherman, and the quest moves on to 17011.
17010.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17011.description: Kid Karyn (veins 327,185) asks the player to borrow her father's boat, since the Pope has stopped him from using it, and the player agrees to keep it secret, which moves the quest to 17012.
guide: Talk to Kid Karyn (Kid, veins 327,185), who says Kurdi is recovering and asks you to ask her father whether you can borrow his boat.
Karyn says her father is not allowed to use the boat for now and asks you to keep the loan secret; agree, and the quest moves on to 17012.
17011.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17012.description: At the boat (ve_fild07 125,128), Larjes (Secret Agent, ve_fild07 128,130) explains that Arunafeltz is involved and offers to help the player sail to the monastery. Choosing to set sail moves the quest to 17013.
guide: Talk to the boat at ve_fild07 125,128; the Secret Agent (ve_fild07 128,130) then reveals himself as Larjes and explains that Arunafeltz is involved in the case.
Larjes offers to sail with you to the monastery; choose 'Yes, I'm ready.' and the quest moves on to 17013.
17012.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17013.description: The player sails from the boat at ve_fild07 125,128 to the island, where at the Night spot (nameless_n 169,254) Larjes sees the island's true nature and says he will wait in the boat, which moves the quest to 17014.
guide: Talk to the boat (ve_fild07 125,128) and choose 'Go to Monastery' to sail to the island.
Step onto the Night spot (nameless_n 169,254); Larjes sees the island's true nature and says he will wait in the boat, which moves the quest to 17014.
17013.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17014.description: Examining the books at abbey02 224,70 reveals a blood-stained book, which gives the player the Research Note (item 7755) and moves the quest to 17015.
guide: Examine the Books at abbey02 224,70 and choose 'Examine Book' for the blood-stained one among the old books.
Reading the book gives you the Research Note (item 7755), and the quest moves on to 17015.
17014.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17015.description: On the island, the player examines the Dead Man at abbey03 232,232 and finds a shining medal in his jacket, the Token of King (item 7726).
guide: Examine the Dead Man (abbey03 232,232) and take the Token of King (item 7726) from the medal in his jacket.
17015.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17016.description: Back at Larjes (nameless_n 259,218) on the island, the player hands in the Token of King (item 7726), and Larjes says the dead man was Tristram III and that Arunafeltz was behind the poison grass.
guide: Talk to Larjes (nameless_n 259,218) while carrying the Token of King (item 7726); he says the dead man was Tristram III.
Larjes says Arunafeltz was behind the poison grass, takes the Token of King (item 7726), and gives you experience.
17016.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

17017.description: The player brings the Research Note (item 7755) from the monastery to High Priestess Niren (ra_temple 165,57), who reads it, decides to send troops, and gives experience.
guide: Give the Research Note (item 7755) to Niren (ra_temple 165,57) and let her read it.
Niren decides to send troops to the monastery, takes the Research Note, and gives you experience.
17017.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18030.description: Busy Boy (prontera 248,212) drops his books, and the player helps him pile them up and agrees to deliver the Pile of Books (item 7431) to Karlomoff, the Historian at the Juno library (yuno 311,195).
guide: Help Busy Boy (prontera 248,212) pile the books he dropped, then choose 'Help him' when he asks you to deliver them to Juno.
Take the Pile of Books (item 7431) to the Historian (Karlomoff, yuno 311,195), who says he has been waiting for his delivery.
18030.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59.

18031.description: Research the Gaebolg family curse by delivering Karlomoff's report to Historian Rodafrian in Morocc and completing dialogue exchanges about Rune-Midgarts history and a song.
guide: Talk to Historian Rodafrian (morocc_in 45,126) and choose 'Mr. Karlomoff has sent me.' to hand over the File Folder (item 7342).

Answer her song questions: choose 'Yes, I have.' and give the line after 'The eagle of the rainbow swallowed the serpent', which is 'Then the eagle built its nest.'; a wrong line removes the File Folder (item 7342).
Give Rodafrian your name, and she asks you to find her colleague Mondo at Mount Mjolnir (mjolnir_01 135,168) for the song's lyrics.
18031.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18032.description: Historian Mondo (mjolnir_01 135,168) on Mount Mjolnir checks the song lyrics the player types, and then says his version came from a little kid who sings it near the river.
guide: Talk to Historian Mondo (mjolnir_01 135,168) and type the four lines of the song you heard, one at a time.
Mondo says his version came from a little kid, and suggests finding that kid near the river on Mount Mjolnir.
18032.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18033.description: Deliver herbs to Father Bamph in Prontera Church after receiving a Leather_Pouch from the Exhausted-Looking Woman.
guide: Talk to the Exhausted-Looking Woman (mjolnir_01 316,268), who asks you to stop her son Kaanu's song and then asks what brings you there.
Choose 'Accident?' and she asks you to take her herbs to Father Bamph in Prontera Church (prt_church 185,106), and you receive the Leather Pouch (item 7432).
18033.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18034.description: Deliver the herb pouch to Father Bamph in Prontera Church and learn about the Geoborg family curse involving Bonnie Imbullea.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) and choose 'Give him the herb pouch.' to hand over the Leather Pouch (item 7432).
Father Bamph explains Jormungand's curse on the Geoborg family and asks you to visit Bonnie Imbullea at mjolnir_01 316,268 to learn about the song.
18034.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18035.description: Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316,268) admits the exorcism failed and mentions a Red Gemstone fragment found at the secret ceremonial grounds, which the player then takes back to Father Bamph.
guide: Talk to Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316,268), who asks whether you delivered the herb pouch to Father Bamph.

Tell her Father Bamph sent you to ask about the royal secret and her exorcism; she explains that the exorcism failed and that a maid found a fragment of a Red Gemstone at the secret ceremonial grounds.
Head back to Father Bamph in Prontera Church (prt_church 185,106) with the news about the Red Gemstone.
18035.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18036.description: Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) hears about the Red Gemstone fragment and asks the player to go with him to the secret ceremonial grounds to check whether the exorcism was sabotaged.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) and tell him what Bonnie Imbullea said about the Red Gemstone fragment.
Father Bamph says a Red Gemstone has no reason to be in a holy place and asks you to use the hidden switch in the bookshelf to reach the secret ceremonial grounds, where he will meet you.
18036.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18037.description: The player examines the body of the first prince (prt_church 19,111,5) and finds a dark mark on his sleeve that looks like the scales of a serpent.
guide: Examine the first prince's body at prt_church 19,111,5.
Pull up the prince's sleeve to see the dark mark that resembles the scales of a serpent.
18037.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18038.description: The player examines the second prince's body (prt_church 21,111,5) with Father Bamph and finds that his scale marks are fainter and differ from the first prince's, which suggests a conspiracy.
guide: Examine the second prince's body at prt_church 21,111,5, where Father Bamph is with you.
Compare his scale marks with the first prince's; Father Bamph says this supports a conspiracy and that they should check the third prince's body next.
18038.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18039.description: Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) asks the player to visit the Assassin Guild in Morocc to learn how to test whether poison killed the princes.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106), who says the royal family must not be alerted yet and that the case must be investigated fully first.
He asks you to visit the Assassin Guild in Morocc and learn how to verify whether poison was used to kill the princes.
18039.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18040.description: The Assassin Guildsman (moc_fild16 201,295) tells the player to find Marjana in the Assassin's Private Pub in Morocc to learn about poison.
guide: Talk to the Assassin Guildsman (moc_fild16 201,295) and choose 'Poison' to say you need to talk to a poison specialist.
He says there is an Assassin's Private Pub in the 7 o'clock direction in Morocc, and you should find Marjana inside.
18040.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18041.description: At the trigger in Morocc (morocc 45,103), the player reviews what is known about the curse and the poison, then chooses whether to report to Historian Rodafrian or Father Bamph first.
guide: Step on the trigger at morocc 45,103 to review the facts about Jormungand's curse, the princes' deaths, and the poison information from the Assassin Guild.
Choose 'Go to Rodafrian' to visit her first, or 'Go to Father Bamph' to head to Prontera and investigate the princes' bodies.
18041.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18042.description: Historian Rodafrian (morocc_in 45,126) checks the song lyrics the player learned from Mondo, then asks whether the player will share the Jormungand curse secret with her.
guide: Talk to Historian Rodafrian (morocc_in 45,126) and tell her the lyrics you learned from Mondo; she confirms they are the song she was looking for.
Choose 'Tell her about Jormungand's curse' to share the royal secret, or 'Don't tell her' to keep it to yourself.
Either way, Rodafrian sends you back to the priests in Prontera Church.
18042.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18043.description: Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) asks the player to bring 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion to the secret ceremonial grounds to test for poison, after the player reports the Assassin Guild information.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) and relate what you learned about poison from the Assassin Guild.
He asks you to bring 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion to the secret ceremonial grounds, where he will wait for you.
18043.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18044.description: After Historian Rodafrian learns the curse secret, Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) asks the player to bring 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion to the secret ceremonial grounds to test for poison.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) and relate what you learned about poison from the Assassin Guild.
He asks you to bring 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion to the secret ceremonial grounds, where he will wait for you.
18044.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18045.description: After Historian Rodafrian keeps the secret, Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) asks the player to bring 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion to the secret ceremonial grounds to test for poison.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) and relate what you learned about poison from the Assassin Guild.
He asks you to bring 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion to the secret ceremonial grounds, where he will wait for you.
18045.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18046.description: Father Bamph reminds the player to use the hidden switch in the bookshelf to reach the secret ceremonial grounds with 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion for the poison test.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106), who reminds you that the hidden switch in the bookshelf leads to the secret ceremonial grounds.
He reminds you that 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion are needed to test for poison.
18046.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18047.description: Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) reports that the second and third princes were likely murdered with poison, clears Bonnie Imbullea of blame, and thanks the player for the help.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) after the poison test; he says that if poison was used, the second and third princes were murdered.
He reminds you to keep the investigation secret; in the later report he asks you to inform Bonnie Imbullea that the princes' deaths were not her fault, and gives you experience.
18047.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18049.description: The player tells Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316,268) that the princes' deaths were not her fault, and she thanks the player; in the later report she sends the player back to Rodafrian.
guide: Talk to Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316,268) and tell her that the princes' deaths were not her fault.
She is relieved and thanks you; in the later report she tells you to return to Rodafrian, the historian stationed in Morocc.
18049.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18050.description: The player tells Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316,268) that the princes' deaths were not her fault and that the exorcism was probably sabotaged, and she thanks the player.
guide: Talk to Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316,268) and tell her that the princes' deaths were not her fault; keep the poison details to yourself.
She is overjoyed, says Kaanu can finally meet children his own age, and thanks you.
18050.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18051.description: After Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316,268) clears the princes' deaths, Historian Rodafrian (morocc_in 45,126) asks for the song lyrics again, and the player decides whether to share the Jormungand secret with her.
guide: Talk to Historian Rodafrian (morocc_in 45,126) and confirm the song lyrics you learned; she asks whether you have figured them out.
Choose 'Tell her about Jormungand's curse' to share the secret, or 'Don't tell her' to keep it; either choice ends this talk.
18051.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18052.description: The player reports to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) that rare herbs grow in a land to the west, and Bamph thanks the player and asks them to stay out of the secret ceremonial grounds.
guide: Talk to Father Bamph (prt_church 185,106) and tell him that rare herbs grow in a land to the west.

Father Biscuss suspects the people there of the murders; choose 'Land to the west?' and Bamph explains that almost everyone there follows the native religion and that his earlier priests failed there.
Bamph thanks you and asks you to stay out of the secret ceremonial grounds from now on.
18052.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18060.description: Gallina (mosk_in 144,279) asks the player to find her son Mikhail, who broke the Matrushka and ran away, and Anna (mosk_in 148,274) then gives the clue to the Inn 'Sticky Herb Tree'.
guide: Talk to Anna (mosk_in 148,274); Gallina says Mikhail broke the Matrushka and ran away, and asks you to bring him back. Choose 'Yes, I will!' to accept.
Talk to Anna again and choose 'About the situation' to learn that Mikhail went to get paste; her only clue is the Inn 'Sticky Herb Tree'.
18060.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18061.description: The Landlord (mosk_in 135,191) at the Inn 'Sticky Herb Tree' tells the player that Mikhail came by a few hours earlier looking for a high-strength adhesive, but only after the player pays 5000z to stay overnight.
guide: Talk to the Landlord (mosk_in 135,191) at the Inn 'Sticky Herb Tree' and choose 'Ask her about Mikhail.'; she offers the information if you stay overnight for 5000z.

Choose 'Stay overnight and get the info. - 5000z' and wake in the room; then talk to the Landlord again and choose 'Ask her about Mikhail.' to hear that he came by, asked for a high-strength adhesive, and was sent to the pub.
18061.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18062.description: Find the missing boy Mikhail who needs a high-strength adhesive to fix something important.
guide: Talk to the Pub Owner (mosk_in 141,212) at Pub Stream and choose 'Ask him about Mikhail.' He says Mikhail came in pale needing a high-strength adhesive, and points you to Victor.
Buy a drink from the Pub Owner for 1000z, then talk to Victor (mosk_in 147,202) and ask whether he has seen a little boy looking for paste.
Victor says Mikhail came to him crying, was told to go home, and probably hid somewhere rather than going to the swamp where Baba Yaga lives.
18062.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18063.description: Victor (mosk_in 147,202) says the swamp on the large island is too dangerous for a timid boy like Mikhail, so the player searches the Bubbling Swamp (mosk_dun03 153,90), finds no trace of him, and goes back to check his house.
guide: Talk to Victor (mosk_in 147,202), who says a swamp with sticky weeds lies deep in the forest of the large island near Moscovia, and doubts that Mikhail went there.
Visit the Bubbling Swamp (mosk_dun03 153,90); you find no trace of Mikhail, so you decide to go back and check his house one more time.
18063.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18064.description: The player finds Mikhail hiding in the fire pot (mosk_in 205,268) and promises to get the paste he needs from Mr. Victor (mosk_in 147,202).
guide: At the Fire pot (mosk_in 205,268), choose 'Look it over' and then 'Mikhail is in the fire pot.' when the pieces of bread are found.
Talk to Mikhail (mosk_in 202,269); he is afraid of being punished, so promise to get paste from Mr. Victor (mosk_in 147,202) to glue the Matrushka together.
18064.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18065.description: Victor (mosk_in 147,202) tells the player that the high-strength adhesive needs 10 sticky herbs from the swamp on the large island near Moscovia and 1 medicine bowl.
guide: Talk to Victor (mosk_in 147,202) and ask what you need for the adhesive; he says sticky weeds grow deep in the forest of the large island, reached by a long boat trip.
Victor says you should bring 10 sticky herbs and 1 medicine bowl to him.
18065.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18066.description: The player searches the Bubbling Swamp (mosk_dun03 153,90) for Sticky Herbs (item 7763) for the high-strength adhesive that Victor will make.
guide: Search the Bubbling Swamp (mosk_dun03 153,90) by stretching out to find sticky herbs; some searches give a Sticky Herb (item 7763) and others give a Green Herb.
Victor (mosk_in 147,202) reminds you that he needs 10 sticky herbs and 1 medicine bowl for the adhesive.
18066.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18067.description: Make the high-strength adhesive for Mikhail, a little boy who needs it stuck together.
guide: Talk to Victor (mosk_in 147,202) and give him 10 Sticky Herbs (item 7763) and 1 Medicine Bowl (item 7134).
Victor makes the High-Strength Adhesive (item 7764), takes the materials, and tells you to leave him alone.
18067.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18068.description: The player hands the High-Strength Adhesive (item 7764) to Mikhail at the fire pot (mosk_in 205,268), and he fixes the broken Matrushka.
guide: Talk to Mikhail at the Fire pot (mosk_in 205,268) and say you have the paste from Mr. Victor; hand over the High-Strength Adhesive (item 7764).
Mikhail fixes the Matrushka; promise him that you will bring it back to his mother and that he will be a brave general, and he says he will give it to Mom.
18068.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18069.description: Gallina (mosk_in 144,279) thanks the player for bringing Mikhail back with the Matrushka, and the quest is completed with experience.
guide: Talk to Gallina (mosk_in 144,279), who says Mikhail came back with the Matrushka roughly pasted together and that she will punish Anna too.
She thanks you for going to a dangerous place to find her son and says Larissa, the maid, can teach you how to make hotcakes; the quest is completed and you receive experience.
18069.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18070.description: Baba Yaga, the Horrible (mosk_in 215,46) asks the player to help her make a magic that stops winter from returning, and dictates the list of materials she needs.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga, the Horrible (mosk_in 215,46) and choose 'Ok, I will.' to accept her request for help; she asks you to come back later.

When you return, Baba Yaga dictates the materials she needs: 20 Grasshopper's Legs, 5 Spawn, 20 Wings of Red Bat, 10 Sticky Mucus, 10 Witched Starsand, 10 Fine Grits, 1 Detonator, 5 Red Blood, 10 Burning Hearts, and a 1, 2 or 3 carat Diamond.
She says she is preparing the magic and asks you to bring the materials quickly.
18070.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59.

18071.description: Baba Yaga, the Horrible (mosk_in 215,46) checks the materials for the magic, including Sticky Mucus, and when all are present she takes them and sends the player after the Magic Gourd Bottle.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga, the Horrible (mosk_in 215,46) and hand over 20 Grasshopper's Legs, 5 Spawn, 20 Wings of Red Bat, 10 Sticky Mucus, 10 Witched Starsand, 10 Fine Grits, 1 Detonator, 5 Red Blood, 10 Burning Hearts, and a 1, 2 or 3 carat Diamond (item 730, 731 or 732).
When everything is there, she takes the materials and says the Magic Gourd Bottle (item 7761) is in a dragon's lair, and warns you to avoid fighting that dragon.
18071.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59.

18072.description: Baba Yaga, the Horrible (mosk_in 215,46) checks the magic materials from a list without Sticky Mucus, and when all are present she sends the player after the Magic Gourd Bottle.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga, the Horrible (mosk_in 215,46) and hand over 20 Grasshopper's Legs, 5 Spawn, 20 Wings of Red Bat, 10 Witched Starsand, 10 Fine Grits, 1 Detonator, 5 Red Blood, 10 Burning Hearts, and a 1, 2 or 3 carat Diamond (item 730, 731 or 732).
When everything is there, she takes the materials and says the Magic Gourd Bottle (item 7761) is in a dragon's lair, and warns you to avoid fighting that dragon.
18072.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59.

18073.description: Baba Yaga (mosk_in 215,46) sends the player to search the pile of skeletons in the dragon's lair for the Magic Gourd Bottle.
guide: Go to the pile of skeletons (mosk_dun03 225,233) in the dragon's lair, where Baba Yaga says the bottle is hidden.
Choose 'Look for it.' until you find the bottle; a Thief finds it at once, and other classes find it by chance, which gives the Magic Gourd Bottle (item 7761).
18073.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59 to proceed.

18074.description: Baba Yaga (mosk_in 215,46) receives the Magic Gourd Bottle and says it must hold the sincere words of three villagers: a child, a young man and a middle-aged man.
guide: Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_in 215,46) while carrying the Magic Gourd Bottle (item 7761); she is pleased that you came back alive from the dragon's lair.
She explains that the bottle holds people's speech, which must be spoken naturally and not forced, and that the quest now moves to the villagers (changequest 18074,18075).
18074.level_basis: The level gate in the script requires BaseLevel > 59 to proceed with Yaga's Pestle.

18075.description: The player collects sincere words about winter from a child, a young man and a middle-aged man in Moscovia for Baba Yaga's Magic Gourd Bottle.
guide: Talk to Yosefina (moscovia 252,203) about warm weather, or to Vasili (moscovia 255,203) about going on adventures when it gets warm, to hear a child's words.
Talk to Fedor (moscovia 233,204) about winter for the young man's words, and to Viktor (moscovia 219,229) about who likes winter for the middle-aged man's words.
Each villager speaks only by chance, so repeat the talk; once a child, a young man and a middle-aged man have spoken, the quest moves on (changequest 18075,18076).
18075.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59 (Yaga_Pestle)

18076.description: Bring Yaga's Pestles to Csar Alexsay III to prove innocence regarding Baba Yaga.
guide: Talk to Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92) and choose 'Explain the circumstances.' to begin his special trial.
Show the Yaga's Pestles (item 7762): he needs 40, and with 40 he takes them (delitem 7762,40), which moves the quest on (changequest 18076,18077). With fewer than 40 he sends you back for more.
18076.level_basis: Yaga's Pestle (item 7762) is dropped by Baba Yaga (level 49).

18077.description: Baba Yaga (mosk_in 215,46) takes the Magic Gourd Bottle and makes the Yaga_Secret_Medicine, while the Csar asks to be told at once when winter is banished.
guide: Talk to Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92), who asks you to help Baba Yaga seize the summer and to announce to him at once when winter is banished.
Talk to Baba Yaga (mosk_in 215,46) while carrying the Magic Gourd Bottle (item 7761); she takes it to make the medicine.
Talk to Baba Yaga again until she gives you the Yaga_Secret_Medicine (item 7765), which moves the quest on (changequest 18077,18078).
18077.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59

18078.description: Carry the Yaga_Secret_Medicine (item 7765) from Baba Yaga to the center of Moscovia (moscovia 224,190) and drop it there to banish winter.
guide: Go to the center of Moscovia (moscovia 224,190) with the Yaga_Secret_Medicine (item 7765) you received from Baba Yaga (mosk_in 215,46).
Use the spot to drop the medicine; it is taken from you, winter is banished, and the quest moves on (changequest 18078,18079).
18078.level_basis: The level gate in the NPC script requires BaseLevel > 59

18079.description: Report to Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92) after winter is banished, and he thanks the player and gives the Old Blue Box (item 603).
guide: Talk to Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92) after winter is banished; he says the winter will not come again and he is pleased.
He gives you the Old Blue Box (item 603) as an atonement to his people and completes the quest (completequest 18079).
18079.level_basis: Yaga's Pestle (item 7762) is dropped by Baba Yaga (level 49).

18100.description: Learn the legend of The Moving Island in Moscovia from Berbayeff and decide whether to seek its appearance.
guide: Talk to Berbayeff (moscovia 171,71), choose 'Tell me.' and listen to how he saw The Moving Island from the village's south shore.
He says he will go up to the island when it appears again, which moves the quest on (changequest 18100,18101).
18100.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18101.description: Berbayeff (moscovia 171,71) waits for The Moving Island to appear again and, when the player asks about a ship, sends the player to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49).
guide: Talk to Berbayeff (moscovia 171,71) while the island is out of sight; he wants the island certified when it appears again.
Ask him about a ship: he says he has none and sends you to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49), which moves the quest on (changequest 18101,18102).
18101.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18102.description: Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49) refuses to lend his ship to a stranger at first, and tells his adventure stories only to a listener.
guide: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49) and choose 'Lend me your ship.' before listening; he refuses to lend it to a stranger (changequest 18102,18103).
Choose 'Tell me an adventure story.' and listen to his story about Payon; at the line about the haunting of a Goblin mob the quest moves on (changequest 18102,18103).
18102.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18103.description: Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49) tells the story of a Goblin mob, and the player listens to the end of his second story.
guide: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49) and choose 'Interesting. Keep talking.' to hear his story about the haunting of a Goblin mob.
When he finishes and says he will tell the adventure story next time, the quest moves on (changequest 18103,18104).
18103.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18104.description: After hearing his stories, the player asks Mr. Ibanoff to lend his ship, and he lists the materials needed to repair it.
guide: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49) and choose 'Lend me your ship.' after his stories; he says the ship has not floated for a long time and needs repair parts.
He lists the materials: Strange Steel Piece 10, Rusty Screw 10, Flexible Tube 5 and Jubilee 10; bring them to him when they are ready (changequest 18104,18105).
18104.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18105.description: The player brings Strange Steel Piece, Rusty Screw, Flexible Tube and Jubilee to Mr. Ibanoff, who uses them to repair the ship.
guide: Bring 10 Strange Steel Pieces (item 7167), 10 Rusty Screws (item 7317), 5 Flexible Tubes (item 7325) and 10 Jubilee (item 7312) to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49).
He checks the counts, takes the materials for the repair, and the quest moves on (changequest 18105,18106).
18105.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18106.description: Mr. Ibanoff takes the player out on his ship and tells them to steer east, following his orders from the sea.
guide: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff on his ship (mosk_ship 98,110), who says he will order where to go by watching the seas.
He tells you to hold the rudder forward to the east at first, which moves the quest on (changequest 18106,18107).
18106.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18107.description: Mr. Ibanoff sails east with the player, has the rudder turned north when the sea currents change, and asks the player to look around the deck for something moving beyond the sea.
guide: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (mosk_ship 98,110) and keep the rudder held east as he says.
When he says the sea currents have changed, adjust the rudder north to follow them; until then keep sailing on the same heading.
When he asks you to look beyond the sea, go around the deck to look more carefully (changequest 18107,18108).
18107.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18108.description: Mr. Ibanoff warns the player about something rising from the sea near the ship, and the player is moved to the island at mosk_fild01 95,93.
guide: Go around the deck of Mr. Ibanoff's ship (mosk_ship 98,110) as he asks, and walk to the spot near mosk_ship 81,110 where the sea starts to move.
Mr. Ibanoff warns that something is rising from the water, and you are moved to the island near mosk_fild01 95,93 (changequest 18108,18109).
18108.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18109.description: The player wakes on Whale Island with the Aged Stranger (mosk_fild01 86,104), who explains that the island is a gigantic whale and plays an instrument that moves it.
guide: Talk to the Aged Stranger (mosk_fild01 86,104) after waking; he says this is the moving island and that it is actually a whale.
He plays an unfamiliar instrument, the island starts to move, and the quest moves on as he prepares to send you back (changequest 18109,18110).
18109.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18110.description: The Aged Stranger on Whale Island tells the player they will return to the mainland soon, and the player is sent back to Moscovia (moscovia 163,54).
guide: Talk to the Aged Stranger (mosk_fild01 86,104) and ask how to come back to the island; he says you can return by enduring the same seas as before.
He sends you back to the mainland, and the quest moves on (changequest 18110,18111); you arrive at moscovia 163,54.
18110.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18111.description: Mr. Ibanoff hears the player's story about the Aged Stranger and the whale, and suggests reporting it to the Csar.
guide: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49) and choose 'Explain the whole story.' to tell him what happened on Whale Island.
He says the story should be announced to the Csar, who may give a prize, and the quest moves on (changequest 18111,18112).
18111.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18112.description: The player tells the Csar about the moving whale island and the old man, and the Csar asks for proof before he will give a reward.
guide: Talk to Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92) and tell him about the moving island, the whale and the old man with the instrument.
He asks you to bring evidence of the whale island and the instrument, and the quest moves on (changequest 18112,18113).
18112.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18113.description: Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49) tells the player that the Csar wants evidence of the whale island, and offers to sail there once more.
guide: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49), who says that finding the whale island again will be difficult.
Choose 'Try again to find Whale Island.' and he agrees to get the ship ready and sail before the sun sets, which moves the quest on (changequest 18113,18114).
18113.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18114.description: Mr. Ibanoff readies the ship at a nearby dock and sails with the player to find Whale Island again while the tide is low.
guide: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49) and choose 'Let's go.' when he asks if you are ready; he only departs in certain hours of the day, while the tides are low.
He sends you to the ship at mosk_ship 94,110, where Mr. Ibanoff (mosk_ship 98,110) gives the sailing orders and the quest moves on (changequest 18114,18115).
18114.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18115.description: Mr. Ibanoff sails east with the player, following his orders, until the ship reaches the moving island and the player lands on it.
guide: Stay on Mr. Ibanoff's ship and keep the rudder held east as he orders.
When Mr. Ibanoff says there is a moving island ahead, you land on the island at mosk_fild01 93,94, which moves the quest on (changequest 18115,18116).
18115.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18116.description: On Whale Island the Aged Stranger hears the player's story and agrees to make a new instrument if the player brings the listed materials.
guide: Talk to the Aged Stranger (mosk_fild01 86,104) on Whale Island and choose 'Explain the whole story.' to tell him what happened.
Tell him you want one of his instruments made, and he lists the materials: Log 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20 and Sea-otter Fur 10, which moves the quest on (changequest 18116,18117).
When you say you are ready, he sends you back to the mainland at moscovia 162,56.
18116.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

18117.description: The player gathers Log, Tough Vines, Antelope Horn and Sea-otter Fur for the Aged Stranger's instrument, then returns to the island with Mr. Ibanoff to hand them over.
guide: Gather Log 30 (item 7201), Tough Vines 20 (item 7197), Antelope Horn 20 (item 7106) and Sea-otter Fur 10 (item 7065); the Aged Stranger says these can be found on the mainland.
Go back to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135,49), who says the old man will not move the island until you return, and he sails you back to the island.
On the island, the Aged Stranger (mosk_fild01 86,104) checks the materials, takes them, and starts making the instrument (changequest 18117,18118).
18117.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18118.description: The Aged Stranger on Whale Island finishes the instrument, the Gusli (item 2707), and gives it to the player.
guide: Talk to the Aged Stranger (mosk_fild01 86,104) and wait; he says the instrument is not finished yet until he succeeds.
When the instrument is ready he gives you the Gusli (item 2707) and says the Csar will believe your story if you show it (changequest 18118,18119).
18118.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18119.description: Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92) hears the player's story about the whale island while the player carries the Gusli, and gives a reward.
guide: Talk to Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92) while carrying the Gusli (item 2707) and choose 'Tell the story all the while.' to tell him about the island.
The Csar and Prime Minister Dmitree doubt the story, but the Csar gives you Old_Bleu_Box (item 12702) and experience, which completes the quest (completequest 18119).
18119.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18120.description: The player learns to play the Gusli from the Aged Stranger and then plays it for Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92), who gives a reward.
guide: Learn the Gusli from the Aged Stranger (mosk_fild01 86,104): equip the Gusli (item 2707) and copy the song he plays; if the play is weak he says to practice and check again.

When he says you play well, the quest moves on (changequest 18119,18120); talk to Csar Alexsay III (mosk_in 131,92), choose 'I can play.' and play the Gusli, and he gives Old_Violet_Box (item 617) and experience, which completes the quest (completequest 18120).
18120.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

18121.description: Irina (moscovia 211,93) makes a Shafka hat for the player from Fox Tail, Yarn, Soft Silk Cloth, Sea-otter Leather and a Spool.
guide: Talk to Irina (moscovia 211,93) and choose 'Learn about the Shafka.' to hear why the hat keeps you warm in winter.
Choose 'Make a Shafka hat.' to accept the request (setquest 18121).

Give Irina 20 Fox Tails (item 1022), 10 Yarn (item 7038), 10 Soft Silk Cloth (item 7166), 20 Sea-otter Leather (item 7065) and 1 Spool (item 7217); she makes the hat, gives you item 5243, and completes the quest (completequest 18121).
18121.level_basis: The item droppers range too widely to pick one level.

60200.description: The Endless Tower Effect quest starts when a party of at least two members enters the Endless Tower, and the stone then keeps the party from entering again for a while.
guide: Make a party of at least two members and talk to the Tower Protection Stone (e_tower 81,105); the party leader chooses 'Generate dungeon Endless Tower' to reserve the dungeon.
Choose 'Enter the Endless Tower' at the same stone to go in; entering sets the quest (setquest 60200 and 60201), and the stone refuses entry until the timer runs out.
60200.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60201.description: Endless Tower Time Limit is the timer the Tower Protection Stone sets when a party enters the Endless Tower; while it runs, the stone lets the party enter the generated dungeon again.
guide: Make a party of at least two members and have the party leader reserve the Endless Tower at the Tower Protection Stone (e_tower 81,105).
Choose 'Enter the Endless Tower' at the same stone; entering sets this quest (setquest 60201), and while the timer runs the stone lets the party enter the generated dungeon again.
60201.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60211.description: Sahedi (thor_camp 250,104) is told that the volcano may erupt, and the player takes the report back to the Drunken Man (ve_in 233,116), where Geologist Gio speaks.
guide: Talk to Sahedi (thor_camp 250,104) and answer 'Yes' when she asks whether the volcano will erupt soon; she panics and gives you the report form (item 7342), which moves the quest on (changequest 2128,60211).

Take the report to the Drunken Man (ve_in 233,116) and tell Geologist Gio what you did; he admits he broke the pyrometer on purpose and takes the File01 report, the Broken Thermometer (item 7704) and the Note Of Geologist (item 7705) (changequest 60211,60212).
60211.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60212.description: After Geologist Gio's report, the player searches the bookshelf (ve_in 281,214) and takes one reward item from Gio's box along with experience.
guide: Search the bookshelf (ve_in 281,214) after Geologist Gio's report; you reach into Gio's purple box of goodies, which moves the quest on (changequest 60212,60213).
You receive one item from the box, either a Random Quiver (item 12104), a Sway Apron (item 661), five Giggling Boxes (item 12027) or a Bloody Dead Branch (item 12103), together with experience.
60212.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60213.description: After the bookshelf reward at Thor Volcano, the player is sent back to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159).
guide: Return to High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277,159), as the bookshelf reward message tells you to do.
60213.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60351.description: The Bathroom Ghost starts at the door, where the player turns the key seven times, and the player then flushes the toilet three times to move the ghost along.
guide: At the door (bra_in01 149,184), choose 'Turn the key.' and turn the key 7 times; you hear water flushing, which moves the quest on (changequest 2208,60351).
At the toilet (bra_in01 144,187), choose 'Flush the toilet.' and flush it 3 times (changequest 60351,60352).
60351.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60352.description: The player turns on the faucet at bra_in01 134,189 once, which makes the carpet move and moves the ghost on.
guide: At the faucet (bra_in01 134,189), choose 'Examine it.' and then 'Turn on the water.' and turn the water on once; you see the carpet move (changequest 60352,60353).
60352.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60353.description: The player shakes the carpet at bra_in01 138,184 seven times, which makes a distant sound and moves the ghost on.
guide: At the carpet (bra_in01 138,184), choose 'Shake the carpet.' and shake it 7 times; you hear a distant sound, which moves the quest on (changequest 60353,60354).
60353.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60354.description: The player examines the mirror at bra_in01 151,180 and answers the spell line, then chooses whether to take off the eye bandage or run away.
guide: At the mirror (bra_in01 151,180), choose 'Examine it.' and answer 'Where are you mom?' as the next line of the spell.
Choose 'Take the eye bandage off.' to see the ghost, which moves the quest on (changequest 60354,60355); choosing 'Run away~.' sends you away and resets the quest to 2208 (changequest 60354,2208).
60354.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.

60355.description: After the ghost appears, the player goes to the Open Manhole (bra_in01 206,188), hears the ghost's story about dying in the jungle, and completes the quest with experience.
guide: Go to the Open Manhole (bra_in01 206,188) after you take the eye bandage off the ghost at the mirror; you are moved there by the warp.
At the manhole, the ghost tells you that he died wandering the jungle many years ago, and the quest is completed with experience (completequest 60355).
60355.level_basis: No monster, item or level gate in the facts sets a level.
